title: Glazed Donut Bread
description: Glazed Donut Bread is a soft, tender loaf topped with a shiny vanilla glaze that drips down the sides. Inspired by my Cinnamon Sugar Donut Bread, this easy breakfast bread is perfect for mornings, brunch, or a sweet snack!
ingredients: 4 to 5 tablespoons milk, (or heavy cream for richer glaze)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray an 8 ½ x 4 ½-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, granulated sugar, baking powder, salt, and ground nutmeg.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla until well combined.
Pour the milk mixture into the flour mixture and stir gently until just combined. Be careful not to overmix; the batter should be a bit runny.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan, spreading it evenly.
Bake for 60 to 70 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out with a few crumbs and the top is golden brown.

Once baked, remove the bread from the oven and let it cool in the pan for about 10 minutes. Then, carefully remove the bread from the pan and place it on a wire rack set over parchment paper (to catch drips).

In a medium bowl, whisk together confectioners' sugar, 4 tablespoons milk, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt until smooth. If too thick, add milk ½ tablespoon at a time until pourable. (It should be thick but drizzle easily.)

While the bread is still slightly warm, pour or spoon the glaze generously over the top, letting it drip down the sides. For full donut-style coverage, you can dip the top directly into the glaze or brush on extra layers.
Let the glaze set for 20 to 30 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Gluten free pot pie
description: Entering my cozy food season aka where i thrive 🥧🥕👩🏻‍🍳 Gluten free biscuit-topped pot pie: For the biscuit topping: ½ cup unsalted butter, melted 2 eggs 2 tbsp milk
ingredients: ¼ tsp garlic powder More melted butter, for brushing the biscuits For the filling:
½ of a medium yellow onion, finely diced
1 cup Yukon gold potatoes, diced into small cubed
¼ cup gluten free all-purpose flour (OR sub
3 sprigs of fresh thyme, stems removed About 4 cups shredded (cooked) chicken
steps: Start by making the biscuit dough. In a large bowl, whisk together the butter, eggs, and milk. Stir in the almond flour, baking powder, salt, and garlic powder. Set dough in the refrigerator to chill.
Preheat oven to 400°F
Heat a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat with the butter. Stir in onion, potatoes, and garlic. Allow to cook for 8 minutes.
if you don’t have an oven-safe skillet, you can transfer everything later to an oven-safe baking dish.

Next, whisk in the flour, italian seasoning, and salt and pepper then slowly pour in your broth while continuing to whisk. Add your milk of choice and the fresh thyme leaves. Give everything a good stir, then allow to thicken for 5 or so minutes.
Stir in your frozen mixed vegetables and chicken and allow to cook for another 5 minutes.
Using a cookie scoop out 8 biscuits on top of the filling. Brush each biscuit with melted butter.
Bake for 17-20 minutes, until filling is bubbly and biscuits are slightly browned and cooked through. Serve and enjoy!

title: Grain Free Chocolate Chip Cassava Cookie Bars
description: These cookie bars have a rich, buttery flavor, and they come together in one bowl and one pan. AND they’re naturally gluten-free and grain-free. Yesssssssssss (please)!! The bars are made with cassava flour, which lends the cookies a fluffy texture with a light but rich crumb. They’re irresistible when warm, and they freeze beautifully. The cookie bars are naturally sweetened with coconut sugar (a
sourceName: From Scratch Fast | Recipes from scratch for busy cooks!
ingredients: 3/4 cup (115 g) packed coconut sugar (sometimes labeled coconut palm sugar)
1 cup (130 g) cassava flour (I prefer Bob's Red Mill brand)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit (175 degrees Celsius). Spray an 8x8-inch pan with cooking spray, then line it crosswise with parchment paper (this will make it easy to pull the cookie bars out later).

In the bowl of a stand mixer with the paddle attachment, combine the softened butter and coconut sugar. Mix on high until lightened in color and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Add the eggs, honey and vanilla, and mix on high until incorporated, stopping and scraping the sides as needed, about 1 to 2 minutes. Add the cassava flour, baking powder and salt, and mix on low until incorporated (the batter will be thick). Scrape the sides, and add 1 cup of the chocolate chips and the pecans. Mix on low until just combined.

Spread the batter in an even layer in the prepared pan (it will be quite thick so will take a bit of work to get it into the corners—a small offset spatula works great). Sprinkle the top with the remaining 1/4 cup chocolate chips. Bake until golden brown on top, about 24 to 26 minutes. Place the pan on a wire rack and let cool. Remove the cookie by pulling on the parchment handles. Cut it into bars using a sharp knife, cleaning the knife between slices (you can cut into 9 large bars or smaller bite-sized squares). If you’re anything like me, you’re going to want to serve these with cold milk or ice cream (yesssss)!!

title: GREATEST LASAGNA EVER
description: GREATEST LASAGNA EVER
ingredients: 32 oz mozzarella (16 oz shredded, 16 oz sliced)
2 quarts tomato basil sauce (jarred or homemade)
steps: 1️⃣ Sauté onions & garlic in oil, add beef + salt, brown well. Stir in tomato sauce, simmer, and salt to taste.
2️⃣ In a separate pan, sauté onions, garlic & spinach until wilted. Off heat, mix with ricotta, then eggs & parmesan. Season to taste.
3️⃣ Cook noodles until slightly al dente.
4️⃣ Butter a 9x13” dish. Line bottom with noodles, letting ends hang over edges.
5️⃣ Layer: thin meat sauce → noodles → 1/3 meat sauce + 1/4 mozzarella → noodles → 1/3 spinach mix. Repeat (3 full layers).
6️⃣ Fold over noodles, top with sauce, sliced mozzarella & remaining parmesan.
7️⃣ Cover with foil & bake at 350°F for 20 min. Uncover & bake 15 min more until browned. Let it rest, slice & serve!
Homemade Tomato Basil Sauce (Optional):
6 cans (28 oz) whole peeled tomatoes 20 garlic cloves, crushed l• 1 cup olive oil
Salt 4 oz fresh basil
Simmer all but basil for 25 min. Blend until smooth. Stir in basil, rest 10 min, salt to taste. Freeze the extra!

title: Greek Chicken Bowl
description: Recipe below👇🥗 Lemon Potatoes: 6-7 baby potatoes, quartered
steps: Add all ingredients to a roasting pan & bake at 400F for 35-45 minutes or until edges are starting to brown.
Chicken Souvlaki:

2 chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes 5 lemons, juiced 1/4 cup olive oil 4 garlic cloves, minced 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped 2 tbsp fresh oregano, chopped 1/2 tsp cumin powder 1/2 tsp chili flakes 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp pepper
In a large bowl, combine lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, chopped parsley, oregano, cumin powder, chili flakes, salt & pepper.
Cut chicken breasts into 1-inch cubes and mix into bowl with other ingredients. Cover and place in the fridge to marinate for 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.

Preheat outdoor grill or grill pan and drizzle with 2 tbsp olive oil. Thread chicken pieces onto skewers and place on grill, turning on all sides for about 8-10 minutes, until chicken is fully cooked through (165 F). Tzatziki:
5 cups plain Greek yogurt 1/2 english cucumber, grated 2-3 garlic cloves, minced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp red wine vinegar 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp pepper
Grate 1/2 an english cucumber using the large side of a box grater. Place grated cucumber in a fine mesh strainer to drain excess water.
Using your hands, squeeze all remaining water out of cucumber and transfer to bowl with Greek yogurt, garlic, olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Mix together until combined.

title: Greek Turkey Meatballs
description: Replying to @Kahlua76 GREEK TURKEY MEATBALLS w/ ORZO SALAD ✨ Ingredients: GREEK TURKEY MEATBALLS - 1 lb lean ground turkey (see notes) 1 tbsp olive oil (15 g) 1 large egg 1/4 cup plain bread crumbs (28 g) 1/4 cup red onion (40 g) finely minced 3 cloves garlic minced 2 tbsp parsley, chopped 1 tbsp di
ingredients: 1/4 cup red onion (40 g) finely minced
1/4 cup red onion (40 g) finely diced
1/2 tsp garlic powder salt and pepper, to taste
steps: Preheat oven to 400 F and line a half baking sheet with parchment.

In a mixing bowl, mix together all turkey meatball ingredients and stir until just combined. Use a cookie scoop or spoon to form into 20 equal meatballs (~1.5 tbsp each). Bake 15 min, until golden brown and juices run clear (165F internal temp).
Meanwhile, cook the orzo according to box instructions. Drain and rinse with cold water.
For the lemon vinaigrette, whisk together lemon juice, dijon, honey, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Slowly drizzle in olive oil while constantly whisking to emulsify.

Mix cooked orzo, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, feta and lemon vinaigrette. For meal prep, separate orzo salad equally into 4 containers with 5 meatballs each. Enjoy with fresh lemon and tzatziki! Notes:

I prefer 99/1 lean turkey for the most protein, but this can be too dry for some. I’d recommend using 93/7 if you like a juicier meatball. For the full printable recipe + tips & nutrition, search 🔍 “Greek turkey meatballs” at myproteinpantry.com or link 🔗 in my bio! 💖 Enjoy!

title: Greek-Inspired Meatballs and Orzo
description: Greek-Inspired Meatballs and Orzo Lean Greek-Inspired Meatballs: -1 lb.
steps: Preheat the oven 350F
In a large bowl, mix all ingredients until combined
Scoop out even portions of the meat (I like to use a tablespoon scoop) and roll into balls, then place on a parchment-lined baking sheet
Bake for 10 minutes, turn over each meatball, then bake for another 7-10 minutes until the meatballs are cooked all the way through (reaching an internal temparature of ~160)
Remove from oven and let rest before adding into the orzo or packing up for the fridge Orzo:
1 tbsp butter 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil 2 c orzo 3 c chicken bone broth salt (to taste)
pepper (to taste)
2 c spinach (chopped)
1/4 c sundried tomatoes (diced)
1/4 c crumbled feta cheese 1/4 c kalamata olives (diced) Instructions:
Heat butter and olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, pan then add in the orzo and stir occassionally until lightly toasted
Stir in the chicken bone broth and bring it to a light simmer for 5-8 minutes until the orzo has absorbed most of the broth
Add in salt and pepper, taste, and adjust
Once seasoned to your liking, stir in the spinach, sundried tomatoes, feta, and olives and cook for about a minute so the spinach cooks down
Add the meatballs into the orzo and cover to slightly reheat them (if needed), then cut the heat
Serve and enjoy!

title: Green Chicken Enchiladas
description: I promise you are going to want to make these.
steps: Mix green sauce with chilies and sour cream.
Smooth 1 spoonful of the sauce around the bottom of a pan.
Simmer the chicken broth in a skillet, and before placing each tortilla in the 9×13 pan, use tongs and pass the tortilla through the broth for just a few seconds.
Layer 6 tortillas over the first layer of sauce.
Layering order:
🌮 tortillas
🍗 1/2 chicken
🧀 1/3 of the cheese
🫕 1/3 of the sauce
Repeat.
Finish with final layer of tortillas, sauce and cheese.
Bake 350 for 30-35 mins uncovered until bubbly.

title: Ground Pork Tacos with Pineapple Salsa
description: who’s hungry?!!
ingredients: 1/4 cup pineapple juice juice of 1/2 lime flour or corn small tortillas for the salsa: all finely chopped
½ lime juice Pinch salt for the Chili Lime Crema: ½ cup sour cream
1 tsp chili powder pinch of salt
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Once hot, add the ground pork and break it apart with a spatula as it cooks. When it's about halfway cooked, stir in the minced garlic, chili powder, smoked paprika, cumin, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Mix until well incorporated.
Stir in the soy sauce, pineapple juice, and the juice of ½ lime. Let everything simmer for about 5 more minutes, until the liquid slightly reduces and the pork is fully cooked.

While the pork cooks, make the pineapple salsa by combining the finely chopped pineapple, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime juice, and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Stir well and set aside so the flavors can meld together.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together the sour cream, mayo, lime juice, honey, chili powder, and a pinch of salt until smooth and creamy.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or directly over a gas flame until soft and lightly charred.

Assemble the tacos by filling each tortilla with the pork, topping with the fresh pineapple salsa, and finishing with a generous drizzle of the chili lime crema. Serve immediately with extra lime wedges if desired

title: Hailey Bieber Meatballs with Tipsy Tomato Sauce
description: But of course with my tipsy tomato sauce 😉 Hailey Bieber meatballs but with my own little tweaks ⬇️ Meatballs 1 lb ground chicken 1/2 cup cottage cheese 3/4 cup panko breadcrumbs 1/2 cup grated Parmesan 1 large egg 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper Olive
ingredients: 1/4 tsp black pepper Olive oil, for cooking Vodka Sauce
1/2 cup grated Parmesan Salt and black pepper, to taste For serving Grated Parmesan Red pepper flakes Fresh basil
steps: Add the ground chicken, cottage cheese, panko, Parmesan, egg, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt and pepper to a bowl. Mix gently until just combined.
Roll into meatballs

Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden on all sides and completely cooked through to 165°F, about 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer the meatballs to a serving plate.
In the same skillet, add the olive oil, butter and red pepper flakes. Cook for about 30 seconds.
Add the vodka and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and simmer for about 5 minutes.
Lower the heat and stir in the heavy cream and Parmesan until the sauce is creamy and smooth.
Spoon the warm vodka sauce generously over the cooked meatballs.
Finish with more grated Parmesan, red pepper flakes and fresh basil

title: Ham Cheddar + Chive Protein Biscuits
description: Ham Cheddar + Chive Protein Biscuits!
ingredients: 1/4 cup milk, plus more for brushing tops
7 oz deli ham, diced in to small pieces
1/3 cup diced green onion OR chives (or a mix)
steps: Preheat oven to 425 and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Blend cottage cheese and milk until creamy. In a large bowl, mix with honey and melted butter, then fold in ham, cheese, and green onion.
In a separate large bowl, mix together all of your dry ingredients. Add to your wet ingredients and mix until just combined- dough will be crumbly and looks slightly dry. That’s OK!
Turn your dough out onto a clean floured work surface. Use floured hands to combine the dough to make it less crumbly and into more of a smooth dough.

Roll dough out as much as you can into a rectangle (ish) about 3/4 inch thick. Don’t worry about it being too perfect! Fold one end of the rectangle into the center, and then the other end of the rectangle over it, like a letter.

Flatten dough again into a more narrow rectangle that is again about 3/4 inch thick. Repeat the process of folding one end into the center and then the other end over it. This is what creates the layers in the biscuits!
Roll a little once again just to pack layers together more tightly. Cut dough into 6-9 biscuits and place on baking sheet almost touching each other.

Brush the tops with milk and then bake for 20-30 minutes (depending on size of your biscuits- smaller ones will cook faster), until tops are slightly brown in centers are set. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before enjoying. Optional: brush tops w/ butter + honey!

title: hash brown egg nests
description: meal prep breakfast on repeat!!!
ingredients: 2 tbsp fresh chives, finely chopped Hot sauce or ketchup, for serving
steps: Preheat your oven to 425°F & generously grease a 12-cup muffin tin with cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine the thawed hash browns, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and 1/2 cup of the shredded cheddar cheese. Mix until everything is evenly combined. Divide the hash brown mixture evenly between the muffin cups. Using your fingers, press the mixture firmly into each cup, making the sides slightly thicker and the bottom thinner. Use the bottom of a 1/4 or 1/3 cup measuring cup to gently press down and create a nest in the center of each. Lightly spray the tops of the hash browns with cooking spray to help them crisp. Bake for 20 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and starting to crisp. Remove the pan from the oven. Carefully crack one egg into each hash brown nest, then sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup of cheddar cheese evenly over the tops. Return the pan to the oven and bake for another 10-12 minutes, depending on how you like your eggs. For a runnier yolk, check them around the 10-minute mark. For a firmer yolk, bake a little longer. Let the egg cups cool in the muffin pan for about 10 minutes before carefully loosening the edges with a small knife and removing them. Top with a sprinkle of salt, black pepper, and freshly chopped chives. Serve warm with your favorite hot sauce or ketchup.

title: Hawaiian Roll Recipe
description: Ditch the crap and enjoy fresh homemade Hawaiian Rolls with just 7 simple ingredients!
ingredients: 2 Tablespoons melted butter (for on top of rolls)
steps: In a small bowl, combine the warm water, yeast, and 1 T honey. Stir lightly and let it sit for 5-10 minutes until it becomes frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour & salt. Warm oil plus remaining honey and add it to the flour mixture.
Add the frothy yeast mixture + the rest of the honey to the bowl and mix well.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for about 2-3 minutes until it is smooth and elastic.
Shape into 12 ball shapes and place them in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish or on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Cover the shaped rolls with a clean kitchen towel and let them rise for 30-45 minutes, or until puffy.
Gently brush the rolls with the melted butter before placing them in the oven Preheat your oven to 375°F Bake the rolls for 18-20 minutes, or until golden brown on top.
While the rolls are still warm, brush them with the remaining melted butter.
Once cooled slice through the entire section of 12 rolls and layer ham, mayo, and cheese.
Place the top half of the rolls back on top and put back in the oven for 8-10 minutes!
Pull apart and enjoy!

title: Hawaiian Teriyaki Bowls
description: hawaiian-inspired teriyaki bowls 🌴🌺🍯🍍🥒 recipe below!
ingredients: sriracha mayo (1 tsp @Yellowbird Foods sriracha & 2 tbsps mayo) add a splash of water & mix until smooth
steps: First we’ll start on the sauce. Add all of the ingredients into a medium sized bowl (listed above). Whisk together until smooth. Set aside for now.
Heat up your skillet over medium heat, add a splash of avocado oil and a pound of ground chicken. Break it up til it’s brown you know the drill.
While we wait for it to brown, I started prepping my toppings. Cubed pineapple, thinly sliced jalapeño, roughly chopped green onions, thinly sliced red onion and Persian cucumber.
watch your chicken and stir periodically
By then out chicken should be fully browned. Give your sauce a quick mix then pour into the pan with the chicken. Mix until well coated. Allow it to simmer 4-5 minutes.
While that’s simmering, I did a quick sriracha mayo (measurements listed above).
Stir in 1 tbsp arrowroot starch to thicken the sauce. Stir until thickened ~30 seconds (the best hack ever) then it’s time to serve!

title: Healthier General Tso's
description: Healthier General Tso's Chicken 🐓🔥
ingredients: Seasonings: Salt, pepper, garlic powder & onion powder
Jasmine rice cooked in chicken bone broth.
Salt, pepper & onion powder to taste
1/4 cup light brown sugar, tightly packed
Note(s): Some measurements are estimated, adjust ingredients to your liking. Could
also sub for chicken breasts if you prefer.
steps: Add all pf the general tso’s sauce ingredients to a small pot and mix. Bring it to a low boil and continue mixing until the sauce thickens. Should take 3-5 minutes. Once done, set aside.
Trim the chicken thighs to your liking then cut them into bite sized cubes.
Place the chicken into a large bowl. Drizzle in some avocado oil and season generously with salt, pepper, onion powder & garlic powder. Mix till well combined.

Get a large skillet going over medium-high heat and spray with cooking oil. Add in the chicken and let cook for 10-15 minutes mixing every few minutes until the chicken is crispy and cooked all the way through (largest piece should reach ~175 degrees internal)
Once the chicken is about done, lower the heat and add in the steamed broccoli along with ~3/4 of the general tso’s sauce. Let cook and continue mixing until the sauce thickens.
Plate it up & ENJOY! 🙌🏻

title: Healthy Baked Apple Fritters "Cookies" (gluten free + dairy free)
description: These Healthy Baked Apple Fritters are soft, cozy, and naturally sweetened with apples and applesauce. Made with oats, oat flour, and warm cinnamon, they’re a gluten-free and dairy-free snack or breakfast your toddler (and you!) will love. Easy to make in one bowl, freezer-friendly, and perfectly sweet without any added sugar.
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped (or shredded) apple (Honeycrisp, Fuji, or Gala are my faves)
½ tsp cinnamon (or measure with your heart!)
1 egg (or flax egg (1 tbsp ground flax + 3 tbsp warm water, let thicken))
1 tbsp oil (melted coconut or avocado oil or butter)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, whisk together the egg (or flax egg), applesauce, vanilla, and oil until smooth.
Stir in oats, oat flour, baking powder, and cinnamon until combined, then fold in the chopped apple.
Scoop 2-3 tablespoons of batter per fritter onto the baking sheet and flatten slightly.
Brush or spray the tops with a little oil and bake for 16-20 minutes, until golden and set.
Let cool slightly before serving. Drizzle with glaze drizzle if desired or pair with yogurt to dip!

title: HEALTHY FUDGY BROWNIES 🍫🍌
description: HEALTHY FUDGY BROWNIES 🍫🍌
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mash bananas until smooth.
Mix in yogurt, peanut butter, egg, maple syrup, and vanilla.
Stir in cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt.
TIP- adding espresso powder brings out the chocolate flavor
Fold in chocolate chips.
Pour into a lined or greased baking dish and top with extra chocolate chips.
Bake for about 25–30 minutes. Don’t overbake if you want them extra fudgy!
Let cool before slicing.

title: Healthy Gluten-Free Greek Yogurt Pancakes
description: if you're looking for thick, fluffy, and flavorful pancakes that are secretly packed with protein and naturally gluten-free, these healthy greek yogurt vanilla pancakes are your new breakfast best friend.
ingredients: 1 cup gluten-free 1:1 baking flour (make sure it includes xanthan gum or add 1/4 tsp if not)
1/4 tsp salt 2 large eggs 1 cup plain greek yogurt (dairy-free or regular)
2 tbsp melted butter or coconut oil (or neutral oil)
1 to 2 tbsp maple syrup (optional, for sweetness)
steps: in a medium bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
in another bowl, mix the greek yogurt, eggs, milk, melted butter, vanilla, and maple syrup until smooth.
pour the dry ingredients into the wet and gently stir until just combined. don't overmix—slightly lumpy batter is okay. let the batter rest for 5–10 minutes to thicken.
heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-low heat and grease lightly.

scoop the batter (about 1/4 cup per pancake) and spread gently if needed. sprinkle cinnamon sugar mixture if desired. cover the pan with a lid and cook for 2–3 max minutes per side, flipping once bubbles form and the edges look set. covering traps steam, which helps the pancakes rise higher and stay super moist and fluffy.
serve warm with fruit, yogurt, nut butter, or maple syrup.

title: Healthy Orange Chicken
description: ✨ 30 Minute Healthy Orange Chicken recipe without all the extra calories and high sodium levels.
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
1/2 tsp baking soda Salt to taste
2 tbsp fresh orange juice 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp ginger, minced To make Orange Sauce
1/4 cup rice vinegar 1 1/2 tbsp chili garlic sauce (optional)
3 tbsp brown sugar Salt to taste
steps: In a medium-size bowl combine all the ingredients under the “to marinate chicken” section and mix it thoroughly and marinate the chicken for at least 10 minutes. In a separate bowl combine orange juice, soy sauce, vinegar, chili garlic sauce, cornstarch, orange zest, garlic, ginger, red chili flakes, brown sugar, and salt. Whisk it until the sugar dissolves and keep the sauce mixture aside. Heat a wide skillet; add oil and once the oil is heated add the marinated chicken pieces to it. Cook on a medium flame for 4-5 minutes and flip the chicken pieces to the next side and cook for 5-6 more minutes until the chicken is cooked perfectly. Stir in the prepared sauce mixture to the skillet and cook the chicken along with the sauce uncovered for 5 minutes. The sauce will start to thicken and everything comes together. In this stage add the sesame seeds and green onions. Serve the orange chicken along with rice and veggies.

title: Healthy Pumpkin Bread
description: In the event that you’re almost ready too, I figured I’d drop my favorite pumpkin bread recipe.
ingredients: 1/4 cup coconut oil, melted and cooled
5 cups flour or 1:1 gluten free flour blend
3/4 tsp baking soda Almond milk (I used about 3 tbsp) Chocolate chips (measure with your heart-l used about 1/3 cup but you can sub for nuts or just forego)
steps: Preheat oven to 350F. Grease and line a loaf pan with parchment paper. Set aside.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs until slightly fluffy (about 2 minutes). Add the remaining wet ingredients and mix until combined.

Stir in the flour, spices, baking powder and baking soda. Mix until combined. At this point, my batter was a little dry because I only had medium sized eggs. If you find it’s not a liquid-y batter (similar to brownie batter), add a few tbsp at a time of your favorite milk and whisk until you reach your desired consistency.
Finally, if using chocolate chips, stir them in. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and top with additional chocolate chips.
Bake in preheated oven for 40-50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out mostly clean. Remove from oven and let cool in the pan for a few minutes before removing and slicing.

title: HEALTHY PUMPKIN LOAF 🎃🍞
description: HEALTHY PUMPKIN LOAF 🎃🍞
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Whisk coconut oil, maple syrup, pumpkin purée and vanilla until smooth. Add the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Pour into a greased or parchment-lined 8 x 4 inch loaf pan and bake for 50-60 minutes. Let cool completely before glazing.
MAPLE GLAZE 🍁 1 cup powdered sugar (@lakanto)
1/4 cup maple syrup
Dash of vanilla extract
Whisk everything together until smooth, adding 1-2 tsp milk or water if needed. Drizzle over the cooled loaf, let set, slice & enjoy!

title: Herby Lemon Garlic Chicken & Rice (with feta & hummus)
description: Herby Lemon Garlic Chicken & Rice (with feta & hummus) 🍋🧄🌱
ingredients: (Serve with rice, extra lemon, feta, parsley & hummus or tzatziki)
steps: Whisk together all marinade ingredients then submerge chicken being sure to coat all sides. Allow to marinate at least an hour (the longer the better.)
Shake off excess marinade and pan fry over medium heat (~6-7 minutes on each side) until internal temp reaches 165°. Remove and allow to rest.

You can also GRILL your chicken but it was too cold for that today 🥶 OR BAKE: shake off excess marinade and place chicken in a baking dish. Bake uncovered at 400° for 20-25 minutes (internal temp 165°)
Prepare your bowl by adding rice and seasoning it with lemon juice, parsley and salt to taste.
Top with chicken and sprinkle with feta cheese and hummus/tzatziki.
Enjoy!

title: High Protein Biscuits
description: Don’t let homemade biscuits intimidate you - these easy high-protein biscuits are incredibly forgiving and perfect for beginners. The quick, no-knead dough bakes up soft and flaky every time, all thanks to the secret ingredient: cottage cheese.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Add the cottage cheese and maple syrup to a high-powered blender and blend until completely smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Cut in the butter. Add the cold grated butter and use a fork to mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.

Add the blended cottage cheese mixture and stir until a dough forms. At first, the dough may look a little rough and shaggy, but this is normal. As you gently fold and pat it, it will come together into a soft, workable dough.

Place the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and gently pat it down into a 1-inch thick round. Fold the dough over itself, then pat it back down into a 1-inch-thick round. Repeat this folding and patting process about 10 times. This helps create flaky, layered biscuits. (Note: It's important to gently pat and not knead or roll.) After the final fold, pat the dough into a 1-inch-thick round and cut out biscuits using either a biscuit cutter or a small circular cookie cutter.

After cutting out the biscuits, gently gather the dough scraps and press them together (do not knead). Pat the dough back into a 1-inch-thick round and cut out additional biscuits. I was able to get about 8 biscuits out of this dough.
Place biscuits on a baking sheet and bake 12–15 minutes, until golden. If desired, immediately brush with melted butter as soon as they come out of the oven.

title: High Protein Breakfast Bites
description: This is the breakfast meal prep we make on repeat.
steps: Cook the sausage, then remove from the pan.
Scramble the eggs in the same pan and season with salt.
Add the cooked sausage and scrambled eggs to a bowl along with the cottage cheese and shredded cheese.
Mix in the flour and the extra egg to bind everything together.
Bake at 375°F for about 18 minutes.

title: High Protein Breakfast Sandwiches
description: Sheet pan high protein breakfast sandwiches 🥯🍳 .
steps: Preheat oven to 350 F 2.Add eggs to bowl and whisk 3.Mix in cottage cheese, sliced pepper, chives and salt 4.Add egg mixture to a sheet pan and bake for 15 mins 5.Build your bagels, spray with olive oil or avocado oil and bake for another 5-8 mins until cheese is melted 6.Eat right away or wrap in aluminum or parchment and store in fridge or freezer.
Reheat when ready to eat! .

title: High Protein Buffalo Chicken Dip
description: HIGH PROTEIN BUFFALO CHICKEN DIP🐓 CALORIES AND MACROS 12 servings (about 1/2 cup per serving) 171 calories 6g fat 5g carb 24g protein INGREDIENTS: - 4 cups Shredded chicken - 2 cup low fat Cottage cheese blended - 1 cup low fat greek yogurt - 1 cup Buffalo sauce - 1 cup Shredded cheese - 1/2 packet
ingredients: 2 cup low fat Cottage cheese blended

Serve with chips or veggie sticks and enjoy! P.S. WE JUST launched our NEW and revamped, “Weight Loss Accelerator” Recipe guide! comment below “recipes” if you want a FREE copy!

title: High protein cottage cheese pancakes
description: High protein cottage cheese pancakes
steps: Start by adding your cottage cheese, eggs, milk to a blender. Blend on medium speed for two minutes.
add your flour and baking powder and mix until combined. Heat up a skillet on medium low heat and add your batter. Top with chocolate chips and flip after 2 minutes
Serve with maple syrup and enjoy!!

title: High Protein Hummus
description: what other flavors should I make?!
ingredients: 15oz can of chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Optional for garnish: drizzle of olive oil, more paprika, or sesame seeds
Blend everything in a blender or food processor. Add water(a little bit at a time) until it’s reached your desired consistency! And more salt & pepper to taste. Enjoy!!

title: High Protein Pancakes
description: No protein powder here, thank goodness!
ingredients: 2 TBS oil for frying Instructions Put all of the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. May need to remove the container and shake to get everything incorporated and blend again.
steps: Preheat a skillet with l oil over medium heat.
Fry the pancakes on each side until golden brown and puffed up in the middle.
About 1-2 minutes per side.
Serve with maple syrup and butter.

title: High-Protein Chicken Alfredo Bake
description: Meals that helped me lose 45 lbs 🤍 Let’s make High-Protein Chicken Alfredo Bake!
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts (or use
1 rotisserie chicken to make this even easier!)
3 Garlic & Herb Laughing Cow cheese wedges
steps: Preheat your oven to 425°F.
Place the chicken breasts on one side of a sheet pan and season with a little salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Add broccoli florets to the pan with a little olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F and the broccoli is tender with lightly crisp edges.
Shred the chicken.
Blend together the cottage cheese, milk, cream cheese, Laughing Cow wedges, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper until smooth.
Cook the Barilla Protein+ pasta according to the package directions and drain.
Add the cooked pasta, shredded chicken, broccoli, and Alfredo sauce to a large baking dish and mix until everything is evenly coated.
Top with the mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes, until hot and bubbly.
Optional: Broil for 2–3 minutes for a golden brown top.
Makes 10 large servings.
Approximate macros (per serving):
✨ 350 calories
💪 41g protein
🍝 29g carbs
🥑 7g fat

title: HIGH-PROTEIN COOKIE DOUGH BANANA BREAD 🍌🍪🍫
description: HIGH-PROTEIN COOKIE DOUGH BANANA BREAD 🍌🍪🍫
ingredients: ¼ cup milk of choice (we used whole milk)
steps: Mix the bananas, eggs, coconut oil, milk, maple syrup, and vanilla extract until smooth. Add the almond flour, FlavCity Banana Bread Protein Powder, baking powder, and salt, then stir until just combined. Fold in the chocolate chips.

Press the cookie dough into an even layer on the bottom of a loaf pan, then pour the banana bread batter over the top. Sprinkle with a few more chocolate chips and bake at 350°F for about 55 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the banana bread comes out mostly clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes before slicing… then enjoy! 🍌🍪🍫

title: High-Protein Egg Biscuits
description: HIGH PROTEIN EGG BISCUITS // a sun-dried tomato version of my viral make-ahead breakfast that’s supports balanced hormones and blood sugar.
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun dried tomatoes (in oil; rinsed and patted dry)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Add 1/2 tablespoon avocado oil, onions, garlic and kale . Let cook until onions are softened and kale has wilted. Stir occasionally.
Whisk eggs until smooth and season with salt and pepper.
Add in the cottage cheese and kale mixture, almond flour, coconut flour and baking powder. Stir until a thick batter forms. Let sit for about 5 minutes.
Scoop batter onto the baking sheet (about 1/4 cup per biscuit). Top with a sprinkle of shredded cheese.
Bake for 18-25 minutes, until golden and firm to the touch. Storage in the fridge for 4-5 days. Reheat of desired.

title: Homemade Crescent Rolls
description: Soft, buttery, and golden — these homemade crescent rolls taste like cozy made from scratch.
steps: Mix warm milk + yeast and let sit until foamy.
Add in the rest, knead until smooth, and let rise for an hour.
Roll into crescents, rise again, and bake at 375°F for 12–15 minutes.
Brush with butter while warm for that soft, bakery-style finish.

title: Homemade Granola Bars
description: Homemade Granola Bars
steps: Mix all the dry ingredients together. In a separate bowl whisk together wet ingredients then add into dry ingredients. Spread out onto a parchment lined baking sheet, not too thin. Spread it to the width of the baking sheet. Bake at 325 for 25 minutes and then let them cool for AT LEAST 1 hour. Cut into squares

title: Homemade Hamburger Helper
description: HOMEMADE HAMBURGER HELPER 🍔 recipe below!
ingredients: 2 cups chicken bone broth (I’m using @Kettle & Fire )
Half a jar of marinara (I’m using @Yo Mama's Foods)
1 box of pasta noodles (I’m using regular @GOODLES, they also have gf ones)
steps: start by dicing your onion and mincing your garlic.
Then heat up a large pot over medium heat, add a drizzle of olive oil and your garlic and onion. Saute until just softened, ~1-2 minutes.
Then add in one pound of ground beef. Break it up til it’s brown you know the drill. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Once the beef is browned, add in your almond milk (or milk of your choosing), chicken bone broth, marinara sauce. Give it a quick mix.

Then add your oregano, dried thyme, dried rosemary. Mix until fully combined then add in your arrowroot starch. Give it another quick mix then bring it to a steady simmer (I raised the heat to medium high)
Add in your noodles and stir every couple minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the noodles are cooked (~10-12 minutes)
Lastly stir in 2 tbsps nutritional yeast and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Then it’s time to plate!!! ENJOY she’s a good one 🤭🤭🤭 @Caraway Home

title: Homemade High Protein Bagels
description: Learn how to make high protein bagels at home with just 5 ingredients! These bagels have a whopping 10 grams of protein per bagel and are made with greek yogurt and baking powder instead of yeast! So quick and easy to meal prep for breakfast throughout the week!
ingredients: 2¼ cups all purpose flour (or bread flour)
Sesame seeds or everything bagel seasoning
steps: PREP: Position a rack in the center of the oven and preheat the oven to 350ºF. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper; set aside.
MIX: In a bowl, whisk the dry ingredients until mixed. Then add the greek yogurt and mix together until a dough forms. You might want to use your hands to make this easier!
DIVIDE: Turn the dough out onto a clean surface. Divide it out into 6 equal pieces. If the dough is sticky dust with flour, I didn’t need to.

ROLL: out the dough into a thick rope, about 7-8 inches in length. Join the ends and gently press. Place your hand through the hole gently roll the joining part on the counter so that the ends fuse. Place the bagels on the prepared baking sheet and let sit for 5-10 minutes if possible. This allows the bagels to puff up more.

BRUSH AND SPRINKLE: On a clean plate, place one bagel, brush with the beaten egg white. Sprinkle with sesame seeds or bagel seasoning. Place the bagel on the baking sheet and repeat with the remaining bagels.

BAKE: Place the pan in the oven and bake the bagels for 20-25 minutes or golden brown on top. Remove the bagels to a wire rack and let them rest for 10 minutes or until cooled so you can slice them. Toast if desired and spread with cream cheese. Store leftover bagels in an airtight container for up to 4 days.

title: Homemade Pizza Rolls (Copycat Totinos)
description: These homemade pizza rolls are the crispy little freezer-snack copycat with all the classic pizza flavors in one bite-sized little pocket. Made with wonton wrappers instead of dough, they cook up extra golden and crunchy in the air fryer while still staying gooey and cheesy on the inside.
ingredients: 2 tbsp softenend cream cheese (or swap with 2 tbsp parmesan and an extra ¼ cup of mozzarella)
steps: In a medium bowl, mix together the shredded mozzarella, finely chopped pepperoni, pizza sauce, softened cream cheese, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning to form a thick filling.

Lay one wonton wrapper on a clean work surface. Lightly brush water around all four outer edges. Then brush one horizontal line and one vertical line through the center of the wrapper to divide the middle into 4 equal filling sections.
Add about 1 teaspoon of filling into each section.
Place a second wonton wrapper on top. Press firmly around all outer edges and around each filling section with your fingers to fully seal the wrappers together.

Use a pizza cutter or knife to slice along the sealed center lines, creating 4 individual pizza rolls. Pinch all cut edges again to make they are sealed tightly. Repeat with the remaining wrappers until you have about 40 pizza rolls total.

Place the pizza rolls in batches in a single layer in an air fryer basket and spray generously with oil. Air fry at 375 degrees F for 6–8 minutes, until golden brown and crispy. *Optional: Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with parmesan cheese and parsley if desired.

title: Homemade Twix Bars
description: not a normal day in the kitchen unless something goes wrong 🫠 homemade “twix” bars 🍫🤭💫 What you’ll need: For the crust: 1 1/2 cups oat flour (blend rolled oats until fine) 1/4 cup melted butter 3 tbsp maple syrup 1 tsp vanilla extract 1/2 tsp salt For the date caramel: 1 cup soft Medjool dates (p
ingredients: For the crust: 1 1/2 cups oat flour (blend rolled oats until fine)
1/2 tsp salt For the date caramel: 1 cup soft Medjool dates (pitted)
1 tsp vanilla extract Pinch of salt For the topping: 1/2 cup unsweetened dark chocolate chips
1 tsp coconut oil Flaky sea salt
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees and line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper.
Mix oat flour, melted butter, maple syrup, vanilla, and salt until a dough forms.
Press evenly into the pan and bake for 10-12 minutes, until edges are lightly golden.
Place in the freezer to cool until you’re done prepping the caramel layer. About 15-20 minutes.
To make the caramel layer, soak dates in hot water for 10 mins, then drain.

Blend the dates, peanut butter, coconut oil, vanilla, and salt in a food processor until smooth. Spread the caramel evenly over the cooled shortbread, then chill in the freezer for 20-30 mins until firm.

Once cooled, it’s time to make the chocolate layer. Melt chocolate and coconut oil together in the microwave in 20-30 second intervals, stirring between each. Once entirely melted, pour over the chilled caramel and spread evenly. Then add a sprinkle of flaky sea salt.
Return to the freezer until set, about 15-20 minutes.
Remove from the pan and slice into small bars. Enjoy immediately! Store in the fridge for up to a week or in the freezer for 1-2 months.

title: Honey & Lime Chicken Burrito Bowls
description: The best recipes of 2025 - 5/10!
ingredients: 20 minutes to make (yes actually) & would also be perfect for meal prep!
steps: Add all the ingredients to a bowl & stir well until all the chicken is fully coated.
Fry off the chicken on a high heat for 5 mins then turn down the heat to medium turn over & cook for another 7 mins until cooked through.
I served mine alongside some rice, salad, guacamole, salsa, sour cream & tortilla chips.

title: HONEY CASHEW CHICKEN
description: HONEY CASHEW CHICKEN
ingredients: 650g chicken breast, cut into very thin strips
1 red bell pepper, cut into chunks
1 green bell pepper, cut into chunks
(optional) spring onions + sesame seeds to serve
steps: Mix all the glaze ingredients together in a small jar or bowl and set aside. Toss the chicken with the soy sauce, then cornflour, pepper and a good pinch of salt.
Heat a drizzle of neutral oil in a large wok or frying pan over high heat. Add the cashews and toast for 2–3 minutes, tossing often, until golden. Remove and set aside.
Re-oil if needed, then add the chicken. It may clump together slightly, so use tongs to separate as it cooks. Fry for 5–6 minutes until golden and cooked through. Remove from the pan.
Re-oil again, then add the onion and cook for 2–3 minutes until starting to soften. Add the peppers and ginger and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes, then add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds.
Return the chicken and cashews to the pan, pour over the glaze and toss everything together until sticky and glossy.
Serve over rice and finish with spring onions + sesame seeds if you like.
ENJOY!

title: Honey Dijon Chicken with Greens
description: Ingredients * 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts (I use thin-cut) * ½ tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * Asparagus, green beans, or broccoli Sauce * ¼ cup chicken broth * ¼ cup Dijon mustard * 3 tbsp honey * 2 tbsp olive oil * 4 cloves garlic, minced or pressed * 1 tsp onion
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts (I use thin-cut)
Asparagus, green beans, or broccoli Sauce
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Place the chicken breasts in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Season both sides with the salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
In a small bowl, whisk together all of the sauce ingredients until smooth. Pour most of the sauce over the chicken, reserving about ¼ cup for later. Coat the chicken evenly.
Cover tightly with foil and bake:
Thin-cut chicken breasts:
20–25 minutes
Regular or thick chicken breasts (or thighs):
30–40 minutes 10-15 min before chicken is done remove from the oven, add the vegetables, and drizzle the reserved sauce over the top.
Return to the oven uncovered for the 10-15 minutes remaining or until the vegetables are tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
Serve with roasted potatoes, rice, or your favorite side. Enjoy!

title: Honey Garlic Chicken
description: Honey Garlic Chicken with Sweet Potato Glass Noodles 😍 honestly it’s insane and I’ve made it 3x since last week lol Bridger is the biggest fan, so I’m adding it into our rotation!
ingredients: 8 oz glass noodles (I use sweet potato glass noodles)
5–2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, trimmed + sliced
1 tsp fresh ginger, grated or chopped
3 cups chopped baby bok choy (or spinach/cabbage)
2 green onions, sliced (plus more for garnish)
¼ cup fresh chopped cilantro + Thai basil (for garnish)
½ tsp red pepper flakes, optional
steps: Cook the noodles according to package directions. Rinse under cold water and set aside. Cooking the noodles first ensures they’re ready to be tossed in at the end without overcooking.
In a small bowl, whisk together all the sauce ingredients until smooth.
Heat avocado oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and sear until golden and cooked through, about 5–6 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

In the same pan, add a bit more oil if needed, then sauté garlic and ginger for 30 seconds. Add carrots, bok choy, and green onions. Cover with a lid and let cook 2–3 minutes until just tender, stirring several times.
Return the chicken to the pan. Pour in the sauce and simmer 1–2 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and toss everything together until glossy and well coated.
Serve hot, topped with extra green onions and sesame seeds if desired.

title: Honey Garlic Chicken Bowls
description: Let’s make Honey Garlic Chicken Bowls 🍯🧄 Perfect over jasmine rice with broccoli for an easy lunch or dinner throughout the week!
ingredients: ½ cup coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
5–6 cloves garlic, minced OR 2 tsp garlic paste
1 tsp sriracha To Thicken the Sauce
steps: Add the chicken breasts directly to the crockpot and season with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and ground ginger.
Pour the coconut aminos or soy sauce, honey, minced garlic or garlic paste, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and sriracha directly over the chicken.
Give everything a quick stir right in the crockpot.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4–5 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
Remove the chicken, cut or shred it, then add it back to the crockpot.
Mix the cornstarch and cold water together until smooth, then pour it into the crockpot and stir everything together.
For a thicker, sticky honey garlic sauce, transfer the chicken and all of the sauce to a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Let it simmer for a few minutes, stirring frequently, until the sauce thickens and gets glossy enough to coat the chicken.
I like to eat this over jasmine rice and broccoli 🤍

title: Honey Garlic Shrimp Bowls
description: honey garlic shrimp bowls 🍤🥦🍯🌶️ recipe below!
ingredients: 1 tbsp arrow root starch (or corn starch)
steps: Start by thawing your pre-cooked shrimp according to package instructions.
While those thaw, we’ll start prepping the sauce. In a bowl, add your sauce ingredients (listed above) and mix until smooth. Set aside for now.
I also started prepping my steamed broccoli & rice during this time, totally optional*

Heat up your skillet over medium heat, add your shrimp in an even layer. Saute about 1 minute then pour your sauce over top. Mix until the shrimp is well coated in the sauce. Then allow it to simmer ~5-6 minutes.
Lastly, stir in 1 tbsp arrowroot starch to fully thicken the sauce. Stir and simmer another 2-3 minutes. Then it’s time to plate!
Add your jasmine rice at the base, top with your honey garlic shrimp and add your steamed broccoli to the side.
Lastly, sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve !!!!!!

title: Honey Glazed Salmon Bowls
description: @kalejunkie HONEY GLAZED SALMON BOWLS WITH PEACH SALSA & CHIPOTLE SAUCE, an easy summer recipe that everyone will love, guaranteed 💯.
steps: First, cut your salmon into cubes and add to a bowl. Toss with the avocado oil, honey, lime, lime zest and seasonings. Transfer to a foil (or parchment paper) lined baking sheet. Broil on high for 8 minutes then remove from oven and set aside. Cook rice and set that aside too. Next, make the peach salsa and chipotle sauce. For the peach salsa, simply chop all of the ingredients and add to a bowl. Toss with the lime and salt. To make the chipotle sauce, add all the ingredients to a small blender and blend until smooth. Finally, assemble your bowls, with the rice on the bottom, the salmon, peach salsa and chipotle sauce. ENJOY!

title: honey mustard chicken tenders 🍯💛😋✨
description: honey mustard chicken tenders 🍯💛😋✨ What you’ll need: For the chicken: 1 ½ lbs chicken tenders 1 ¼ cup panko breadcrumbs ⅓ cup all-purpose flour 1 tsp kosher salt 1/2 tsp black pepper ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 large eggs, beaten ¼ cup milk 2 tbsp hot sauce Avocado oil sp
ingredients: For the chicken: 1 ½ lbs chicken tenders
2 tbsp hot sauce Avocado oil spray For the Honey Mustard Glaze: ¼ cup mayonnaise
¼ tsp salt Freshly cracked black pepper, to taste Optional for serving: Chopped salad kit
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F.
In a shallow wide bowl or plate, mix together the panko, flour, 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder.
In another bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and hot sauce.

Dip each chicken tender into the egg mixture, letting any excess drip off. Then coat in the panko mixture, pressing lightly so it sticks well. Place on a plate or tray and repeat with the remaining tenders. 5.
Lightly spray both sides of the chicken with olive oil spray. Arrange in a single layer in the air fryer, working in batches if needed.
Cook for 15 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden, and the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
For extra color, broil for 2 to 3 minutes at the end, watching closely.
While the chicken cooks, make the honey mustard glaze. In a small bowl, whisk together all glaze ingredients until smooth. Taste and adjust, adding more honey for sweetness or mustard for tang.
Brush on or toss the crispy chicken tenders in the honey mustard glaze.
Serve alongside or over a chopped salad kit. Enjoy!

title: Spicy Honey Mustard Salmon Bowls
description: Colorful, delicious, and surprisingly simple—a new go-to weeknight dinner!
ingredients: 1 jalapeño, seeded, if desired and chopped
2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil and/or parsley
steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 450° F. 2. On a sheet pan, add the salmon, onion powder, garlic powder, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Toss the salmon to coat. Arrange the bacon around the salmon. Bake for 10-15 minutes until the bacon is crispy and the salmon is cooked to your desired doneness. 3. To make the honey mustard. Combine all ingredients in a bowl or glass jar. Taste and adjust the salt. Toss the salmon chunks with honey mustard4. In a skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the garlic and allow the butter to brown around the garlic. Remove and mix in the jalapeño and basil or parsley. 5. Serve the salmon over bowls of lettuce, rice, and dill. Drizzle everything with garlic butter, then add additional honey mustard. Enjoy!

title: Hot Honey Chicken Wraps
description: Let’s make healthy HOT HONEY CHICKEN WRAPS!
ingredients: 1 tbsp white vinegar or lemon juice 🌯Other
steps: Slice the chicken into bite sized pieces. Add to a bowl and toss with 2 tsp olive oil. Mix together the flour and spices, then toss to evenly coat the chicken.
Add chicken to your air fryer basket and spray with olive oil spray. Air fry at 400F for 12 mins or until golden brown. Shake halfway!

While the chicken is in the air fryer whisk together all of the ingredients for the greek yogurt ranch. Add 2 cups coleslaw mix to a bowl and toss in half of the ranch dressing, then save the rest for dipping.
When the chicken is done add it to a bowl and toss in the buffalo sauce, honey and red pepper flakes.
Add the chicken, coleslaw and pickles to the center of the whole wheat wrap. Fold in the sides and roll up. Optional to toast on a hot skillet for a few minutes per side to get it crispy!
Serve with the rest of the ranch and enjoy! 🧡

title: Hot Honey Mustard Bowl
description: Hot honey mustard sweet potato bowl 🍠✨🍯 recipe below!!
ingredients: 1/2 cup @Primal Kitchen Foods dijon mustard Zest of 2 lemons Juice of 2 lemons
1 bag @Whole Foods Market red onion, diced A bunch of fresh parsley, chopped
3 heaping tbsp @FAGE greek yogurt A little shake of feta cheese Seasonings: @Simply Organic onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, pepper, @Graza olive oil, avocado oil
steps: Season chicken with above seasonings minus smoked paprika, brown on both sides in avocado oil on cast iron, then finish baking in oven at 425° until internal temp of chicken reaches 165°. Once finished cooking, let rest for a few minutes then cut into cubes
In a bowl, combine honey, dijon, 1 lemon zest, 1 lemon juice, pepper and big dash of smoked paprika
In same chicken pan, add in hot honey mustard and chicken, stir well making sure to get chicken juices off the bottom of the pan, coat evenly, bring to a boil, then simmer until sticky
Coat sweet potatoes with olive oil, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, pepper
Bake sweet potatoes in oven at 425° until soft and golden brown

Add yogurt, 1 lemon juice and 1 lemon zest, honey, onion powder, and pepper to a bowl and stir until combined. Then, add in onion, parsley, feta, and coleslaw and stir until evenly coated and combined
Assemble sweet potato bowl and top with additional hot honey mustard, feta, and parsley
Enjoy 😚

title: Hot Honey Mustard Salad
description: Ep 1 of FEEL GOOD BOWLS SERIES 🎬 HOT HONEY MUSTARD & FETA CHOPPED CHICKEN SALAD ✨ Chopped vegetables, roasted chickpeas, sautéed chicken, fresh herbs, avocado and feta, all tossed in a Hot Honey Mustard dressing.
ingredients: 1 of FEEL GOOD BOWLS SERIES 🎬 HOT HONEY MUSTARD & FETA CHOPPED CHICKEN SALAD ✨ Chopped vegetables, roasted chickpeas, sautéed chicken, fresh herbs, avocado and feta, all tossed in a Hot Honey Mustard dressing. Everything you need for a healthy and delicious bowl this week!
1/4-1/2 tsp cayenne pepper (reduce if spice averse)
steps: Preheat oven to 400F. Transfer the chickpeas to a baking sheet and toss in olive oil and a pinch of salt. Roast for 25-30 minutes until browned and crisp. With 3-4 minutes remaining, add the shredded Brussels on top to soften slightly.

Meanwhile pat the chicken breasts dry and season with olive oil, paprika, cumin, salt and pepper. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Transfer chicken to the skillet and cook undisturbed for 8-10 minutes, flip and cook another 6-8 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165F. Remove and set aside to rest.
Next make the dressing by combining all ingredients in a blender or whisking vigorously until creamy and combined. Add more water if it gets too thick.

Dice the chicken then assemble the salad with all salad ingredients except the avocado. Toss in the dressing until fully coated. Add the avocado on top then serve, topping with a squeeze of lemon juice and additional feta and herbs if desired.

title: HOT HONEY SHRIMP + MANGO AVOCADO SALAD
description: HOT HONEY SHRIMP + MANGO AVOCADO SALAD took less than 20min + has ~55g protein 😮‍💨 • 200g thawed raw peeled shrimp (seasoned with drizzle hot honey, 1 tbsp chili oil, juice of 1/2 lime, 1 tsp each chili + cumin powder, salt&pep to taste) • 1/2 cup cooked quinoa • 1 mango • 1/2 avocado • 1/8 red onio
ingredients: 200g thawed raw peeled shrimp (seasoned with drizzle hot honey, 1 tbsp chili oil, juice of 1/2 lime, 1 tsp each chili + cumin powder, salt&pep to taste)
steps: Top with lime, cilantro & hot honey

title: How to make homemade cosmic brownies! 🍫✨
description: How to make homemade cosmic brownies!
ingredients: ¾ cup (95g) all-purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) Ganache Frosting: ¾ cup (130g) semisweet chocolate chips or chopped chocolate
¼ cup (60g) heavy cream Rainbow candy chips
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F (163°C) and line/grease an 8x8-inch pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, mix until well combined. Stir in cocoa powder and salt. Then, gently fold in the flour and cornstarch until just combined (don’t over mix). Spread batter into the prepared pan. Bake for 30-40 minutes until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out mostly clean/with a few moist crumbs (not wet batter). Let the brownies cool completely. To make the ganache, melt the chocolate and heavy cream together. Microwave in 15-second intervals, stirring in between until smooth. Pour over the cooled brownies and top with rainbow candy coated chips.
Chill until ganache is set (1-2 hours). Enjoy!

title: Instant Chocolate Chia Pudding
description: INSTANT chocolate chia pudding with 50g of protein!!
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain or vanilla greek yogurt
1 serving promix chocolate or vanilla protein powder (discount code
Sliced strawberries & mini dark chocolate chips for topping optional!
steps: Add chia seeds and hot water to a bowl
Mix for about 30 seconds until the chia seeds gel up
Stir in Greek yogurt and protein powder until smooth
Add toppings and enjoy!

title: Italian Penicillin Soup
description: My Nana’s Italian penicillin soup!!
ingredients: 10 cups water (or 4 cups chicken stock, 6 cups water)
1 tbsp if you’re using chicken broth)
5 cloves garlic (or however many you want, really can’t go wrong)
optional: a couple sprigs of thyme & rosemary (we had leftover from thanksgiving so threw them in)
optional: 1 tsp Italian Bomba sauce from TJs (Calabrian chili paste)
pastina, cooked (I cook mine separately and pour broth over, but you could cook it in the soup if you want)
shredded cooked chicken (I used rotisserie chicken, no skin)
juice of 1 lemon (or half if you don’t like things as lemon-y, but this and the garlic really help if you’re sick) TOPPINGS:
steps: in a large stock pot, add water/broth, all the veggies (give them a rough chop, doesn’t need to be small cus we’re going to blend them), chili paste, herbs and bring to a boil once boiling, cover and bring down to low heat until veggies (mostly carrots) are tender (about 20 mins)

while that’s going, cook your pastina to the directions on the box using a slotted spoon, remove the carrots/onions/celery/garlic, and 1 tsp of chicken bouillon and put in a blender with 1-2 cups of broth and blend until smooth remove the herbs from the pot and set aside, you won’t need those once smooth, add it back into the large pot and combine add in chicken, lemon juice
I’m a serving bowl, put a dollop of pesto, then a mound of pastina, then ladle the broth on top.

top with Fresh shaved parm, chopped parsley and black pepper and enjoy! NOTES: if your broth ever gets too salty, just add more water. Or if it’s not salty enough, add more Bouillon taste as you go and adjust to your preferences!

title: Jalapeño Cheddar Biscuits
description: tarting off 2025 with a new high-protein breakfast biscuit flavor!!
ingredients: 2025 with a new high-protein breakfast biscuit flavor!! these biscuits are easily one of my most popular recipes, they’re easy to mix together & freeze well for meal prep—can’t wait for you to try this jalapeño cheddar version!! 🫑🧀 ✨full recipe is below & on my website✨ if you want a meal prep plan with recipes + grocery list for the entire month of January, that’s on my substack now! ingredients:
1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese, divided (sub DF cheese)
12oz jar sliced jalapeños in vinegar, drained & chopped
steps: Preheat oven to 400F and line a baking sheet with parchment. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium, then add the onion and cook for 5 to 7 min, stirring until translucent. Clear the center of the pan and add in the chicken. Cook, stirring constantly, until the chicken is cooked through, 7 to 10 min. Set aside to cool down and drain any excess liquid. Whisk the eggs in a bowl, then add 1 cup of the cheddar cheese, the cooled chicken and onion mixture, and the jalapeños. Mix, then add the almond flour, coconut flour, baking powder, and spices and mix until just combined. Use a large cookie scoop or spoon to make 12-14 evenly sized balls and place them on the baking sheet. Rub oil in your hands and shape each into a biscuit shape by pressing down lightly on the tops. Cover the tops of each with the remaining cheddar cheese. Bake for 13 to 16 min, until the biscuits are firm and starting to brown on the outside. Remove and cool completely on the baking sheet. Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 4 days or freezer for a month. I like to reheat these from the fridge in the air fryer on 325F for ~5 minutes, or 10-12 minutes from frozen! enjoyy💕

title: Jalapeño Chicken!
description: Jalapeño Chicken!
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs (cut into bite-sized pieces)
Cornstarch (enough to coat the chicken—about 3–4 tbsp)
2–3 tbsp avocado oil (or any cooking oil)
4 fresh jalapeños, sliced (1 per pound of chicken—adjust to taste) Sauce:
steps: In a large bowl, season the chicken with black pepper, garlic salt, and a generous sprinkle of cornstarch. Toss until evenly coated.

Heat avocado oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken in batches, making sure not to overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden and cooked through. Set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
In a separate bowl, whisk together brown sugar, soy sauce, water, and minced garlic. Set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté sliced onions and jalapeños until the onions are translucent.
Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the sauce, and stir to coat everything evenly.
Let the sauce simmer for a few minutes until it thickens up and coats the chicken nicely.
Serve hot over white rice!

title: Kale Caesar Pasta Salad
description: Pasta caesar salad with kale and crispy roasted chickpeas! What could be better?
ingredients: 8oz pasta, cooked according to package directions (I use Fusilli Bucati Corti)
1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese (omit for vegan)
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Drain & rinse the can of chickpeas and then place on a baking pan between two paper towels. Roll the chickpeas in the paper towels and remove as much water as possible. Some of the skins will come off the chickpeas, discard the skins. (This will make the chickpeas crispier!) Drizzle olive oil, smoked paprika and sea salt on the chickpeas mixing with your hands or a spoon until evenly coated. Bake for 30-40 minutes.
blend the olive oil, lemon juice, tahini, dijon mustard, garlic, nutritional yeast, salt, pepper and water in a blender until smooth.
Mix the Salad: Add the pasta, kale, chickpeas, parmesan cheese and dressing to a bowl and mix to combine. Serve and enjoy!

title: King Ranch Chicken Soup
description: King Ranch Chicken Soup Creamy, cheesy, and packed with shredded chicken, peppers, corn, and plenty of Tex-Mex flavor.
ingredients: 1 shredded rotisserie chicken OR 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cooked and shredded
½ cup all-purpose flour (use less if you like a thinner soup)
1 (10 oz) can fire-roasted tomatoes with diced green chiles, undrained
1 cup shredded Mexican-blend cheese Better Than Bouillon, to taste, optional for extra flavor Salt & pepper, to taste
For Serving Sour cream Tortilla strips Diced avocado Fresh lime Tajín
steps: Melt the butter in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced onion and jalapeños and cook for 4–5 minutes, until softened.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir until well combined. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in the chili powder, garlic powder, cumin, and paprika.

Slowly pour in 4 cups of chicken broth, whisking as you go to create a smooth, thick base. Add Better Than Bouillon to taste for an extra boost of flavor. Add an additional cup of chicken broth if you like a thinner soup base.
Add the undrained fire-roasted tomatoes and green chiles, drained corn, and shredded chicken. Stir everything together and bring to a gentle simmer. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and creamy.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in 1 cup of shredded Mexican-blend cheese until melted and creamy.
Ladle into bowls and top with sour cream, tortilla strips, avocado, a squeeze of fresh lime, and a sprinkle of Tajín. Serve warm and enjoy!

title: KOREAN BEEF BOWLS
description: This lands on the table in 20 minutes from the time you start to preheat your pan.
ingredients: 20 minutes from the time you start to preheat your pan. Crispy, salty beef and a sticky, savoury sauce that clings to every bite. The salad comes together in seconds and has a cool kick that compliments the hot beef perfectly. Place it all on a bed of rice, add your favourite toppings and dinner is served.
steps: Preheat a large skillet to screaming hot. Put on your rice 1 cup of rice to 2 cups of chicken stock. Add avocado oil to pan and then ground beef. Break it up with a large spoon and let it sit to brown and crisp. Meanwhile put the sauce together by grating garlic and ginger into a small bowl then add the rest of the ingredients and stir to combine. Once beef is crisped on one side, flip over to the other side to crisp. Once it is crispy on all sides, add sauce and stir to thicken. Cut cucumbers into thin slices and toss with rice vinegar, red pepper flakes, salt and pepper. Place rice, saucy beef and cucumber salad in a bowl the top with pickled onions, green onions and sesame seeds.

title: LASAGNA SOUP
description: LASAGNA SOUP ingredients:
steps: In a big pot, on medium- low heat, add in your butter. Sauté your onion until translucent & toss in your garlic. Once garlic is fragrant, add in your ground beef.
Season your ground beef & cook until browned. Add in your 2 tbsp of tomato paste. Mix with your beef with tomato paste & cook for 3-4 mins before adding in your marinara sauce.
Once marinara comes to a simmer, add in your beef broth. Bring heat to med-high. Once your meat sauce comes to boil add in your lasagna pieces. Cover & let it cook for 6-7 mins

Toss in your heavy cream, with Parmesan & mozzarella cheese. Follow that with a second round of the same seasonings (a little less than before). Mix before adding in your fresh parsley & fresh basil. Cover for another 5 mins, let it simmer on low.
For ricotta mixture: in a small bowl add 2 parts ricotta, 1 part mozzarella & Parmesan. Add in fresh basil. Mix.
Serve your lasagna soup with ricotta mixture, garnish with parsley & Parmesan
Enjoy :)

title: Lasagna Stuffed Zucchini Boats
description: lasagna stuffed zuchinni boats on repeat 🕺 recipe below
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F.

In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the ground beef. Add the salt, pepper, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, and red pepper flakes. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the beef is browned and cooked through.
Stir in half of the marinara sauce. Remove from the heat and set aside.
In a medium bowl, combine the ricotta, spinach, Parmesan cheese, egg, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Spread the remaining marinara sauce in the bottom of a large casserole dish. Arrange the zucchini halves in the dish.

Fill each zucchini boat with a generous spoonful of the ricotta mixture, then top with t he meat sauce. Use any remaining ricotta mixture on top of the zucchini boats. Sprinkle the mozzarella evenly over the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the zucchini is tender and the cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Lemon Parmesan One-Pan Pasta
description: This yummy easy one-pan pasta that's delicately delicious, full of lemony white wine flavor, tons of garlic and parmesan and topped with slices of tender juicy chicken breasts. Perfect for an easy weeknight, you'll love how quick and simple this recipe is to make.
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts (pounded to an even 1/4 inch thick)
1-2 tablespoons cajun seasoning or all-purpose chicken seasoning (use your favorite)
3/4 cups dry white wine (sauv blanc, chard, or pinot grigio)
3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice + zest of one lemon
1 cup half and half, room temp
salt and pepper to taste (about 1/2 tsp of each)
steps: Season chicken liberally on both sides. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook undisturbed for 3-4 minutes.
Flip just once, immediately add 1/3 cup chicken stock, reduce heat to simmer and cover pan, allow to cook 5 more minutes. Remove chicken and set aside on a plate tented with foil.
Melt the butter over medium heat into the same skillet (some leftover chicken stock in the pan is fine). Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add salt and pepper.

Add in 3/4 cup white wine and cook 2 minutes to allow it to reduce slightly. Then add 3/4 cup chicken stock and 3 tablespoons lemon juice. Slowly pour in the half and half then bring to a gentle boil. Add the pasta into the pan, breaking in half if needed or allow them to heat so you can bend them into the pan using tongs.
Allow pasta to simmer for 4-5 minutes, stirring frequently, then reduce heat to low and continue to simmer until pasta is al dente.
Add the parmesan gradually, reserving some for serving. The sauce will continue to thicken as the dish sits.
Sprinkle with fresh parsley, lemon zest, red pepper flakes. Toss well and serve with sliced chicken and parmesan on top.

title: Lemon Ricotta Meatballs
description: How have I never tried this combo until now??
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. In a large bowl, mixed together, ground chicken, ricotta cheese, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic powder, salt, Italian seasoning, Parmesan, lemon zest, and parsley. (I forgot to add the parsley to my meatballs 😔)
Roll your chicken mixture into meatballs and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bacon in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 165°.
While the meatballs are cooking, boil your chicken broth. Once the broth is boiling, add in your orzo and cook according to package instructions.
Heat some olive oil in a pan and cook your spinach. Once the orzo is done cooking, add the cooked orzo to your pan and mix with the spinach.
Plate orzo, and add meatballs along with fresh parsley, parm and a slice of fresh lemon.

title: Loaded Chicken Burger Boats
description: loaded chicken burger sweet potato boats!!
ingredients: 1 tsp each of onion powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, & paprika
steps: Start by preheating your oven to 400 degrees.
Poke holes with a fork into the sweet potato. Place in the microwave for 2 minutes. This will allow the cutting process to be much easier.

Once out of the microwave slice the sweet potato into 1-inch thick slices lengthwise. I can usually get about 4-5 slices out of one sweet potato. Add to a baking sheet, spray with some avocado oil, and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Place in the oven for 20-25 minutes until they can easily be pierced with a fork.
While the sweet potatoes are cooking prep the chicken mixture. Add the ground chicken to a pan on medium heat and cook about 5-7 minutes until brown.
Add in the chicken seasoning along with 3 tbsp of the chicken sauce. Mix until well incorperated and set aside.

Once the sweet potatoes are out, place a few spoonfuls of the chicken mixture onto the sweet potato slices. Top each piece with cheddar cheese and place back in the oven for about 5 minutes until the cheese has melted.
Top with shredded lettuce, diced white onion, dill pickles, sesame seeds, and a drizzle of chosen foods chicken sauce. Enjoy!

title: Loaded Hashbrown Breakfast Bake 🍳
description: Loaded Hashbrown Breakfast Bake 🍳
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Place the bacon on a sheet pan and bake for ~15 minutes. Remove from the oven, chop, and set aside.
Reduce oven to 375°F and grease a 9×13 baking dish with oil. Allow the hash browns to thaw if still frozen.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion, bell peppers, salt, and pepper and sauté for 3–5 minutes, until softened.
Push the vegetables to the sides of the pan and add the breakfast sausage to the center. Cook until browned & mix everything together
Whisk together the eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt and pepper.

Spread the thawed hash browns evenly in the prepared baking dish. Top with the sausage & pepper mixture, then pour the egg mixture evenly over the top. Add shredded cheddar cheese and the chopped bacon.
Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes. Remove the foil and continue baking for another 20–25 minutes, until the eggs are set and the top is golden.
Garnish with sliced green onions and enjoy!

TO MAKE AHEAD: After step 6, cover with foil and place in the refrigerator overnight (up to 24 hours). Remove from the fridge 20 minutes before baking to bring to room temperature, then bake covered for 30 minutes and uncovered for 30 minutes

title: Making a super easy & affordable crockpot meal!
description: Making a super easy & affordable crockpot meal!
ingredients: 8 chicken drumsticks Buffalo Wild Wing’s Parmesan Garlic Sauce
steps: Start by washing and prepping the veggies. Cut the potatoes in half and chop an onion. Snap the ends off of the green beans.
Add the potatoes, green beans, onion, and minced garlic to the crockpot. Season with Heath Riles Garlic Butter Seasoning. Stir everything well and top with a a few pats of butter.

Add the chicken drumsticks to a bowl and season well with the Garlic Butter Seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to the chicken to coat it. Stir well and place the chicken drumsticks in the crockpot.
Cook on low for 7-8 hours. Once everything is cooked, top with shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!

title: Maple Dijon Chicken with Sweet Potatoes 🍠🍯🍁
description: Maple Dijon Chicken with Sweet Potatoes 🍠🍯🍁 Sweet potatoes: •1-2 sweet potatoes depending on size •1 can garbanzo beans •olive oil •seasoned with smoked paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper Chicken: •7-8 chicken tenders •1 tbsp olive oil •2 tbsp Dijon •3 tbsp pure maple syrup •2 ts
ingredients: seasoned with smoked paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper Chicken:
avocado and wild rice to put to the side if you’d like. Some goat or feta cheese would be yummy too
steps: Preheat your oven to 425°F. In a large bowl, mix together your sweet potatoes and chickpeas with the olive oil and seasonings. Pour onto your cookie sheet and bake for 20 minutes while you make the chicken.

In the same bowl, add your chicken along with the rest of the ingredients. Mix. Take out the sweet potatoes and chickpeas after 20 minutes, and make space in the middle for the chicken. Once you’ve added the chicken, put it back in the oven for roughly 15 more minutes. Then I like to broil it for a couple minutes.

title: Marry Me Chicken Orzo
description: This Marry Me Chicken Orzo is a treat of a one pot pasta recipe - super simple and takes just 30 minutes to make. All the flavours of our favourite Tuscan inspired chicken dish, made into a complete dinner.
ingredients: 650 g Chicken breast (Skinless and boneless. Chopped)
1 tbsp Olive oil (Or oil from sun dried tomatoes jar)
650 ml Hot chicken stock (Made with a stock cube (bouillon cube))
150 ml Double cream (heavy cream (US/CAN) or (AUS) thickened cream)
steps: Fry the chicken: In a large, deep frying pan, heat the oil over a medium heat. When it's hot, carefully add the chicken pieces. Cook for 5 minutes stirring occasionally until all sides are starting to colour.
Garlic, tomatoes and herbs go in: Reduce the heat and add the garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, oregano and paprika. Stir for 3-5 minutes until the garlic is softened.
Pasta and stock in, then simmer: Add the orzo, stock, and some pepper and give everything a good stir and put the lid on. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the orzo is almost cooked.

Reduce heat, time for spinach and cream: Turn the heat to the lowest setting add the spinach and cream and stir very well for 1-3 minutes until the spinach is wilted and the cream is heated through. Check the chicken is cooked through.
To serve: Turn off the heat and stir in the parmesan.

title: Marry Me Pasta
description: Marry Me Chicken Pasta 💍 This recipe is such a crowd-pleaser and it only takes about 30min.
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh parmesan (plus more to garnish)
steps: Fresh basil, torn, to taste
In a large sauce pan, heat about 1 T of sun-dried tomato oil and 1 T butter over medium heat. Cook your chicken until no longer pink and set aside. Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Reduce heat to low and add in another T of butter along with your shallot and seasonings. Cook for 2-3 minutes (add in some olive oil if needed). Add in your garlic and cook for another minute.

Pour in your chicken broth, scraping up any brown bits on the bottom of the pan. Bring to a simmer, add in your pasta, and stir. Cover and simmer until al dente, about 10-15 minutes, stirring every few minutes.
Once your pasta is done, add in your half & half, sun-dried tomatoes, and parmesan. Stir until melted.
Add in your spinach, cooked chicken, and basil. Stir until spinach is wilted. Serve immediately and top with more fresh parm. Enjoy!

title: Meal Prep Chicken Enchilada
description: Meal Prep Chicken Enchilada
ingredients: 3 cups shredded cooked chicken (rotisserie or slow-cooked)
1 1/2 cups shredded cheese, plus extra for topping
8 small flour or corn tortillas, cut into halves or quarters
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Make the filling – Mix shredded chicken, Greek yogurt, 1 ½ cups cheese, green chiles, and taco seasoning in a bowl.
Assemble the lasagna layers in meal prep containers (or a large baking dish):
Layer a portion of the chicken mixture in each dish top with tortilla and enchilada sauce
Repeat layers until all ingredients are used, ending with tortillas, sauce, and extra cheese on top.
Bake – Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes, then uncover and bake for 5 more minutes until cheese is melted.
Cool & Store – Let cool before sealing in four meal prep containers. Refrigerate for up to 4 days. Optional top with cilantro, a little plain Greek yogurt and jalapeños
To Serve:
Reheat in the microwave for 1–2 minutes.
