title: Million Dollar Ravioli
description: This Million Dollar Ravioli is a rich and hearty baked ravioli casserole layered with seasoned ground beef meat sauce, tender cheese ravioli, and a homemade Parmesan cream sauce all topped with bubbly melted mozzarella.
ingredients: Salt and Black Pepper to taste
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the ground beef and onions. Cook until the beef is browned and no longer pink, then drain the grease. Season with onion powder, garlic powder, and chicken bouillon powder. Stir in the pasta sauce and let it simmer for a few minutes before setting aside.

In another skillet over low heat, melt the butter. Whisk in the heavy whipping cream and bring to a gentle simmer. Slowly add the Parmesan cheese in small handfuls, stirring well after each addition until the sauce is creamy and smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste, then let the sauce cool slightly.

Spread a layer of meat sauce into a 7x11 baking dish. Layer ravioli over the sauce, then add a layer of cream sauce. Repeat the layering process one more time and finish with meat sauce on top. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese evenly over the dish. Cover and bake at 350°F for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 10 minutes, then broil on high for 2–3 minutes until golden brown on top. Serve warm and enjoy!

title: Million Dollar Spaghetti
description: Million Dollar Spaghetti!!
ingredients: 1 cup asiago cheese, shredded (or substitute with an additional cup of parmesan)
steps: Cook pasta.
Brown beef with onion and bell pepper, season with Britscookin Garlic & Herb, and mix with spaghetti sauce.
Make alfredo sauce by melting butter, adding garlic and cream, then stirring in parmesan and asiago (or more parmesan if substituting).
Combine cooked pasta with alfredo sauce in a casserole dish, top with meat mixture, and sprinkle mozzarella.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes. Garnish with parsley if desired.

title: Miso Ginger Roast
description: MISO & GINGER CHUCK ROAST (GF / DF) ✨ Reposting my viral miso & ginger chuck roast because you all loved it so much the first time I shared!
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck roast, cut into thirds
1 tbsp plus 1 tsp rice wine vinegar
3 tbsp fresh ginger (3 inches), finely grated
Note: If using a Dutch oven or roasting pan with aluminum foil you will need to add
1 cup beef bone broth to your pot before roasting. If using a roasting pan with a cover you can omit.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F.
Combine tamari, miso, honey, vinegar, garlic, ginger and red pepper flakes in a small bowl and whisk well to combine.
Pour over your beef and toss to coat evenly.

Add meat to your roasting dish, cover and roast for 3 hours then remove from the oven and check for doneness. If meat pulls apart easily, shred into large chunks and toss in juices. If it does not pull apart easily, return it to the oven covered for 30 more minutes.
Once meat has been shredded, increase oven temperature to 450°F and return to the oven uncovered to finish cooking for 15 minutes longer until the top layer of meat is crispy.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion.

title: MOM’S MEXICAN PIZZA!
description: MOM’S MEXICAN PIZZA!
ingredients: Store-bought pizza dough OR premade pizza crust
1 can Rotel diced tomatoes + green chiles, drained
Shredded cheddar or Colby Jack cheese
steps: Prepare pizza dough/crust according to package directions.
Spread a thin layer of cream cheese over the crust.
Top with drained Rotel.
Sprinkle about 1/3 of the taco seasoning over top.
Add about half the black beans and half the corn (or more if you want!).
Sprinkle the remaining taco seasoning over everything.
Top generously with shredded cheese.

Bake according to your pizza dough/crust directions until the crust is cooked and the cheese is bubbly mine took about 10 minutes but I used @George Cookware which makes it faster! SO easy + so good!! 🌮🍕

title: My mom’s Fiesta Salad!
description: My mom’s Fiesta Salad!🌮 My favorite childhood weeknight meal my mom would fix!
ingredients: A couple big handfuls of tortilla chips
steps: Prepare the meat sauce by browning ground beef with the onion. Drain.
Add in beans and French dressing. Let simmer for a minute and remove from heat.
In a large bowl add the shredded lettuce. Then pour over the meat sauce.
Add the cheese, chips, and toss.
Serve immediately!

title: No Chop Just Dump and Bake Queso Chicken Bake
description: no chop just dump and bake.
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) low sodium beans
1 cup low fat shredded mozzarella/colby whatever
¾ cup Good Culture low fat cottage cheese
steps: In an oven-safe pan, combine rice, bone broth, salsa, seasoning, beans, and shredded chicken. Mix to combine.
Top with shredded mozzarella, cover tightly, and bake at 375°F for 45 55minutes.
While it bakes, blend cottage cheese and queso together until smooth — that’s your high protein queso.

Once rice is cooked through, remove from oven, drizzle queso on top, and dig in. MACROS PER 1 CUP SERVING (~10 servings): I prob had 2 cups for a serving lol 🔥 ~324 calories- 26g protein- 36g net carbs 7g fiber 6g fat

title: No-Bake Chocolate Chip Cookie Peanut Butter Pie
description: This fun no-bake layered dessert combines chocolate chip cookies with layers of peanut butter cream cheese and chocolate pudding.
sourceName: The Salty Cooker – Flavorful, Simple Recipes for Everyday Cooking
ingredients: 3 cups chocolate chip cookies ((crumbled; plus more for topping))
steps: Roughly crumble the chocolate chip cookies and spread onto the bottom of your 7x10-inch dish.
Pour the melted butter over the top of the chocolate chip cookies.
In a mixing bowl, add your peanut butter, powdered sugar, 1/4 cup milk, and cream cheese. Mix until light and creamy, and the ingredients are combined.
Spread the peanut butter cream cheese mixture over top of the cookies.
Mix the chocolate pudding according to the package directions, reducing the milk by 1/2 cup. If using dairy-free milk, use the mixer on high speed to help it set.
Pour the chocolate pudding over the top of the peanut butter layer.
Spread the whipped topping over the top of the chocolate pudding.
Allow the dessert to chill, then add crumbled cookies on top. Enjoy!

title: Noodle-less Chicken Pad Thai
description: NOODLE-LESS CHICKEN PAD THAI 🍋‍🟩🌶️ recipe below!
ingredients: 1 bag power slaw or broccoli slaw
1/4 cup peanut butter (not over processed, we want the peanut butter to be runny)
steps: in a skillet over medium heat, add a tiny splash of avocado oil and 3 eggs. Quickly scramble then set aside on a plate.

In the same skillet, add another splash of avocado oil, add in 1 pound of cubed chicken breast. Season with sea salt. Stir and cook about 4-5 minutes. (You don’t have to cook fully, it will continue to cook in the pan)
Then add in your thinly sliced red pepper, yellow onion, 1 bag of power slaw/ broccoli slaw, shredded carrots, and minced garlic.
The pan will feel super full, but Stir every couple minutes until veggies are cooked down. ~10-12 minutes total.
While that cooks, we will make the sauce super quick. Add all sauce ingredients into a bowl and whisk until smooth. (Listed above) set aside for now.
Roughly chop about 5-6 green onions, then add into the pan with the sautéing veggies. Add your scrambled eggs and sauce into the pan. Stir until everything is well coated in the sauce.

title: Old Fashioned Pot Roast Recipe Without Wine
description: This simple Old Fashioned Pot Roast Recipe Without Wine is made in the slow cooker and is melt-in-your-mouth tender. It is a classic comfort food that is perfect for Sunday dinner and will become a family favorite.
ingredients: 3.5-4 pounds boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 2 pieces
2 cups beef broth or beef stock
1 pound whole carrots, peeled & cut on a bias into 2-3 inch pieces
steps: In a small bowl, combine the salt, brown sugar, and pepper. Rub and pat the spice mixture on all sides of each piece of the roast.

In a large pot or skillet, heat the olive oil over medium high heat. Sear one piece of the roast at a time on all sides until dark brown. Place seared meat into the slow cooker. Reduce to medium heat.
Add the onions to the remaining oil in the pot and sauté for 2-3 minutes, scraping any brown bits off the bottom of the pan. Add these to the slow cooker.

Add the garlic, Italian seasoning, paprika, worcestershire, and soy sauce to the slow cooker. In a liquid measuring cup or small bowl, whisk together the broth and cornstarch. Pour the mixture over the roast, onions, and spices. The top of the roast will not be covered.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6-7 hours or HIGH for 3.5-4 hours.
Add the potatoes and carrots. Use the back of a spoon to press them into the broth so they are mostly covered in liquid.
Cover and cook for an ADDITIONAL 3 hours on LOW or 1.5 hours on HIGH. (If you prefer softer veggies, see notes below.)
Remove the roast and shred it into large pieces. Place on a serving platter with the pan juices. Use a slotted spoon to remove the veggies.

title: One Pan Lemon Pepper Yogurt Chicken and Rice
description: Marinated chicken and rice made in one pan, even the rice...simply mix, bake, eat, and enjoy!
ingredients: 6 chicken thighs or breasts ((skin on or off) )
1- teaspoons black pepper, using more to your taste
steps: 1. In a bowl, toss together the chicken, olive oil, yogurt, lemon zest, garlic, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and a good pinch of salt and chili flakes (if desired). If time allows, marinate for 30 minutes or overnight.2. Preheat the oven to 400°. 3. Pour the rice and broccoli into a 9x13-inch baking dish. Pour over 2 cups of water. Add the butter. Arrange the chicken over the rice and broccoli. Add lemon wedges, if desired. Bake 30-40 minutes, until the rice is fluffy and the chicken is cooked through. If the rice is hard, add 1/3 cup water and cook for an additional 10 minutes. 4. Serve the chicken, rice, and broccoli topped with fresh basil and or thyme. And enjoy!

title: One Pot Chicken Broccoli Cheddar Orzo
description: If you love broccoli cheddar soup, this one pot chicken broccoli cheddar orzo is the perfect way to soft launch soup season for all of you who are craving fall!🍂🍁 One Pot Chicken Broccoli Cheddar Orzo
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
8 oz cheddar cheese, freshly grated Seasonings: Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Salt Black pepper
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and season with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper to taste.
Cook until the chicken is fully cooked, then remove it from the pot and set aside.
Melt the butter in the same pot.
Add the diced onion and grated carrot, and cook for about 5 minutes, or until softened.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Season to taste.
Pour in the chicken stock, then stir in the orzo and chicken bouillon.
Bring to a boil and cook uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the chopped broccoli, cover, and cook for another 5 minutes.
Return the cooked chicken to the pot.
Stir in the heavy cream and shredded cheddar cheese until smooth and creamy.
Cover and cook over low heat for about 5 more minutes, or until the orzo is tender.
Stir, serve, and enjoy!

title: One Skillet Lasagna Pasta
description: One Skillet Lasagna Pasta All the classic flavors of lasagna in an easy, one-pan meal that's ready in 30 minutes!
ingredients: 1 tsp each Italian seasoning, dried parsley, garlic powder, and dried basil
1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, for topping For the Lasagna Topping:
½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese Parsley, salt, and pepper, to taste
steps: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the ground beef and diced onion until the beef is browned and the onion is softened. Drain any excess grease if needed.
Stir in the Italian seasoning, parsley, garlic powder, basil, salt, pepper, and tomato paste. Cook for 1-2 minutes
Pour in the chicken broth, marinara sauce, and heavy cream. Stir well to combine.

Add the uncooked fusilli pasta and bring the mixture to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook according to the pasta package directions, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender. Add additional broth if needed.
While the pasta cooks, combine the ricotta cheese, ½ cup mozzarella cheese, parsley, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Once the pasta is cooked, top the skillet with the remaining 1 cup of mozzarella cheese. Add dollops of the ricotta mixture over the top.
Cover the skillet for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Garnish with additional parsley if desired and serve warm.

title: One-pan Korean-style Beef Noodles
description: These One-pan Korean-style Beef Noodles combine minced (ground) beef, ramen noodles and a creamy gochujang sauce in an easy family dinner that's ready in just 20 minutes. Everything cooks in the one pan for minimal washing up, making it perfect for busy weeknights when you want something a little different from the usual mince rotation.
ingredients: 2 tbsp gochujang (see note 1 for spice levels and subs)
250 ml coconut milk (see note 2 for substitutions)
3 x 85 g (3 oz) bundles of ramen noodles, or any other instant noodle packets, flavouring sachets discarded (see note 3 for more details)
2 spring onions (scallions), finely sliced, plus extra to serve
steps: Make the sauce – Combine the sauce ingredients in a small bowl or jug. Whisk to combine, then set aside.

Cook the beef mince – Heat the oil in a large heavy-based pan with a lid over medium–high heat. Add the beef mince, break it up with a spatula and leave it undisturbed for 4–5 minutes until it begins to caramelise. Flip it over and continue cooking for a further 3–4 minutes until cooked through.
Add the garlic and ginger – Add the garlic and ginger and cook, stirring, for 60 seconds.
Stir in the tomato paste – Stir through the tomato paste.
Add the sauce – Add the sauce, stir and cook for 60 seconds until slightly thickened.

Add the coconut milk and noodles – Stir through the coconut milk, then add the noodles to the pan, followed immediately by the water. The noodles won't be completely submerged in the liquid and that is okay. Try and nestle them in so they are as submerged as possible with their tops exposed.
Place the lid on – Cover and cook for 2 minutes. Uncover, turn the noodle bundles over using tongs and cover again. Cook for 1 minute.

Uncover and add the spring onion – Uncover the pan, give the noodles another toss with tongs to absorb the sauce (they will continue to absorb the sauce as they sit). Add the spring onion and toss with tongs for 60 seconds or until the spring onion is well distributed. (See note 4 for sauce thickness.)
Serve – Serve the noodles divided among four bowls, topped with extra spring onion, sesame seeds, sliced cucumbers and chilli oil, if using.

title: One-Pan Sesame Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, (trimmed of excess fat)
3/4 cup finely diced yellow onion ((from about 1 small onion))
1 cup white jasmine rice, (rinsed well and drained)
6 green onions, (thinly sliced on the diagonal, white and green parts separated)
1/4 cup tamari or low-sodium soy sauce
steps: Preheat the oven to 350℉.
Pat the chicken dry and season all over with salt and pepper.

In a large oven-safe skillet with a tight-fitting lid, heat the oil over medium-high heat. When hot, add the chicken in a single layer, working in batches as needed to avoid overcrowding, and cook until golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside. The chicken does not need to be fully cooked through as it will continue to cook in the oven.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the onions. Cook, stirring, until the onions are softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, and rice, and continue to cook, stirring, toasting the rice until fragrant and lightly browned, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the broth and the white parts of the green onions and bring to a simmer, 3 to 5 minutes.

In a small bowl, whisk together the tamari, toasted sesame oil, rice vinegar, and honey. Nestle the chicken back into the skillet, then drizzle the tamari mixture over the tops of the chicken. Cover, carefully transfer to the oven, and bake for 25 minutes. Carefully uncover the skillet and continue baking until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through, 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove from the oven and fluff the rice with a fork. Garnish with the green parts of the onion and sesame seeds.

title: One-Pot Buffalo Chicken
description: one pot meal prep — buffalo chicken edition 👏🏼 (& as always tastes good reheated) full recipe below 🤍 One-Pot Buffalo Chicken & Rice - 16 oz shredded rotisserie chicken* - 3 celery stalks, finely chopped - 1/3 cup shredded carrots - 1/2 medium red onion, chopped - 2 tsp olive oil - 3 garlic cloves,
ingredients: 2/3 cup buffalo sauce (can use more or less based on personal preference)
1 cup rice of choice (I used jasmine)
Salt, pepper, & garlic powder to taste
steps: In a large pan over medium heat, add olive oil, celery, carrots, onion, and garlic and cook for about 3-5 minutes or until veggies are slightly softened. Add chicken, buffalo sauce, and ranch seasoning. Mix well until all ingredients are well combined.

Then add rice, bone broth, and half & half. Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and cook for 20 minutes or until rice is cooked and liquid is absorbed. Once rice is done, stir in cheddar cheese and top with green onions. Enjoy!

I find rotisserie chicken reheats much better than other chicken, so would highly recommend using this if possible! I use a hand mixer to shred & it’s super easy ☺️ This will make 4-5 servings depending on portion size!

title: ONE-POT PESTO CHICKEN & ORZO
description: Another easy one-pot meal prep that tastes good reheated!!
ingredients: 5 links chicken sausage, sliced (I use @Bilinski's Chicken Sausage or @Amylu Foods )
~1/4-1/3 cup pesto — I eyeball this! (I like the @SAUZ Basil Jalapeño)
Salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste
steps: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet or pot over medium heat. Add the chopped shallot & garlic and cook 2–3 minutes until softened. Add the sliced chicken sausage and cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned.

Stir in the dry orzo. Pour in the bone broth and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover. Let simmer for 10-15 minutes or until all bone broth is absorbed and orzo is cooked.
While that’s cooking grate your parmesan and slice tomatoes. Once orzo is done, stir in desired amount of pesto, along with parmesan and tomatoes. Add to meal prep containers and enjoy!

title: orange chicken 🍊🍚🍽️
description: orange chicken 🍊🍚🍽️ what you’ll need:
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs (cut into bite-sized pieces)
1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper
1 egg, beaten For the orange sauce
1/2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water For the garnish Toasted sesame seeds Sliced green onions Red pepper flakes
steps: Heat a large pan over medium heat and add a few tablespoons of oil.
Add the cubed chicken, cornstarch, flour, seasoning, and the beaten egg in a large ziplock bag or Tupperware. Seal it tightly with a lid and shake really well until the chicken is well coated.

Once the oil is hot, add the chicken in a single layer (you may need to work in batches). Cook for 4-5 minutes per side, turning occasionally, until the chicken is fully cooked and golden brown and crispy.
Meanwhile, make the orange sauce. Add all the sauce ingredients to a bowl and whisk really well until fully combined.

Once the chicken is cooked, lower the heat to medium-low and pour the sauce directly into the pan with the chicken. Toss everything together and let it simmer for 2-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Remove from the heat and serve immediately with rice and your choice of veggie. Top with toasted sesame seeds and sliced green onion. Enjoy!

title: Oreo Cheesecake Cups
description: high-protein oreo cheesecake cup recipe below🤍
steps: To a blender add your greek yogurt, cottage cheese, maple syrup, vanilla and salt. Add your oreo cookies and blend until smooth. In a small bowl add crushed oreo to the bottom and pour the cheesecake mixture over it. Melt your chocolate and coconut together in microwave or on the stove and pour over your cheesecake. Pop in the freezer for 15-20 minutes and enjoy!

title: Overnight Ham & Cheese Croissant Casserole
description: Overnight Ham & Cheese Croissant Casserole 🥐🧀 Recipe below and on sammymotgoms.com ⬇️ Ingredients * 8 medium sized croissants cut in half, slightly dry * 6 eggs * 1 cup heavy cream * 10 large pieces ham roughly chopped (around 200 grams) * 2 cups sharp white cheddar shredded (around 250 grams) * 1 t
ingredients: 8 medium sized croissants cut in half, slightly dry
confectioners' sugar aka powdered sugar, optional for dusting
Begin by lightly spraying your baking dish with a neutral cooking oil.
steps: Slice the ham into bite-sized pieces, or simply fold multiple times. Distribute the ham and cheese across the croissants, aiming to tuck the pieces into the nooks and crevices between the croissant pieces. Gently lift a few croissant pieces to sneak fillings underneath. This step does not need to look perfect—it just ensures every bite has filling.
Next in a medium sized bowl whisk together the eggs, cream, dijon mustard, onion powder, dried thyme, black pepper and pinch of salt.

Pour the egg mixture evenly over the top of the croissants. Ensure the liquid covers all the tops of the croissants, but it does not need to be fully submerged. If you notice a few dry spots, take a cooking brush and lightly brush the tops of the drier croissants with any excess egg mixture from the dish.
Cover with aluminum foil and chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour or overnight.

Preheat the oven to 350 °F. Bake the ham and cheese croissant casserole (covered) for 20 to 25 minutes. Carefully remove the aluminum foil and continue baking for another 10 to 15 minutes, or until the cheese begins to bubble and it has achieved a beautiful golden-brown top layer.
Lest rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Dust with powdered sugar and a drizzle of honey.

title: PB&J Protein Muffins
description: These soft, protein-rich muffins bring the nostalgic flavor of peanut butter and jelly into a toddler-friendly snack. Made with simple ingredients like banana, Greek yogurt, oat flour, and a swirl of strawberry jam, they’re naturally sweet and filling. Perfect for busy mornings or packed lunches, they store well and freeze beautifully.
ingredients: 1/2 cup oat flour ((just blend rolled oats))
steps: Preheat oven to 350 F (175 C).
Line or grease a mini muffin tin.
In a bowl, mash the banana.
Whisk in egg, peanut butter, greek yogurt, and vanilla until smooth.
Add in oat flour and baking powder, and stir until just combined.
Scoop batter into muffin cups, each about 3/4 full.
Drop about 1/3 tsp strawberry jam on top of each muffin, and swirl gently with a toothpick.
Bake for 14-16 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool completely before serving to toddlers!

title: PCOS Breakfast Cake
description: LET THEM EAT CAKE 🎂
ingredients: 6am, eyes still half-crusted over, my kids are fighting…I don’t have the bandwidth to even think up what I’m going to make before all
4 of us get out the door by 7:30. I can reheat, eat, and GO. This brekkie cake keeps me full for hours, and we love her for that
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F
Grab 4 oven-proof baking dishes and add to each:

1 egg, 2 Tbsp Greek yogurt, 1/4 c self-rising flour, 2 Tbsp rolled oats, pinch cinnamon, pinch sea salt, 3 Tbsp whole milk, splash vanilla. Stir. Drizzle in a little maple syrup, and top with a few berries.
Bake 30 mins, then top with more Greek yogurt and maple syrup.
Makes 4 servings:
336 calories, 20G protein, 45G net carbs, 4G fiber, 7G fat
Would you try this?

title: Peach Cobbler Overnight Oats
description: the PERFECT summer oats 🙌🏼 literally can’t wait for breakfast in the morning
ingredients: Pinch of sea salt, cinnamon & nutmeg
Toppings: crushed graham crackers, pecans, etc
2 cubed peaches, 1-2 tsp of butter, a splash of maple syrup, and a dash of cinnamon
steps: Stir occasionally until peaches soften and mixture thickens (5-10 minutes).
Remove from heat and let cool slightly before adding to oats!

title: Peaches & Cream Baked Oats
description: Peaches & Cream Baked Oats for the PCOS gal who’s always on the run but still wants a hormone-nourishing brekkie 💅🏼🍑🥥✨
ingredients: 4 scoop vanilla protein (I love my VITA-PCOS protein)
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees and grease 4 ramekins.

Blend all ingredients (except mix-ins) and pour into 4 equal portions inside ramekins. Divide peach slice mix-ins equally among ramekins (reserving a few for the topping) and stir gently. Top with reserved peach slices and bake 20 mins. These make great make-ahead meal prepped brekkies for eating on the go!
Makes 4 servings: 346 calories, 20 G protein, 13 G fat, 12 G fiber, 28 G net carbs
Save + share with all your gals & pals!!🍑✨

title: peanut butter chocolate crunch ice cream cups!! 🧸
description: peanut butter chocolate crunch ice cream cups!!
ingredients: 1 cup chocolate chips (I’m using hu gems)
1 cup rice crisps (I’m using the real cereal brand)
steps: sea salt

Start by making date caramel on the stove top. Let your butter melt in your pan for 1 minute before adding dates. Let the dates soften on medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes until they melt together and place in a bowl.
Mix the rice pops, peanut butter, and maple syrup. you and add more maple syrup as you mix if you’d like it sweeter. Set aside.
Melt the chocolate and fill the bottom of each muffin tin. Once filled, gently rotate the muffin tins to coat the inside walls of each tin.
Place the peanut butter crisps in the bottom, top with coco whip, date caramel, another chocolate layer, and sea salt. Freeze for 3 hours.
Thaw for 2 min and devour 🫶🏼

title: Peanut Butter Oat Bowl
description: Can not stop making this super healthy and filling breakfast
steps: Mix all ingredients except berries and peanut butter
Microwave for 2 min Mix
Add optional splash milk and non nutritive sweetener if desired
Top with berries and peanut butter
Nutrition 410 cal- 21g protein-16g fat (unsaturated)
15 g fiber- 22 g net carbs

title: Peanut Butter Oreo Cheesecake Trifle
description: Peanut Butter Oreo Cheesecake Trifle
ingredients: For the Pudding: 1 3.9oz box instant chocolate pudding
2 cups (480ml) cold whole milk For the Peanut Butter Cheesecake Mousse: 8oz (226g) full-fat cream cheese, softened
For the Homemade Whipped Cream: 1 cup (240ml) cold heavy whipping cream
For layering: 1 family size package Oreos, 3½ cups coarsely crushed and the rest cut in half @OREO
steps: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the instant chocolate pudding and cold milk until smooth and refrigerate for 5 minutes to thicken. If it’s overly lumpy, you can hit it with an immersion blender until smooth.

In a large bowl, beat cream cheese, powdered sugar, peanut butter, salt, and vanilla until smooth. Beat heavy cream until medium peaks form. Gently fold into cream cheese mixture until smooth. It will look separated at first, just keep folding until it comes together.
Spoon ½ cup of chocolate pudding into the bottom of a 3 quart trifle bowl. Arrange halved Oreos around the inside edge of the bowl, then sprinkle 1 cup of crushed Oreos over the pudding.
Spread ⅓ of the peanut butter cheesecake mousse over the Oreos.

Top with half of the pudding. Repeat with another of layer of halved Oreos, crushed Oreos, ⅓ of the peanut butter cheesecake mousse, and the remaining pudding. Finish with crushed Oreos and the final third of the peanut butter cheesecake mousse.
Cover the trifle bowl refrigerate for at least 8 hours, preferably overnight.
Just before serving, make the whipped cream by beating all ingredients until medium peaks form. Spread over the top and sprinkle remaining crushed Oreos on top.
Keep refrigerated and enjoy! @KitchenAid

title: Peanut Butter Pretzel Pie
description: Raise your hand if @nicolemcmom just listed all your favorite things!
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped peanut butter cups and coated peanut butter candies, such as Reese’s Pieces®, or as needed for topping
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (180 degrees C). Stir pretzels, sugar, and melted butter together and press lightly into a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven just until fragrant, about 10 minutes. Let cool to room temperature, about 20 minutes.
Beat cream cheese, peanut butter, confectioner’s sugar, and vanilla together with an electric mixer until well blended, light, and fluffy. Fold in 2 1/2 cups whipped topping.
Spread peanut butter mixture evenly over cooled crust.
Whisk together chocolate pudding mix and milk until smooth, well combined, and slightly thickened.
Carefully spread chocolate pudding mixture over peanut butter layer, taking care not to mix layers together. Top with remaining whipped topping.
Sprinkle with chopped candies and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
🧑‍🍳: @nicolemcmom

title: Peanut Butter Sheet Cake
description: This Peanut Butter Sheet Cake is so decadent in flavor and unbelievably easy to make. In only an hour, this dessert is ready from start to finish to serve to a crowd. Watch out, we guarantee there will be no leftovers!
ingredients: 1/3 cup neutral oil (canola, vegetable or avocado)
steps: Preheat oven to 350Â°F. Grease a 15x10-inch sheet pan with butter or nonstick spray.
In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine peanut butter, water, butter, and oil. Bring to a boil, then turn off the heat.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together self rising flour and sugar. Add the hot peanut butter mixture, and mix until smooth.
In a small bowl, whisk together eggs, buttermilk and vanilla extract. Add this mixture to the peanut butter mixture, and stir just until combined.

Pour the batter into the prepared sheet pan, spreading evenly. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out with a few moist crumbs. Allow the cake to cool at least 20 minutes before adding the frosting.

For the frosting, in a medium saucepan, combine milk, peanut butter, and vanilla. Once melted and fully combined, turn off the heat and stir in powdered sugar until smooth. Spread on the slightly cooled cake. Slice and serve.

title: Pineapple Coconut Margarita
description: Pineapple Coconut Margarita 🍍 INGREDIENTS: 2 oz tequila 2 oz pineapple juice 1/2 oz lime juice 3/4 oz cream of coconut
steps: Brush the side of your glass with cream of coconut, then sprinkle with shredded coconut.
Place glass in the freezer to set.
Add tequila, pineapple juice, lime juice and cream of coconut to a cocktail shaker.
Add ice, then shake until chilled.
Strain into prepped glass.
Garnish with a piece of pineapple, and enjoy!

title: Pot Roast Gyros
description: These gyros are simple - nothing fancy, but such delicious flavors...a quick, fun, delicious, and different weeknight meal!
ingredients: pickled red onion, lettuce, and herbs for serving
steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 325° F.2. Arrange the onions, shallots, and garlic, in the bottom of a large, oven-safe Dutch oven.3. In a bowl, mix the paprika, cumin, oregano, thyme, cayenne, and season with 2 teaspoons of salt. Place the roast on the onions, then rub all over with the spice mix. Pour over the beer and lemon juice. Add 1/3 cup water. Cover and roast for 3 to 4 hours or until very tender.4. Crank the heat on the oven up to 425° F. Uncover and cook for 10 minutes, until deeply caramelized on top. Remove the meat from the pot and shred it using two forks.5. Simmer the remaining sauce left in the pot with the butter, until just barely reduced. Toss the beef with the sauce. 6. Stuff the beef and onions into warmed pitas with tzatziki. Then add lettuce, red onions, and herbs. Drizzle over more tzatziki. YUM! Enjoy!

1. Arrange the onions, shallots, and garlic, in the bowl of the crockpot.2. In a bowl, mix the paprika, cumin, oregano, thyme, and cayenne, and season with 2 teaspoons of salt. Place the roast on the onions and rub all over with the spice mix. Pour over the beer and lemon juice. Cover and cook on LOW for 5-6 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours.3. Remove the meat from the pot and shred it using two forks.4. Crank the heat on the crockpot to HIGH and cook the remaining sauce with the butter until just barely reduced. Toss the beef with the sauce. 5. Stuff the beef and onions into warmed pitas with tzatziki. Then add lettuce, red onions, and herbs. Drizzle over more tzatziki. YUM! Enjoy!

title: Pot roast 😋 on repeat all fall and winter
description: Pot roast 😋 on repeat all fall and winter
steps: Add 1 tbsp olive oil and sear the roast on all sides, remove, and add:
1 yellow onion, diced 5 cloves of garlic, minced 2 tbsp tomato paste 1 cup dry red wine
Add the roast back in and add:
2 cups beef broth 2 bay leaves
Fresh thyme
Bake at 300 for 2 hours covered After 2 hours, remove the bay leaves and thyme, then add:
3 carrots, chopped 3 celery stalks, chopped 1 1/2 lbs baby potatoes, washed 2 whole cloves of garlic
Cover, bake at 300 for 1 hour Remove the potatoes and garlic, combine with:
1 tbsp butter 1/4 cups whipped cream cheese 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1/4 cup grated Parmesan 1/3 cup milk Salt and pepper to taste
Shred the meat and add cornstarch slurry (1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp cold water) Enjoy💗🍂

title: Protein Blueberry Muffins
description: Let’s make Protein Blueberry Muffins!
steps: Preheat your oven to 350°F and line or lightly grease a muffin pan.
In a large bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, applesauce, maple syrup, eggs, and vanilla extract until smooth.
In a separate bowl, combine the oat flour, protein powder, baking powder, and baking soda.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and gently mix until just combined.
Add in the blueberries.
Divide the batter into the muffin cups.
Bake for 18–20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Store in the fridge for an easy grab-and-go breakfast or snack all week! 🫐💙

title: Protein Breakfast Biscuits
description: High Protein Breakfast Biscuits - Bacon & Habanero Cheddar 1 1/2 cups almond flour 4 eggs 3 tbsp greek yogurt 6 strips uncured bacon, cooked and diced 1 1/4 cup shredded cheddar (I like to use habanero cheddar) 1/4 cup green onion, sliced 2 tsp baking powder 1/2 tsp baking soda 1 tsp garlic powder 1
ingredients: 6 strips uncured bacon, cooked and diced 1 1/4 cup shredded cheddar (I like to use habanero cheddar)
steps: Preheat oven to 400F. Prepare a large baking sheet greased with avocado oil.

In a large bowl, whisk the almond flour, baking powder and soda, garlic and onion powder, salt and pepper. In a small bowl, beat the eggs and greek yogurt. Fold the egg mixture, bacon, green onions and 1 cup of cheddar into the dry ingredients until well combined and mixture begins to thicken. Using a cookie scoop, scoop 8 balls of dough and transfer to the baking sheet. Gently press down each ball to form a biscuit and top with remaining cheddar. Bake for 9-11 minutes until the biscuits are baked through and lightly browned all over. Serve with butter or cottage cheese and avocado!

title: Protein Breakfast Buns
description: High Protein Breakfast Buns recipe⬇️ Makes 4 Buns Ingredients: Self-Rising Flour: 1 ½ cups flour 2 ¼ tsp baking powder ½ tsp salt Bun Dough: 1 cup ‘self-rising flour’ 1 cup Greek yogurt Filling: Scrambled eggs (I used 3 eggs) Cooked sausage Shredded cheese Toppings: 1 egg + 1 tbsp water Everything B
ingredients: ½ tsp salt Bun Dough: 1 cup ‘self-rising flour’
1 cup Greek yogurt Filling: Scrambled eggs (I used
3 eggs) Cooked sausage Shredded cheese Toppings: 1 egg + 1 tbsp water Everything Bagel Seasoning Shredded cheese
steps: Preheat oven to 350F Prepare the self rising flour first, then add 1 cup of it to a bowl along with 1 cup of Greek yogurt.
Use a spatula to mix the dough and slowly add more of the self-rising flour 1 tbsp at a time until the dough is incorporated and doesn’t stick to the bottom/sides of the bowl.
Flour a flat, even surface then place the dough and divide it into 4 equal parts.
Next gently roll and press the dough balls out to make 4 flat even circles making sure they are not too thin or too thick, about ¼ inch thick.
Fill the center of each with a heaping spoonful of scrambled eggs, cooked sausage, and shredded cheese.
Then bring the edges of the dough together and pinch, sealing the filling inside.
Place them, seal side down, on a parchment paper lined baking sheet.

Then in a separate bowl, crack an egg and add 1 tbsp water, whisk that together and gently brush the buns with the egg wash, top with more shredded cheese, and sprinkle with the Everything Bagel Seasoning.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the dough looks golden brown.
Remove from oven, cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes and enjoy!
Leftovers can be refrigerated for up to 3 days and reheated in the oven.

title: Protein Cookie
description: Guys these are SO good!!!
ingredients: 8g protein powder (I use Equip, code VEDA to save)
steps: Cinnamon
Sea salt Directions
Mash banana and mix all ingredients in a bowl
Transfer to baking sheet and cook in oven for 13-15 mins on 350

title: Protein Mac and Cheese
description: Sneakyyyy protein and nutrients in your mac & cheese >>
ingredients: 5 ingredients + it's protein and nutrient packed thanks to bone broth!!
1 cup mini choo choo wheel pasta
steps: WHAT TO DO:
Melt the butter in a skillet and add the pasta. Cook for a few minutes until most of the butter is absorbed.
Add the bone broth and cook until the pasta is al dente and all of the liquid is about 80% absorbed.
Stir in the heavy cream. Add in the cheese and stir until fully melted and mixed in before scooping into bowls and serving.

title: Protein McGriddle Bites
description: High Protein McGriddle Bites
ingredients: 2 cups protein pancake mix 1 1/2 cups water
steps: Preheat oven to 400.
Brown ground sausage. Mix all ingredients.
Grease a muffin tin and fill with the mixture. Drizzle with lite maple syrup. Bake for 10-15 minutes and enjoy! I like to dip mine in maple syrup.
Note: Let them cool before taking them out! They will be a little sticky.

title: pumpkin banana protein muffins
description: pumpkin banana protein muffins recipe below 🧡 sharing one of my favorite versions of my classic banana protein muffins again!!!
steps: Preheat oven to 350F. Mash bananas in a bowl and add all wet ingredients. Mix, but don’t over mix, until combined.

Add your oats to a blender and blend to make oat flour. Pour into the banana mix along with all the other dry ingredients. Mix (again don’t over mix!) until just combined. Add chocolate chips and fold into batter.
Scoop batter into a prepared muffin tin and top with more chocolate chips. Pop into the oven for 14-18 minutes until baked through. Enjoy!

title: Cream Cheese Swirled Cinnamon Pumpkin Butter Bread
description: Enjoy warm right out of the oven with a smear of salted honey butter. Perfect for all the autumn weekends ahead!
ingredients: 1 cup canned pumpkin puree ((not pumpkin pie filling))
3/4 cup melted coconut oil ((or melted butter) )
1/2 cup maple syrup ((use 3/4 cup for a sweeter loaf))
4 tablespoons salted butter, at room temperature
steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350° F. Butter 2 (9x5 inch) bread pans.2. In a large mixing bowl, stir together the pumpkin butter, pumpkin, coconut oil, maple syrup, eggs, and vanilla until combined. Add the flour, baking powder, baking soda, pumpkin pie spice, and salt, mix until just combined. Divide half the batter evenly between the prepared bread pans.3. Spoon teaspoon size amounts of the cream cheese over the batter, using 4 ounces of cream cheese per bread pan. Gently swirl the cream cheese using a sharp paring knife. Sprinkle 2-4 tablespoon of cinnamon sugar over each pan, then evenly spoon the remaining batter over each bread pan, it's OK if all the cream cheese is not covered. Sprinkle 2-4 tablespoons cinnamon sugar over each pan. 4. Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the center is just set.5. Meanwhile, make the honey butter. In a small bowl, combine the butter, honey, and a pinch of salt.6. Remove the bread and let cool on a rack, or enjoy warm with extra honey butter.

title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: the fall cookie of your dreams just dropped 🍁 these pumpkin chocolate chip cookies are chewy, soft, perfectly spiced, and loaded with chocolate.
ingredients: ⅓ cup pumpkin puree, drained and squeezed (should end with ¼ cup)
⅔ cup semi-sweet chocolate chips (or ⅓ cup each of regular and mini chips), plus more for rolling on the outside if you feel like it!
steps: In a large bowl, combine melted butter, brown sugar, and squeezed pumpkin.
(To drain pumpkin puree, wrap in a strong paper towel and gently squeeze to remove excess liquid. You should end up with ¼ cup). Mix to combine.
Add egg yolk and vanilla; mix well.
Add flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Stir until no streaks of flour remain.
Fold in chocolate chips (I did half mini, half regular for fun), and scoop cookies into 1½ oz balls. Roll cookies in more chips if you feel like it!
Cover and chill dough for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Place cookies 2 inches apart on prepared baking sheet and bake until edges are set and centers are soft, 9 to 10 minutes. Cookies should be set around the edges but still slightly soft in the middles. Let cool on cookie sheet before serving.

title: Pumpkin Honey Bun Cake
description: Pumpkin Honey Bun Cake 🍂 Ingredients • 1 box yellow cake mix • ½ cup vegetable oil • 4 eggs • ½ cup pumpkin purée • ½ cup sour cream • 2 tsp pumpkin pie spice Filling • 1 cup brown sugar • 2 tsp cinnamon Maple Glaze • 2 cups powdered sugar • 4 tbsp milk • 2 tsp maple syrup (I used maple s
ingredients: 2 tsp maple syrup (I used maple syrup, but you can use maple extract if you have it)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 baking dish.
Mix cake mix, oil, eggs, pumpkin purée, sour cream, and pumpkin pie spice until smooth.
Pour half the batter into the dish. Sprinkle filling (brown sugar + cinnamon) evenly over top, then cover with remaining batter.
Bake 35–40 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Whisk glaze ingredients together and pour over the warm cake. Let it soak in before slicing.

title: PUMPKIN STREUSEL MUFFINS
description: My Fall baking series: 🎃 PUMPKIN STREUSEL MUFFINS🍁 These are soft, fluffy, easy and piled HIGH with streusel.
steps: Mix the streusel ingredients until chunky crumbs form. Whisk the dry muffin ingredients together in one bowl and the wet ingredients in another. Fold the wet into the dry JUST until combined. Don’t overmix! 🔥 Bake at 425°F for 5 minutes, then WITHOUT opening the oven, reduce the temperature to 350°F and bake another

title: Pumpkin-Shaped Treats
description: Homemade Pumpkin-Shaped Reese’s Ingredients • 2 tbsp softened butter • 1 ½ tbsp creamy peanut butter • 2 tbsp coconut sugar • 1 tbsp powdered sugar • Pinch of salt • Melting chocolate (dark, milk, or semi-sweet) Instructions 1.
steps: Melting chocolate (dark, milk, or semi-sweet) Instructions
Make the filling
Beat together butter, peanut butter, coconut sugar, powdered sugar, and salt until smooth.
Chill for 10–15 minutes until slightly firm.
Chocolate shell
Melt chocolate in the microwave (30 seconds at a time, stirring) or over a double boiler.
Spoon a thin layer into silicone molds (pumpkin molds if available).
Fill & cover
Roll the peanut butter mixture into small balls and place into the chocolate-coated molds.
Cover with more melted chocolate to seal.
Set
Refrigerate or freeze for 30–45 minutes until firm.

title: Quick and healthy banana and raspberry pancakes
description: These banana and raspberry pancakes are a perfect go-to for busy parents looking to whip up something quick, healthy, and toddler-approved. Made with familiar ingredients like ripe bananas, fresh raspberries, an egg, and blended oats, these pancakes are both nutrient-packed and naturally sweet.
sourceName: Ashleigh Cooks - Simple, healthy family recipes for baby, toddler, mum and dad.
steps: Mash your banana and raspberries in a bowl.
Blend your oats in a blender until it resembles flour.
Add your oat flour and an egg to your mashed fruit.
Heat a pan over medium heat and cook your pancakes in a small amount of oil or butter. Use a tablespoon to make your pancakes.
Allow to cool slightly before serving. Enjoy!

title: QUINOA CRUNCH SALAD with GINGER PEANUT DRESSING
description: QUINOA CRUNCH SALAD with GINGER PEANUT DRESSING✨ This salad is loaded with protein and fiber from the chicken, bone broth quinoa, edamame, and cabbage.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sea salt Ginger Peanut Dressing: 1/3 cup avocado oil
steps: Preheat your oven to 350ºF.
In a medium bowl, toss the peanuts, avocado oil, sesame oil, sriracha, coconut sugar, and salt together.
Spread out on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Roast for 15-18 minutes, flipping halfway through (checking often in the last 5 minutes to ensure they don’t burn).
They should be a deep golden brown when they are done.
They will crisp up as they cool.
Add the quinoa, bone broth, and a pinch of salt to a small saucepan over high heat.
Bring to a boil.
Once boiling, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 20 minutes or until most of the liquid has been absorbed.
Keep it covered and let it rest for a few minutes then fluff with a fork.
While the quinoa and cashews are cooking, whisk together the dressing ingredients in a small bowl.
Assemble the salad by adding the cabbage, bell pepper, cucumber, edamame, green onion, cilantro, chicken, quinoa, and peanuts to a bowl.
Toss with the dressing.
Enjoy!

title: Raspberry Cheesecake Cups
description: RASPBERRY CHEESECAKE CUPS- 48g of protein.
ingredients: 2 tsp maple syrup (add more to taste)
steps: Combine the cheesecake batter ingredients into a blender.
Lightly coat a ramekin with coconut oil & pour in the batter.
Place in the oven at 375F for 18- 20 minutes (broil for 1 min to make the top golden brown)
While the cheesecake is in the oven, combine the jam ingredients into a saucepan & mix on medium heat for 5 minutes.
Put a layer of jam onto the cheesecake and cool in the fridge for 20 minutes.
Add your favorite toppings & enjoy!

title: Red, White, & Blue Berry Mini Muffins
description: Red, White, & Blue Berry 🍓🫐 Mini Muffins // Just in time to celebrate America 🇺🇸 these red, white, and blue BERRY mini muffins are snack time favorite and this viral recipe using Greek yogurt will have you skipping the Little Bites at the store and making them at home.
steps: In a bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, baking soda, and baking powder. In a separate bowl, whisk together the greek yogurt, maple syrup, eggs, vanilla, and oil. Add the dry ingredients to the wet, and mix together until combined. Add blueberries and strawberries to batter and fold to combine. Use a mini muffin pan and spray with cooking oil spray (avocado, coconut, etc.) and divide batter using a tablespoon portion. Bake the muffins at 350F 15-18 minutes. Store in the fridge for up to a week!

title: Reese’s hearts
description: High-protein & low-sugar Reese’s hearts for Valentine’s Day❤️‍🔥
ingredients: 1/3 cup vanilla protein powder (I use @flavcity code: CALLA)
Roll into a ball and place on a parchment paper lined tray and slightly flatten. Set in the freezer
30 min Using a cookie cutter, cut out mini hearts (or you can form by hand or just roll into balls). Set back in the freezer for 30 min
Melt chocolate chips + coconut oil in the microwave in
30 second intervals, stirring between each. Can also use double boiler
steps: Dip each heart into melted chocolate, top with flakey sea salt, and place back in the freezer to set.
Enjoy! 💘🍫

title: Salmon Sheet Pan Dinner
description: welcome to day 9 of 10 days of high protein meals!!
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon filets (remove skin if desired), 4 filets
juice of 1 lemon, for topping for the yogurt sauce:
1/2 teaspoon kosher salt for the potatoes and artichokes:
steps: Combine the olive oil, salt, garlic powder, oregano, and chili powder in a small bowl and set aside. Add the salmon filets to a large, flat container. Cover the filets with the oil and spice mixture. Use clean hands to gently rub the spices into the salmon. Top each filet with the chopped dill and parsley. Flip each filet facedown, then secure the cover on the container and chill for at least 20 minutes and up to 12 hours. While the salmon marinates, prepare the sauce: in a jar with a lid, mix together the yogurt, lemon juice, dill, parsley, and salt until well combined. Cover and chill until serving. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 400F and line a large sheet pan with parchment paper.

Toss the potatoes in the olive oil, salt, oregano, chili powder, and garlic powder in a large bowl. Transfer to the sheet pan and bake until tender to a fork and beginning to crisp on the outside, 20 to 15 minutes. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and push the potatoes to one side of the pan. Add the marinated salmon to the pan skin side down. Add the artichoke hearts to the marinade container and mix to coat in the remaining marinade. Add the artichokes to the sheet pan (if your sheet pan is too small, artichokes can be cooked on a separate pan) and bake until salmon is cooked to an internal temperature of 145F, 10-16 minutes, depending on your preference. Remove from the oven and squeeze the lemon juice overtop the salmon. To serve, add a large spoonful of yogurt sauce to each plate, with the potatoes, artichokes, and salmon on top. Garnish with additional dill and parsley if desired. 🌱plant-based swaps: Use dairy-free yogurt for the sauce. For the salmon, swap with a 14-ounce tofu block sliced into 1/2-inch cubes, season with the same herbs and spices, see full recipe for cooking instructions.
come back tomorrow for the last day of the series!!

title: Salsa Verde Chicken Enchiladas
description: Tbh this is probably one of my favorite meals I’ve made recently too 🤭👏 INGREDIENTS
ingredients: 1 teaspoon onion powder salt & pepper to taste
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a mixing bowl, combine salsa verde salsa, diced green chilies, cilantro, sour cream, cumin, onion powder, garlic powder, and salt/pepper. In a separate mixing bowl, combine rotisserie chicken, softened cream cheese, 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese, and ⅓ cup sauce mixture. Add chicken & cheese mixture into tortilla and roll together. in the 13x9 pan, add a small amount of sauce to bottom of pan, enough to evenly coat the bottom. place rolled tortillas on to bottom of pan evenly. add remaining salsa mixture on top of tortillas, making sure all the tortillas are covered in the sauce. Add remaining monterey jack cheese on top Bake uncovered for 20 minutes, broil for additional 2-3 minutes if needed. add cilantro on top for garnish.

title: Salsa Verde Chicken Skillet
description: Salsa verde chicken and rice skillet if you’re looking for an easy and delicious one pan dinner, you’ve made it to the right place!
steps: salt and pepper to taste
How to:
Start by adding olive oil to a skillet on medium heat. Ad your onion and garlic and allow to cook for 3-5 minutes.

Add in your chicken, black beans, corn, salsa verde and chicken broth. Mix together before adding your seasonings. Allow this to come to a boil before adding your rice. Cover with a lid and allow to cook for 20 minutes.
Once your rice is completely cooked top with cheese and allow this to melt.
Serve with avocado, Greek yogurt, cilantro and lime!
Enjoy!

title: Salted Chocolate Brownie Balls
description: SALTED CHOCOLATE BROWNIE BALLS🤎
ingredients: 1 1/2 cup pitted medjool dates (soaked and patted dry)
1/2 cup chocolate chips + 1 tsp coconut oil for melting
steps: How to:
add all brownie batter ingredients to the food processor and pulse until a dough forms roll into balls and dip in melted chocolate top with flaky sea salt place in fridge for at least an hour to set
Enjoy!

title: Sangria Season 🍋🍊
description: Sangria Season 🍋🍊
steps: Sparkling water
In a large pitcher, combine the Rosé, elderflower liqueur, fresh lime juice, fresh orange juice, frozen peaches, and frozen raspberries. Mix together and place in the fridge for at least two hours.
Fill glasses with ice and pour in the sangria. Top with sparkling water and garnish with fresh mint.

title: Saucy Chicken Noodles
description: @kalejunkie 30-MIN SAUCY CHICKEN NOODLES (inspired by PAD THAI)✨ one of the best dinners I’ve made in so long.
ingredients: 14 oz rice noodles (stir fry or pad thai noodles)
1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite size pieces
1 red bell pepper, seed removed and sliced thin
1 cup green onions, sliced thin (this is ~1 bunch)
1/2 cup low sodium soy sauce or tamari
1 lime, juiced and drizzled on top
steps: Cook noodles according to package instructions.
Drain and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, and once hot, add the chicken pieces and soy sauce.
Cook for about 7-8 minutes, until browned on all sides and almost cooked through.
Transfer the chicken from the pan to a plate, leaving the oil and juices from the chicken.
Add the bean sprouts, bell pepper, carrots and garlic.
Cook until the veggies have softened, about 4 minutes.
While those are cooking, make the sauce.
Add all sauce ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth and set aside.
Once the veggies are done, push them to the side of the pan.
Crack both eggs in the pan and scramble them.
Combine with the veggies.
Add the chicken, drained noodles, green onions, cilantro, lime, pepper flakes, and sauce to the pan.
Toss to combine.
Plate and top with additional cilantro, chopped peanuts, and a squeeze of lime.
Enjoy!

title: Scallion Chicken
description: scallion chicken 🤤
ingredients: 1½ lb boneless skinless chicken thighs (or breasts if you prefer), cubed
1 tbsp oil (avocado or olive oil) For the Sauce:
6 to 8 scallions, sliced (whites and greens separated)
1/2 tbsp fresh ginger, finely minced Served with: Choice of cooked rice Choice of cooked veggie
steps: In a bowl, toss the chicken with cornstarch, salt, and pepper until lightly coated.
Whisk together all sauce ingredients in a small bowl and set aside.

Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in an even layer and let it cook undisturbed for 3 to 4 minutes to get some golden color. Flip and cook another 3 to 4 minutes until cooked through. Remove the chicken to a plate.
In the same pan, add a tiny bit more oil if needed. Add the white parts of the scallions, garlic, and ginger. Sauté for about 30 to 60 seconds until super fragrant.
Pour in the sauce and let it simmer for 1 to 2 minutes to slightly thicken.
Add the chicken back to the pan and toss to coat everything in the sauce.
Turn off the heat and stir in the green parts of the scallions.
Serve immediately with your choice of veggie & rice, enjoy!

title: Scoopable Cookies
description: Is this the best trend ever?
ingredients: ▢ 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips or chunks
steps: In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, or a handheld mixer, cream together butter, brown sugar, and white sugar for 5 minutes on medium speed until light and fluffy.
Once five minutes is over, add in egg and vanilla and mix until combined.
In a separate bowl, mix flour, baking soda, and salt, and mix until combined. Add these dry ingredients to the butter mixture on low speed, and mix until just combined.
mix in chocolate chips or chunks until just combined.
Portion dough out into big 2 tablespoon sized dough pieces and place in a baking sheet in the freezer for 20 minutes or so until hard. While dough is chilling, heat oven to 180C (350F).

Place dough balls close to each other in a pan, nearly touching. Bake 9-12 minutes or until golden brown on the edges and soft and gooey in the center. Sprinkle with flakey sea salt, then scoop out while still warm, topping with chocolate sauce, ice cream, anything else you like.

title: Sesame Chicken Bowls
description: EASY SESAME CHICKEN BOWLS 🌶️🍚 recipe below!
ingredients: A splash of toasted sesame oil
1/2 tsp red pepper flakes (or more if you like 🌶️)
steps: In a bowl, add in all of your ingredients for the sauce (tamari, honey, ketchup, sesame oil, minced garlic & red pepper flakes) mix until smooth. Then set aside for now.
In a skillet over medium heat, add a splash of avocado oil and a pound of ground chicken. Break it up til it’s brown you know the drill.
Once the chicken is fully cooked, pour in your sauce. Mix until well coated in sauce. Let it simmer and allow the sauce to thicken 3-4 minutes. Then stir in your roughly chopped green onions.
Then it’s time to plate 🍽️ I served over some Jasmine rice but you could also do it over lettuce wraps or whatever your heart desires!!
Lastly, I topped with sesame seeds!
SO SO DELICIOUS 🍚🌶️

title: Sesame Chicken Lettuce Wraps
description: EASY SESAME CHICKEN LETTUCE WRAPS 🥬 recipe below!
ingredients: A splash of toasted sesame oil
1/2 tsp red pepper flakes (or more if you like 🌶️)
steps: In a bowl, add in all of your ingredients for the sauce (tamari, honey, ketchup, sesame oil, minced garlic & red pepper flakes) mix until smooth. Then set aside for now.
In a skillet over medium heat, add a splash of avocado oil and a pound of ground chicken. Break it up til it’s brown you know the drill.
While we wait for the chicken to brown, roughly chop your green onions for serving.
Once the chicken is fully cooked, pour in your sauce. Mix until well coated in sauce. Let it simmer and allow the sauce to thicken 3-4 minutes.
Then it’s time to plate 🍽️ I added jasmine rice and then the sesame chicken to my lettuce wraps, add your toppings and serve!!

title: Sheet Pan Breakfast Burritos
description: Sheet Pan Breakfast Burritos This may be the single most efficient, and lowest effort, method for making breakfast burritos in bulk 🌯 Making breakfast burritos this way is just incredibly satisfying - and you get 10 (!!) breakfast burritos that you can store frozen and reheat in just a few minutes e
ingredients: 10 (!!) breakfast burritos that you can store frozen and reheat in just a few minutes every morning Per burrito (Makes 10):
steps: Roll” pan (the exact dimensions were 10”x15”, 1 inch lip) for this recipe, which is a common sized sheet pan found at grocery stores.
A quarter sheet pan will be smaller, so you’ll need to scale down the ingredients slightly
You can also scale up the recipe by using a larger sheet pan, just be sure it has at least a 1” raised edge Ingredients:
1 red bell pepper, diced 1 orange bell pepper, diced 1 yellow onion, diced 400g yellow Potatoes (~2-3), diced 30g (2 Tbsp) olive oil Salt/pepper to taste Lean Ground Breakfast Sausage:

448g (16oz) 93% beef or turkey 2 tsp coarse salt 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon chili powder 1/2 teaspoon rubbed sage 1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning 1/2 teaspoon cumin OR use your favorite all purpose seasoning Blended egg mixture:
650g (2.75 cups) egg whites 3 eggs 200g (1 cup) cottage cheese 8g (1 Tbsp) corn starch 50g (1/2 cup) shredded cheddar 10 burrito sized tortillas High Protein Cream Sauce:
400g (2 cups) fat free Greek yogurt 50g (3 Tbsp) hot sauce of choice
Garlic, salt and pepper to taste Cilantro as garnish — This recipe is highly customizable
Let sit for 10 minutes before slicing STEP 4: Assemble your burritos
Slice into equally sized rectangles, add to a burrito sized tortilla along with any sauce or garnishes of choice
Roll your burritos, and enjoy!

title: Sheet Pan Chicken Sausage and Gnocchi
description: This was so good one of my new favorite dinners🤭 RECIPE: - 1 pack chicken sausage - Half onion - One zucchini - Few cloves of garlic - Cherry tomato carton - Oil,salt, pepper,garlic powder,onion powder, oregano and basil - Gnocchi - Boursin cheese DIRECTIONS: 1.
ingredients: Oil,salt, pepper,garlic powder,onion powder, oregano and basil
steps: Dice chicken sausage, onion, zucchini, and garlic
Add all ingredients to a sheet pan with oil and seasoning
Bake at 425 for 15 minutes
After 15 minutes mix up ingredients
Put back into oven for 15 minutes
Add half Boursin cheese block while hot
Mix cheese and serve Original recipe: @Julia

title: Sheet Pan Chicken Shawarma
description: SHEET PAN CHICKEN SHAWARMA 🍗🍋🌿 I made this dinner for the first time last week, and it was SO good that I’ve already made it twice since!
ingredients: Zest and juice of 1/2 a lemon
steps: Preheat oven to 425F.
Dice chicken thighs into 1 inch cubes. Add to a large mixing bowl with all of the other ingredients, except for the red onion.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and marinate for at least 20 minutes on the counter, or place in the fridge for up to 12 hours for even more flavor!
Line a baking tray with parchment paper and spread the chicken into an even layer. Slice the red onion and sprinkle it over the top of the chicken, then lightly spray everything with olive oil spray.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, then I like to turn the oven to broil for 3-5 minutes until the tops of the chicken get a little char.
You can serve this over rice, in a pita, or on a salad! Enjoy! ☺️

title: Sheet Pan Chili Orange Chicken and Broccoli
description: The easiest sheet pan dinner. Add a side of rice for a main, or serve it as an appetizer!
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken breasts or thighs cut into cubes
green onions + sesame seeds, for serving
1 cup fresh orange juice + 2 tablespoons zest
steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 450° F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or rub with oil.2. On the sheet pan, mix the chicken, orange zest, and pepper. Add the flour and toss again. Add 2 tablespoons olive oil, tossing to coat. Arrange the chicken to one side of the baking sheet. Add the broccoli to the other side. Toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Bake for 15-20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.3. Meanwhile, make the sauce. In a saucepan, combine all ingredients, then set over medium heat. Bring to a boil for 3-4 minutes, until the sauce bubbles and begins to thicken. Remove from the heat. 4. Remove the broccoli from the sheet pan. Then pour the orange sauce over the chicken and toss the chicken up in the sauce. Bake for another 5 minutes, until the sauce is baked onto the chicken.5. Serve the chicken, broccoli, and orange sauce with green onions and toasted sesame seeds. I love this over rice, but it's also great as an appetizer too!

title: Sheet Pan Fajitas 🌮🫑🥑
description: CRYING THESE ARE SO GOOD 😭🙏🏼
ingredients: 5 lb chicken breast, chopped into strips
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper and add chicken, peppers, and onion. Drizzle with avocado oil, then sprinkle with taco seasoning. Toss to coat.
Sprinkle corn on top, then slice open lime and squeeze juice all over the mixture. Add the lime halves to the pan and roast 20 mins, or until chicken is cooked through and peppers are tender.
Remove from oven, sprinkle with cheese, then bake another 5 mins until cheese is melty.
I served mine with a dollop of Greek yogurt and some guac inside La Banderita avocado-oil fajita tortillas! Enjoy!
Makes 4 servings:
271 calories, 26G protein, 14G net carbs, 3G fiber, 11G fat
Are you gonna try this one? 🌮

title: Sheet Pan Kebabs (So Easy & Delicious)
description: Sheet Pan Kebabs (So Easy & Delicious) Kebab Ingredients: 2 lb ground beef 1 small white onion, grated 3 garlic cloves, minced ¼ cup fresh dill, chopped ¼ cup fresh parsley, chopped Zest of ½ lemon Pinch of black pepper Pinch of salt 1 tbsp cumin 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp coriander ¼ tsp cinnamon
ingredients: ¼ cup fresh parsley, chopped Zest of ½ lemon Pinch of black pepper Pinch of salt
¼ tsp cinnamon Yogurt Sauce: ¾ cup Greek Yogurt Juice of ½ lemon
1 tsp Date syrup Pinch of salt Pinch of black pepper Parsley, freshly chopped Dill, freshly chopped
steps: Preheat the oven to 425F.

Add all kebab ingredients to a large bowl and mix with your hands. Once thoroughly mixed in, spray a sheet pan with avocado or olive oil, then toss the meat onto it and press the meat evenly across making a rough rectangle. It should be about ½-¾ inch thick.
Score long vertical lines almost to the bottom (don’t cut through), both vertically and horizontally creating your kebabs. Bake for 20–22 mins.
While they bake in the oven, combine all your yogurt sauce ingredients in a bowl until it becomes a creamy consistency.
Remove the kebabs from the oven. Spoon out excess liquid, mix with 1 tbsp tomato paste, and brush over kebabs. Broil for 2-3 mins until browned.
Let rest a few minutes, then cut along the score lines Enjoy as delicious wrap with the yogurt sauce, tomatoes, and lettuce, or eat as is with the sauce.

title: Sheet Pan Pizzas
description: SHEET PAN PERSONAL PIZZAS
ingredients: 10g (1 ½ tsp) salt Dash of garlic powder and oregano Wet Ingredients
steps: Spread evenly on a half-sized baking sheet. Bake dough at 375°F for 25-30 minutes until firm. Remove and let rest for 5 minutes Toppings 400g (about 1 ⅔ cups) tomato sauce 227g (2 cups/1 bag) reduced-fat mozzarella 40g (⅓ cup) Parmigiano Reggiano, grated 40 slices turkey pepperoni Bake at 375°F for ~8 minutes. Switch to broil and cook for an additional 3-6 minutes or until the top is browned Enjoy immediately, or store frozen. To reheat:
Microwave for 2-2.5 minutes
Air fry at 400 for 2-3 minutes to finish Enjoy!

title: Sheet Pan Sticky Ginger Soy Chicken and Broccoli
description: A delicious, fun, take-out style dinner made at home, and much healthier too!
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken breasts or thighs, cut into 2 inch cubes
2 tablespoons pomegranate juice ((or use orange juice))
steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 450° F. Rub a baking sheet with oil.2. Arrange the chicken and broccoli in the prepared baking dish. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the honey, ketchup, tamari, pomegranate juice, garlic, ginger, and a good pinch of chili flakes. Pour the sauce over the chicken and toss to coat. Bake for 25-30 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is bubbling.5. Turn the oven to broil and broil 3-5 minutes, until the chicken caramelizes on top. WATCH CLOSELY, the broiler works fast. Serve the chicken, broccoli, and sauce over bowls of rice topped with green onions and pomegranate, if desired.

1. Arrange the chicken and broccoli inside the instant pot bowl. 2. In a bowl, whisk together the honey, ketchup, tamari, pomegranate juice, garlic, ginger, and a good pinch of chili flakes. Pour the sauce over the chicken and toss to coat. Seal the lid and cook on high pressure for 8-10 minutes.3. Once done cooking, release the steam. Serve the chicken, broccoli, and sauce over bowls of rice topped with green onions and pomegranate, if desired.

title: Sheet Pan Tacos 🌮
description: Sheet Pan Tacos 🌮 Recipe below 👇 Makes 10 tacos
ingredients: ½ cup Greek yogurt Juice of 1 lime
steps: Preheat oven to 400F convection or 425F bake.
In a large bowl add the ground beef, diced onion, cilantro, spices and salt. Mix well with your hands until combined. Set aside.

Take a tortilla, and then a small ball of meat and place that in the center of the tortilla, then spread the meat evenly from edge to edge. Sprinkle a good amount of cheddar cheese in the center then fold the tortilla over to create a taco.
Place the tacos on a wire rack set inside a baking sheet, making sure not to overlap them. Spray with a little avocado oil and add a little salt and pepper.
Bake for 20-30 minutes til golden and crispy. Remove from oven and let cool on wire rack for 5 minutes.
While they bake prep the avocado sauce by putting all the ingredients into a food processor or blender, and blend until smooth.
Enjoy with the avocado sauce and a squeeze of lime.

title: Skillet Turkey Dinner
description: This is the best little skillet dinner, it can be made in less than 30 minutes 🙌 ✨INGREDIENTS ✨ * 1 tablespoon olive oil
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Set turkey into skillet and break it up into small pieces. Then cook ground turkey with onion, seasonings and garlic until meat is browned and onion is translucent.
Add sun dried tomatoes, rice and chicken broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to simmer, cover the skillet and cook 15 minutes until rice is tender.
Uncover and stir in spinach, lemon juice and zest. Cook until spinach is wilted.
Serve topped with Feta straight from the skillet.

title: Slow Cooked Spicy Chicken Lasagna 🍝🔥
description: Slow Cooked Spicy Chicken Lasagna 🍝🔥 700g of protein in one lasagna 🤯 Per serving (Makes 10) 690 Calories 70g Protein 64g Carbs 19g Fat Store each slice individually and freeze for meal prep.
ingredients: 30g (2 Tbsp) chicken bouillon 2, 25oz jars of spicy marinara sauce
30g (1/2 cup) Parmigiano Reggiano Handful chopped chives & basil Salt/garlic powder to taste
Montebello brand recommended because the sheet size fits the roaster pan perfectly
For this recipe, I used a foil
15x11x3 roasting pan that you can find in most grocery stores: “Handi-Foil Medium Rack Roaster Pan”
steps: Add diced chicken breast, chicken thighs, tomato paste, chicken bouillon, marinara, red chili flakes, Italian seasoning, red lentils, and bone broth to a slow cooker. Cook on high for 4–5 hours or low for 6–7 hours Shred the chicken directly in the slow cooker using a spatula or by pressing against the sides. Add the cottage cheese, mozzarella, parmesan, chives, salt, and garlic powder directly into the sauce and stir to combine Then layer lasagna as follows: (4 lasagna layers, 5 sauce layers) Thin layer of sauce Lasagna sheets Sauce Lasagna sheets Sauce
Lasagna sheets

Sauce Lasagna sheets Sauce Top with mozzarella and parmesan. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 375°F for about 40 minutes (place foil roaster on a sheet pan for stability) Remove foil and broil for 5–10 minutes until browned and bubbly, the let rest at least 15–20 minutes before slicing, and enjoy! Each slice has 70g of protein, and can be stored frozen for 3+ months and microwaved to reheat in ~5-6 minutes!

title: SLOW COOKER BEEF BRISKET PASTA
description: WEEKNIGHT WINNERS | RECIPE 4/20
steps: Pat the beef brisket dry and season with the sea salt and cracked black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and sear the brisket on all sides until well browned.
Transfer the brisket to the slow cooker. Add the onion, garlic, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, red wine, beef stock and dried Italian herbs.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours or High for 4 hours, until the brisket is fall-apart tender.
Remove the brisket and shred it using two forks. Return the shredded beef to the slow cooker and stir through the sauce.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to the packet instructions. Drain well, then add it to the slow cooker and toss until coated in the rich brisket sauce.
Serve topped with plenty of grated parmesan, fresh parsley and extra cracked black pepper, if desired.

title: SLOW COOKER BEEF BRISKET TACO 🌮
description: SLOW COOKER BEEF BRISKET TACO 🌮
steps: Season the beef brisket all over with salt, pepper, and taco seasoning.
Place the brisket into the slow cooker, then add the onion, tomato sauce, apple cider vinegar, honey, and brown sugar. Gently mix everything around to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 8–10 hours or on high for 4–5 hours, until the meat is tender and easily pulls apart.
Once cooked, remove the brisket and shred it using two forks. Return the shredded meat to the slow cooker and stir through the juices.
Dip each mini tortilla into the brisket juices, then place into a hot pan over medium heat.
Add a portion of shredded brisket and mozzarella cheese to one side of the tortilla. Fold it in half and toast for 1–2 minutes per side, until golden and slightly crispy, and the cheese is melted.
Repeat with remaining tortillas. Serve warm.
Feel free to serve with any Mexican sauce you like. An avocado blended with Greek yoghurt, lime, coriander and jalapeño is also delicious

title: Slow Cooker Birria Tacos
description: This easy slow cooker birria tacos recipe delivers tender beef, crispy tortillas, and rich consommé—perfect for a hands-off taco night!
ingredients: 2 ½ lb beef pot roast or chuck roast (trimmed and cut into 2-3 large pieces*)
1 ½ cups yellow onion (chopped, plus more for garnish)
1 teaspoon dried oregano (mexican oregano if you can find it, it is more citrusy)
½ teaspoon cinnamon (or 1 small cinnamon stick)
1 cup canned crushed tomatoes (fire roasted if you can find it)
2 cups shredded Monterey jack (Oaxaca or queso chihuahua)
½ cup chopped fresh cilantro (for serving)
guajillo, ancho and arbol chiles (optional in place of chipotle for a more traditional birria. See note below.)
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and spray with cooking spray. Brown the beef on all sides in two batches. Transfer the beef to the slow cooker.

In a blender, or food processor, blend 1 cup onion, garlic, garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, cumin, chili powder, cinnamon, chipotle in adobo, crushed tomato, beef broth, white vinegar and salt. Pour over beef. Add bay leaves and cook on low heat for 8 hours.
Shred beef strain the broth. Return beef to slow cooker with ½ cup broth and keep warm. Save remaining broth for dipping tortillas and serving.
Quickly dip tortilla in the consommé (broth) and add to a hot skillet or griddle.
Add 3 tablespoons of shredded beef and 2 tablespoons shredded cheese to the tortilla with some onion and cilantro. Fold and cook like a quesadilla until browned on each side.
Serve birria tacos with raw chopped onion and cilantro, plus remaining consommé in a small bowl, for dipping.

title: Slow Cooker Chicken Carnitas
description: slow cooker chicken carnitas 🍋‍🟩🍗
ingredients: 1-1.5 lbs of boneless skinless chicken thighs
steps: Rice (if you’re into that)
TOPPINGS:
Cilantro
Avocado
Remaining lime wedges
INSTRUCTIONS:
in a bowl, combine all your sauce ingredients (listed above). Whisk together until smooth.
Add you chicken thighs to your slow cooker, pour the sauce over top. Mix until the chicken is fully coated in the sauce.
Cover and cook on low for 8-9 hours or on high for 4-5 hours.
When it’s done, shred with a fork and serve!
Add all your toppings and enjoy!! I served over some cilantro lime rice, avocado on the side, remaining lime wedges and cilantro on top!
Chefs kiss solid 1000/10!

title: Slow cooker cowboy butter chicken orzo 😍 I’m in love with this dinner!
description: Slow cooker cowboy butter chicken orzo 😍 I’m in love with this dinner!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter salted, unsalted, or garlic and herb
1 to 2 teaspoon Kinder's Cowboy Butter Seasoning
1 lemon juice Salt and pepper to taste
steps: Add the diced chicken breast to the slow cooker.
Add the paprika, chili powder, onion powder, garlic powder, Cowboy Butter Seasoning, minced garlic, butter, lemon zest, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chicken broth.
Stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours or on high for 2.5 to 3.5 hours.
About 30 minutes before the chicken is fully cooked, add the heavy whipping cream and dry orzo.
Stir well and replace the lid.
Cook for another 30 to 40 minutes on low until the orzo has absorbed the liquid and is completely tender.
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Once the orzo is done, stir in the grated Parmesan and chopped spinach until the cheese is melted and the spinach is wilted.
Serve immediately.

title: Slow Cooker Mississippi Turkey Breast
description: You might never want turkey another way after trying this recipe.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pepperoncini brine from the jar
steps: Place turkey breast into the slow cooker and sprinkle with au jus and ranch seasonings.
Add pepperoncini along with 3 tablespoons brine from the jar.
Place the stick of butter on top.
Cover and cook on Low for 7 to 8 hours or on High for 4 to 4 1/2 hours.
Remove turkey breast from the slow cooker and set aside to rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Meanwhile, use a small strainer or slotted spoon to remove any large floating bits from the liquid.
Whisk together cold water and flour until smooth.
Stir flour mixture into the slow cooker liquid until well incorporated.
Cover and cook on High until gravy has thickened, 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve turkey with gravy and peppers from the slow cooker. 🎥: Nicole @nicolesperfectbite

title: Slow Cooker Orange Chicken
description: it’s easy & your kids will love it!
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts and add to your slow cooker.
3 tbsp flour and toss to coat the chicken.
steps: In a separate bowl, mix together:
1/3 cup orange marmalade 1/3 cup BBQ sauce 2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp ginger
Pour the sauce over the chicken and mix well.

Cook on LOW for 6–7 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours. NOTE: This is different from what I say in the video!! We cooked ours on high for 4 hours and it was honestly a little overcooked 😂 So definitely stick to 2–3 hours on high!

title: Slow Cooker Pot Roast
description: This slow cooker pot roast is an easy and delicious dinner that's easily made in a slow cooker or crockpot. This version is paleo, whole30, and AIP-friendly.
ingredients: 3 lb boneless beef chuck roast boneless
steps: Using a large pan, heat the avocado oil over medium heat. Add the roast, season with salt and pepper, and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side or until lightly browned. Remove from the pan and place on the bottom of the slow cooker.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan and saute for 3-4 minutes or until slightly translucent. Remove from the pan and add to the slow cooker.
Add the parsnip, carrots, rosemary, thyme, bay leaves, broth, coconut aminos, and balsamic vinegar to the slow cooker. Place the lid on the slow cooker and cook on low for 7 hours.
Once finished, whisk in the arrowroot starch with about a tablespoon of water until fully combined. Add back to the slow cooker and allow to cook for another hour.
Turn off the slow cooker and remove the bay leaves.
Serve the roasted shredded along with the vegetables and top with several spoonfuls of the broth. Top with chopped parsley.

title: Slow-Roasted Sticky Balsamic Beef
description: Slow-Roasted Sticky Balsamic Beef
ingredients: Beef: 3 lbs beef chuck roast (whole or large chunks)
Seasoning: Salt and cracked black pepper to taste
steps: Prep and Sear: Preheat your oven to 325°F (165°C). Pat the beef dry, season generously with salt and pepper, and sear in a hot, oven-safe pan or Dutch oven until browned on all sides.
Combine Glaze: In a bowl, whisk together the balsamic vinegar, brown sugar/honey, soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, and thyme.
Slow Roast: Place the onion and garlic around the beef. Pour the balsamic mixture and beef broth over the meat. Cover tightly with a lid or heavy-duty foil.
Cook: Roast in the oven for 3–4 hours, basting the beef with the pan juices every hour, until it is fork-tender and pulls apart easily.

Glaze and Caramelize: Remove the lid for the final 20–30 minutes of cooking. If the sauce hasn’t thickened into a sticky syrup, remove the beef, place the pan over high heat on the stove, and reduce the remaining liquid until it coats the back of a spoon.
Serve: Shred the beef slightly or serve in large, tender chunks, drizzled with the thickened balsamic glaze. Serve over creamy mashed potatoes, polenta, or roasted root vegetables.

title: Smash Burger Tacos
