title: Toffee Cookie Bars
ingredients: 2 cups (240 g) all purpose flour (spooned & leveled, not packed)
60 g (2 tbsp + 2 tsp) light corn syrup
21 mL (1 tbsp + 1 tsp) heavy whipping cream
4 oz Melted dark (or semi sweet) chocolate (for drizzling)
More flaky sea salt for topping
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (177°C). Grease and 8×8 pan with butter and line with parchment paper (this helps with easy pan removal later). To make the cookie base, in a large bowl, using a rubber spatula, mix together butter, brown sugar and granulated sugar. Mix until smooth. Add the eggs and vanilla, mix again until incorporated.
In a separate bowl, gently whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cornstarch. Slowly add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture, mix as you go.

Evenly spread dough into the prepared pan and bake for 33-34 minutes, or until the base is golden brown, the edges are set and there is a just a slight jiggle like jello in the middle. Note: ovens do vary so please look for visual cues rather than at the clock. The bars could need more or less time depending on the oven. Best rule of thumb is to start checking for visual cues around 28-30 minutes.

When the cookie base is almost done (about 5 minutes left of baking), work on the toffee layer. Add water and cornstarch to a small bowl. Mix well with a fork until all cornstarch chunks disappear. Set to the side.

In a saucepan, over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the brown sugar, heavy cream, salt and corn syrup. Whisk constantly until mix comes to a boil and pour in the cornstarch/water slurry. Stir until the mix thickens, about 1-2 minutes (please do not cook the mixture any longer than 1 - 2 minutes). Then mix in the vanilla. The mixture should still be runny (so that we can pour over the baked blondies).

When the cookie base is done baking, pour the hot toffee over the base *Note: try to spread the toffee in and around the bars as much as possible. You can do this by moving the pan around and letting the toffee spill all over the bars. Our goal is not let too much of the toffee pool in the middle of the cookie base.

Bake for another 10 minutes. Toffee should be bubbling. Remove from the oven, let the bars rest for about 2 hours. To melt the dark chocolate, simply place chocolate chips or chunks in a heat proof bowl, microwave in 10 second intervals, stir and repeat until chocolate is completely melted.
When ready to serve, lift bars from the pan, drizzle with the melted chocolate and sea salt! Enjoy!

title: Pumpkin Bread
description: Kids love it, grown-ups love it...this pumpkin bread is hard to beat!
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, (spooned into measuring cup and leveled-off)
steps: Preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C )and set an oven rack in the middle position. Generously grease two 8 x 4-in (20 x 10-cm) loaf pans with butter and dust with flour (alternatively, use a baking spray with flour in it, such as Pam with Flour or Baker's Joy).
In a medium bowl, combine the flour, salt, baking soda, baking powder, cloves, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Whisk until well combined; set aside.

In a large bowl of an electric mixer, beat the butter and sugar on medium speed until just blended. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Continue beating until very light and fluffy, a few minutes. Beat in the pumpkin. The mixture might look grainy and curdled at this point—that's okay.
Add the flour mixture and mix on low speed until combined.

Turn the batter into the prepared pans, dividing evenly, and bake for 65 to 75 minutes, or until a cake tester inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the loaves cool in the pans for about 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely. Once completely cooled, cover the loaf with aluminum foil or store it in a cake keeper and keep it at room temperature for up to 3 days.

title: Turkey, Spinach and Feta Stuffed Pepper Nachos
description: turkey, spinach and feta stuffed pepper…nachos?
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chicken broth, plus more as needed
Chopped pickled red onions, plus a splash of the brine
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Cut the bell peppers into wide, flat pieces and arrange them in a single layer on a 10x15-inch jelly roll pan or similar rimmed baking sheet coated with cooking spray. If you like your peppers on the softer side, drizzle them with olive oil and bake for about 6 minutes while you make the filling. If you prefer a little more crunch, you can skip the pre-bake.
Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground turkey, Greek seasoning, oregano and garlic powder and cook, breaking up the turkey, until browned.

Add the orzo and chicken broth. Cook, stirring frequently, until the orzo is almost tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed, adding an extra splash of broth as needed if the pan gets dry before the orzo is cooked through. Stir in the garlic and spinach and cook until the spinach is wilted. Turn off the heat and stir in half of the feta and all of the lemon zest. Taste and season with salt, pepper or additional Greek seasoning as needed.
Spoon the turkey-orzo mixture over the pepper pieces. Crumble the remaining feta over the top and bake for about 12 minutes, until the peppers are crisp-tender and the feta is lightly browned.
Meanwhile, make the Greeko de Gallo by tossing together the tomatoes, cucumber, pepperoncini, pickled onions, a splash of the pickled onion brine, a drizzle of olive oil and fresh dill or parsley.
Pile the Greeko de Gallo over the hot stuffed peppers, finish with a drizzle of extra-virgin olive oil and serve.

title: Ultimate Crumbl Peanut Butter Cookie Copycat
description: This ultimate Crumbl Peanut Butter Cookie Copycat recipe is a perfect knockoff of those huge cookies sold at your local Cumbl Bakery. With peanut butter in three different layers, these super soft & tender cookies are melt-in-your-mouth delicious!
ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar (plus extra for rolling)
steps: Preheat oven to 410°F.
Place peanut butter chips and peanut butter in a bowl. Microwave for 1 minute. Stir until fully combined. Stir in the powdered sugar.

Using a 1 tablespoon scoop or a tablespoon measuring spoon, scoop the filling onto a cookie sheet that has been lined with wax paper or parchment. It should make 14 disks. Set in the freezer while you make the dough.
Mix flours, powder, soda, cornstarch, and salt in a large bowl.

In a separate bowl or stand mixer, beat together the softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar on medium speed until light and fluffy, 3 minutes. Add in peanut butter and mix until well combined. Add in vanilla and eggs, one at a time, scraping down the bowl after each addition.
Add in dry ingredients on low speed until just incorporated and there are no dry pockets.

Using a 3.25 ounce scoop (or ⅓ cup measuring cup plus one tablespoon of dough), fill it ⅔ of the way with dough. Add 1 frozen filling disc, then fill the rest of the scoop up with dough to cover the filling. Roll in sugar and place on a parchment lined cookie sheet. Since these are so large only 6 cookies will fit on each baking sheet. Use a flat measuring cup to lightly flatten the cookie dough. Set in the freezer for 30 minutes.
Bake at 410° for 10 minutes. Allow to cool on the cookie sheet for 10 minutes. Then use a spatula to carefully transfer them to a cooling rack.

Once cookies are cool, microwave peanut butter until loose. Drizzle with a spoon in a random pattern. For a more exacting look, place melted peanut butter in a zip bag and cut a small hole in the end and drizzle.

title: Uncle Vinny’s chicken
description: Uncle Vinny’s chicken is a dish that I can remember very vividly as a kid.
ingredients: 4 lbs. Chicken, I used a combo of drumsticks and breasts
steps: In a small frying pan cook the garlic on a low flame until fork tender in olive oil.
Mashed the garlic right into the oil and cool.
In a bowl combine the garlic oil, salt, pepper, mustard, lemon juice and parsley.
Mix well. Put the cleaned chicken in a ziplock.
Pour the marinade over the chicken and marinate for at least an hour (even overnight). Preheat the grill to 375 degrees.
Pour the contents of the ziplock into aluminum pans (I use two half trays), cover with aluminum foil and get on the grill. I like to add chicken broth to the pan halfway through cooking.

Cook for about 1 hour, periodically giving the chicken a turn. Uncover and bake for about 20 more minutes. Baste the chicken with the juices. Cook until the internal temperature is 165 degrees and serve.

title: Unstuffed Pepper Skillet
description: Unstuffed Pepper Skillet is an easy one pan meal my family loves!
ingredients: 1/4 tsp each of salt, pepper, and paprika
2 cups of shredded Colby Jack cheese
steps: Brown 1 lb of ground beef in a skillet, add all seasonings, the onion and diced bell peppers.
Let that cook until beef is cooked through and peppers/onions have softened. Drain any grease from the skillet.
Add the diced tomatoes, Worcestershire sauce, minced garlic, beef broth, and uncooked rinsed rice.
Stir well, bring to a boil, lower heat to about medium low and cover with a lid. Cook for about 20 minutes or until the rice is cooked (I stirred once during this time).

Mix in one cup of shredded cheese and top with the rest of the cheese. Let sit until cheese melts or pop under the broiler in the oven until cheese is melted. Top with sour cream and hot sauce. Enjoy!

title: Vegan Nacho Cheese Pasta Sauce
description: Nutritionally dense and dairy free, vegan nacho cheese pasta sauce.
ingredients: 1 med head cauliflower separated and steamed till fork tender about 10 min-
then add onion and garlic to blender
steps: Blend and sauté pour over pasta

title: Viral Chuck Roast
description: VIRAL CHUCK ROAST✨ my most popular recipe for good reason!
steps: Preheat your oven to 325. Season the roast generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Add to a baking large casserole dish or Dutch oven, cover (with a lid or foil), and bake for 1 hr per pound of meat.
Remove the roast from the oven and raise the oven temperate to 425.
Using two forks, shred the meat into large chunks. (If the roast is not pulling apart easily, put it back in the oven for 30 min).
Toss the shredded pieces of roast around in the rendered fat and place it back in the oven, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes until you see some nice crispy ends.
Serve with mashed potatoes or roasted vegetables and enjoy!
FAQs:
My roast is more/less than 4 lbs, how long should I cook it?
Use the “hour per pound” method but I’ve found a minimum of 2.5 hour is needed even for smaller roasts. So if your roast is 2 pounds = 2.5 hours; 6 pounds = 6 hours.
How do I choose a good beef chuck roast?

Look for nice fatty roast with lots of marbling. A roast that is too lean will not render enough juice. (Note: I have hit or miss luck with grass-fed roasts. Most are just too tough/lean and don’t render enough fat for this preparation.)
How many people does this serve?
A 4-pound roast serves 6-7 people.
Do I need to sear it first?
Nope! The last part of the cook will give it some nice crispy bits without searing.
Did you add liquid?
No, that is the juice rendered from the meat.

title: Viral Frozen S'mores
description: gluten-free VIRAL FROZEN S’MORES - omg wow, these really live up to the hype and are so easy to make!
ingredients: 4 ingredients, and they even have some protein snuck in there for good measure. I used @simplemills honey cinnamon Sweet Thins to keep these gluten-free and I also just love the addition of that cinnamon flavor, but feel free to use regular graham crackers. Who’s making these!?
2 boxes in case of broken ones)
1 scoop vanilla protein powder (I use @taylordukeswellness, 20g protein per scoop)
1/2 cup chocolate chips (I used @hukitchen) + 1/2 tsp coconut oil
steps: Line a loaf pan with parchment paper.
Arrange the sweet thins in rows to cover the base of the loaf pan.
Melt chocolate and coconut oil in the microwave for 30 seconds at a time, stir, and repeat until smooth.
Pour half of the melted chocolate over sweet thins, reserving the rest for later. Place in the freezer for about 10 minutes.
Mix the CocoWhip & protein powder in a bowl. Then spread it over the chilled chocolate.
Pour the rest of the melted chocolate over the whip, using a silicone spatula to gently spread it.
Top with another layer of Sweet Thins.
Freeze for one hour, then slice into bars. Enjoy and store any extras in the freezer.
Note: if you are using regular graham crackers instead of Sweet Thins, you’ll want to use a baking dish instead of a loaf pan, and double to CocoWhip filling.

title: Waffle Topping Delight
description: The perfect waffle topper for a balanced breakfast that hits the spot 🤌🏻 Original recipe from @Laura Stevens with some adaptations!
ingredients: 2 scoops @Further Food chocolate collagen (or 1 tbs cocoa powder!)
steps: Let it sit in fridge overnight! (Can do shorter but I usually do overnight)
Enjoy!!!!

title: White Chicken Chili
description: white chicken chili 😋🥑✨ full recipe below 👇🏼
ingredients: 2 cans white northern beans, rinsed & drained
steps: I prefer to pre-bake my chicken in the oven while I’m preparing everything else. To make the chicken, simply season with salt and pepper and place it in the oven at 400 for 20-25 minutes until fully cooked. Once cooked, shred it and set it aside for later.
In a large pot, add 1 tbsp avocado oil to medium heat.
Add in the onions and jalapenos and saute for 2-3 minutes until soft. Add the minced garlic and saute for another minute until fragrant.
Add all the seasoning into the pot and mix until the onions and jalapenos are well coated. Saute for one more minute.
Next, add the beans, corn, green chilis, and chicken stock, mix well, and bring to a boil.
Cover with a lid and reduce the temperature to low. Simmer for 15-20 minutes to let the flavors come together!
Cut the cream cheese into cubes and add to the soup. Whisk until smooth and well incorporated. It takes about 5 minutes for the cream cheese to melt entirely.
Finally, add the shredded cooked chicken, heavy cream, and the juice of half a lime. Give it one more good mix.
Serve immediately with your toppings of choice. I love to eat it with sliced avocado, grated cheese, and freshly chopped cilantro. Enjoy!

title: white pesto lasagna
description: white pesto lasagna 🤤 full recipe 👇🏻 What you’ll need: For the Lasagna 12 oven-ready lasagna noodles 1 lb ground chicken 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 3 cups fresh spinach, roughly chopped 2 ½ cups shredded mozzarella, divided ½ cup grated parmesan 2-3 tbsp pesto (used on top at th
ingredients: 2-3 tbsp pesto (used on top at the very end) Fresh basil for topping (optional) For the sauce
¼ tsp black pepper For the Ricotta layer
steps: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the olive oil and once hot, add the ground chicken. Cook for 5-7 minutes, occasionally breaking up the meat, until almost fully cooked.
Season with salt and pepper, then add the chopped spinach. Sauté for a few minutes until the spinach has wilted. Remove the meat mixture from the skillet and set aside in a bowl.
In the same skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Once melted, whisk in the flour until it forms a paste, about 1 minute. Slowly pour in the milk, whisking continuously until fully incorporated.
Let the sauce simmer for 3-4 minutes, until slightly thickened. Remove from the heat and stir in the salt, pepper, and pesto. Set aside until ready to assemble.
In a small bowl, prepare the ricotta layer by mixing together the ricotta, parmesan, egg, and salt until well combined.
Grease a 9×13-inch baking dish and begin assembling the lasagna.
Spread about ¾ cup of the sauce on the bottom of the pan. Add 3–4 lasagna noodles, followed by half of the ricotta mixture, half of the chicken mixture, ½ cup mozzarella cheese, and 1 cup of sauce.
Repeat the layers once more using the remaining ricotta and chicken.
Finish with a final layer of noodles and the remaining sauce. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese. If desired, add a few small dollops of extra pesto on top.
Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for another 10 minutes, until bubbly and lightly golden.

title: Will be making this on repeat!! 🍁
description: Will be making this on repeat!!
ingredients: 2 cups cold whole milk 1 3.4 oz dry jello cheesecake mix
steps: In a large mixing bowl, combine the Jello cheesecake pudding mix and cold whole milk as directed on the box. Stir until the mixture reaches a thickened consistency. Add the softened Cool Whip and fold gently into the pudding mixture until fully combined. Stir in the vanilla extract. Lay one sleeve of Biscoff cookies in an even layer across the bottom of a 9x13 casserole dish. Spread half the cheesecake mixture evenly over the cookie layer. Add a second even layer of Biscoff cookies over the cheesecake mixture. Spread the remaining cheesecake mixture evenly over the top. Add the entire jar of cookie butter to a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in 15 to 20 second increments, stirring between each, until completely melted and pourable. Pour the melted cookie butter over the top layer of cheesecake mixture and spread evenly with a spatula. Crumble extra Biscoff cookies over the top. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate for a minimum of 6 to 8 hours overnight is even better.

title: Yummy Greek Chicken Recipe
description: Dump & bake!!!
ingredients: 2 tbsp lemon juice + zest Seasonings for chicken: paprika, garlic powder, oregano, thyme, onion powder, pepper, parsley (amount up to you)
steps: Season chicken in a casserole dish with oil and seasonings. Add rice and chicken broth. Add minced garlic, lemon juice, and zest. Add zucchini, tomatoes, and top with feta. Cover with foil.
Bake on 375 for 40 min. Remove foil and bake for 15 more min.

title: Zucchini Lasagna Boats
description: lasagna zucchini boats 😋
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese + more for the topping
1 tbsp avocado oil Fresh basil, chopped
steps: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
Add 1 tbsp of avocado oil to a large skillet on medium-high heat. Once heated, add the ground turkey and cook for 5-7 minutes until brown.
Once browned, add in the chopped onion and saute a few minutes until soft.

Once done, add the entire jar of sauce, 1 tbsp of Italian seasoning, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tsp pepper. Mix well, cover with a lid, and bring the temperature down to low. Let it simmer until its time to put it in the baking dish.
Meanwhile, cut your zucchini in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds, leaving a hollow center. Make sure not to scrape it too thin! Then, lay them down at the bottom of a baking dish.
Next, make the ricotta filling. Add 1 cup of ricotta cheese, 1/2 cup of parmesan cheese, and 2 tbsp of Italian seasoning to a bowl, then mix.
Add about 1/2 of the ricotta cheese filling to the base of each zucchini, leaving about 1/2 cup of the filling to add to the top.
Add the meat mixture to each piece of zucchini. I really like to pile it on here!
Top it with dollops of the rest of the ricotta mixture and a sprinkle of parmesan cheese.
Cover with foil, and bake for 30 minutes.

After 30 minutes, pull off the foil and place it back in the oven for about 10 minutes uncovered until the cheese is melted and starting to become golden. Top with freshly chopped basil & serve immediately. enjoy!

title: Lemon Basil Zucchini Pasta Alfredo
description: A creamy bowl of lighter pasta Alfredo that comes together in under an hour and is great for warm summer nights!
ingredients: 2 zucchini or yellow summer squash, very thinly sliced
steps: 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta according to package directions until al dente. Remove 1/2 cup pasta cooking water. Drain.2. Meanwhile, melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the lemon slices. Sear until the lemon is caramelized, about 1 minute per side. Remove the lemon from the skillet. Finely chop the lemon slices and mix with the basil.3. To the same skillet, add 4 tablespoons butter and the onion. Cook until caramelized, 8-10 minutes. Stir in the garlic, zucchini, thyme, and season with salt, pepper, and chili flakes. Cook another 5 minutes until golden. 4. Add 1/2 cup pasta cooking water and the cream, stirring until smooth. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer and cook for 5 minutes, until slightly thickened. Stir in the parmesan, then toss in the pasta. Cook for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat. 5. Serve topped with the reserved lemon/basil mix. Twirl the pasta up with the sauce and zucchini. EAT and ENJOY!

title: 3 ingredient sweet potato pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup sweet potato, steamed or microwaved until soft (skin not included)
1/2 cup grated cheese (tasty, or a mild cheddar)
steps: Steam or microwave your sweet potato. When steaming, peel the skin before chopping into pieces and then steam. If microwaving, cut the very ends of each side and pierce with a knife or fork a few times. Microwave/steam for 15 minutes.
Mash your sweet potato and add egg and cheese, then stir.
In a pan over medium high heat, with a little oil, tease your mixture into mini pancake shapes. You should get around 6.
Pan fry for 3 minutes each side, or until golden brown.

title: 6 ingredient magnum bars 🧸🩵
steps: start by wrapping 1 medjool date around each popsicle stick once it’s in the mold.
make the ice cream mixture with bananas, cocowhip, protein powder, blue spirulina, and chocolate chips.
pour the mixture into the molds (make sure the mixture gets under the date too).
freeze for at least 4 hours or overnight.
coat each bar in chocolate and pop them back in the freezer for 15 minutes.

title: A Salad I Will Be Eating on Repeat This Summer
ingredients: crispy rice (cover sticky rice with soy sauce and sesame oil and put in the oven until crisp)
steps: chuck everything in a bowl and enjoy

title: A simple, easy, and delicious weeknight dinner!
ingredients: 1 chicken breast (I used 2 for extra protein)
4 oz shredded cheddar cheese (I used shredded Colby jack)
steps: Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Chop the onion and add it to the skillet, sautéing until translucent.
Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and add to the skillet, cooking until browned.
Stir in the rice, thyme, sage, salt, and pepper, mixing well.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 15 minutes or until the rice is cooked.
Stir in the heavy cream and frozen peas & carrots, mixing until combined.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese on top and let it melt before serving.

title: Apple Cider Margarita
steps: Add ice to the cocktail shaker.
Pour in 2 ounces of tequila.
Add 4 ounces of apple cider.
Include 1 ounce of triple sec or Cointreau.
Squeeze in the juice of one lime (or substitute with about 1/2 ounce of lime juice).
Shake the mixture well.
Rim the glass with cinnamon sugar (or simple syrup).
Add ice to the rimmed glass.
Pour the cocktail mixture into the glass.
Optionally, top with a cinnamon stick or sprinkle cinnamon on top.

title: Apple Cider Tequila Cocktail
steps: Add ice to a shaker.
Pour 3 oz apple cider, 2 oz tequila, 1 oz Cointreau, and the juice of an entire lime into the shaker.
Shake well until chilled.
Prepare the glass rim by coating it with hot honey and sea salt.
Strain the shaken mixture into the prepared glass, pouring the ice from the shaker into the drink.
Serve immediately and enjoy.

title: Apple Elderflower Spritz
steps: Combine vodka, elderflower liqueur, apple cider, and lemon juice in a large pitcher.
Refrigerate until ready to serve, then add the Prosecco.
Serve over ice with apple slices and fresh thyme.

title: Apple Fritters
steps: These can be served for snack, breakfast or even an on the go treat. They taste great cold too so pop them into lunchboxes!
suitable from 6 months +:
keep in the fridge in an airtight container for 2-3 days or freeze for up to 3 months

In a bowl, mix together 2 grated apples, 3 TBSP plain flour, 2 eggs and a pinch of cinnamon until well combined. Add a little oil/butter to a frying pan/pancake pan and add small dollops of your mixture. Fry on each side for 1-2 mins over a low heat.

title: Apple pie chia pudding
ingredients: Cinnamon brown sugar or maple syrup to taste
steps: Blend everything until smooth, mix in chia seeds, divide into 4 containers, and let set in the fridge overnight!

title: Asian Noodle Salad with Chicken & Peanut Dressing
ingredients: 3 tbsp soy sauce (or tamari or coconut aminos)
1/4 cup soy sauce (or tamari or coconut aminos)
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar (or rice vinegar)
2/3 cup chopped cilantro more for garnish
1/2 cup chopped peanuts more for garnish
1 fresno chili cut in half, deseeded and thinly sliced
3- 4 tbsp Chili crisp or your favorite chili oil
steps: Add the chicken thighs to a bowl along with the honey, soy sauce and ginger powder, garlic powder and salt. Toss to coat and leave to marinate for a few minutes.

Make the dressing by combining all of the dressing ingredients in a nutribullet or high speed blender and blending until smooth. Taste and adjust the flavor as desired by adding more honey, vinegar etc.
Cook the noodles according to the package instructions and then place in a colander and run under cold water

Heat a skillet on medium high heat. Add in the chicken thighs plus and of the excess sauce from the bowl and leave the chicken to cook for 5-6 minutes per side until golden brown in color. Once cooked through place on a cutting board and slice, spoon any excess sauce from the pan overtop

Add the lettuce and noodles to a large salad bowl along with the cucumbers, cilantro, scallions, peanuts and sliced chili. Finally add the chicken and pour the dressing overtop. Toss until well coated. Serve with chili oil/chili crisp spooned overtop for an additional kick of spice and garnish with additional peanuts and cilantro

title: Autumn Huge Spritz🍂✨
steps: Commencer avec environ 3 onces de prosecco.
Ajouter une once de liqueur de fleur de sureau Saint‑Germain.
Incorporer environ une once de jus de grenade.
Compléter avec environ une once d'eau pétillante LaCroix.
Ajouter quelques feuilles de menthe.
Remuer légèrement pour réveiller le mélange.
Décorer avec une garniture de menthe.

title: Award Winning Chili Recipe
steps: Brown the meat.
Rinse the beans and put them directly in the Crock Pot.
Pour one can of tomato sauce into the Crock Pot and half of the second can, reserving the rest for later if needed.
Season the mixture in the Crock Pot with a whole packet of mild chili seasoning, hot sauce, chili powder, cumin, and oregano.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Once the meat is done, pour it into the Crock Pot and stir the mixture.
Check if more tomato sauce is needed and add the remaining half can if necessary.
Let the chili cook for about 5 hours, tasting and adjusting seasoning as needed during the cooking process.
For faster cooking, you can cook on high for 2 to 4 hours.
For best flavor, make the chili a day ahead and let it sit in the fridge before reheating.

title: Baked Apples
steps: Slice apples
Top with cinnamon and vanilla
Cook 390 for 35-55 min depending how soft you want them

title: Baked Barbecue Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 1 jar Primal Kitchen barbecue sauce (or your favorite barbecue sauce)
steps: In your crockpot, add one roughly chopped yellow onion, four to five cloves of freshly minced garlic, and a jar of Primal Kitchen barbecue sauce or your favorite barbecue sauce. Mix until well combined. Add in a pound to a pound and a half of chicken breast and mix the chicken in with the sauce mixture. Cover and cook on low for four to six hours or on high for about two to three hours. Once it's done, shred the chicken with two forks.

Heat up a skillet over high heat and warm up your tortilla for about 10 seconds per side. Add in your chicken crockpot mixture, fold in half, and press down. Continue that process until you run out of tortillas.
Pop the tacos in the oven at 400 degrees for about 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with extra barbecue sauce, cherry tomatoes, lime wedges, pickled red onions, or any other desired toppings.

title: Baked Boursin Tomato Soup
steps: Add Boursin, tomatoes, onion + garlic to a Dutch oven. Drizzle with olive oil and season.
Roast at 400°F for 40 minutes.
Add chicken broth + blend until smooth.
Stir in heavy cream and Parmesan if you want it a little thicker.

title: Baked Ziti Dish
steps: Brown the ground beef in a pan with olive oil.
Add garlic, half of a red bell pepper, and onions to the beef.
Season with garlic powder, oregano, thyme, rosemary, pepper, and salt.
In a bowl, mix 15 ounces of ricotta, one egg, garlic powder, thyme, a pinch of salt, and half a cup of grated Parmesan cheese.
Stir in one cup of freshly shredded mozzarella and lots of pepper into the ricotta mixture.
Add the cooked beef to the sauce and mix in a whole jar of marinara and a little bit of white wine.
Combine two to three scoops of the sauce with the ricotta mixture and mix well.
Dump the cooked rigatoni pasta into the mixture and mix everything together.
Add some sauce to the bottom of a baking dish, then layer in the pasta mixture, mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese.
Repeat layering with more sauce, fresh mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese until all ingredients are used, finishing with sauce and cheese on top.
Bake at 350°F for about 15 minutes, then broil for an additional two minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Banana Nut Chia Pudding with a Date Pecan Crumble
ingredients: 3/4 cup unsweetened plant-based milk (I used soy milk)
1/3 cup unsweetened plant-based yogurt (I used soy yogurt)
To serve: Extra banana slices , coconut flakes, etc
steps: Note: Not a fan of the chia seed texture? Try blending it together with the banana milk to help smooth it out.

title: Bang Bang Shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb medium raw shrimp, peeled and deveined
2/3 cup mayo (i used avocado oil mayo! Also can sub 1/3 cup mayo, 1/3 cup greek yogurt)
steps: Preheat oven to 350F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Spread out panko bread crumbs onto the baking sheet in a thin and even layer. Bake about 5 minutes until crumbs are golden brown. Once cooled, transfer to a bowl.
Meanwhile, pat shrimp dry and add to a bowl. Toss in the avocado oil, garlic powder, paprika and salt until fully coated.

Heat a cast iron pan on medium-high heat. Add the shrimp and cook for about 90 seconds on one side, flip and cook an additional 60 seconds until opaque. Transfer to a bowl and toss in 1/2 cup of toasted breadcrumbs, half of the sauce and the green onions.
Transfer to a serving bowl, top with remaining breadcrumbs and sauce. Garnish with sliced green onions.

title: Barbacoa Recipe
ingredients: 1 small can Chipotle's in adobo sauce
steps: Grab a blender and add half a cup of beef broth, five garlic cloves, one tablespoon of oregano, two teaspoons of cumin, half a teaspoon of ground cloves, two teaspoons of sea salt, one teaspoon of black pepper, and about 2 tablespoons of apple cider vinegar. Squeeze in about 2 tablespoons of lime juice. Open a small can of Chipotle's in adobo sauce, find the chilies underneath the sauce, and add four of them. Scoop in four teaspoons of the adobo sauce. Blend all the ingredients together and set the sauce aside.

Put a pan over medium-high heat. Cut about 3 pounds of beef chuck roast into 3-inch cubes. Season the beef with salt and pepper on all sides. Add olive oil to the pan and sear the beef for about three to four minutes until golden brown, flipping to sear all sides. Transfer the seared beef into the Crock Pot.

Pour the blended sauce into the Crock Pot and add four bay leaves. Turn the Crock Pot on high and wait for four hours. After four hours, shred the meat with two forks to mix in the juices. Serve with cilantro lime rice and your favorite toppings.

title: Barbecue Chicken Sheet Pan Dinner
steps: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees.
Dice the bite-size potatoes and add them to a large sheet pan.
Drizzle the potatoes with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Mix to coat the potatoes evenly.
Place the coated potatoes onto the sheet pan and bake in the oven for about 25 to 30 minutes, depending on the size of the potatoes.
Shred the rotisserie chicken and add it to a skillet with some seasonings.
Once the potatoes are ready, sprinkle the shredded chicken over the potatoes.
Add red onion on top of the chicken and potatoes.
Pour barbecue sauce over the chicken and potatoes, ensuring everything is covered.
Sprinkle sharp cheddar cheese on top of the mixture.
Return the sheet pan to the oven until the cheese is melted.
Remove from the oven and finish with a little more barbecue sauce and parsley.

title: BBQ Chicken Potatoes
ingredients: BBQ Chicken Stuffed Potatoes w/ a side of coleslaw.
Spices- heavy pinch of garlic powder, paprika, oregano black pepper salt
steps: I hope y’all enjoy
Save my recipe below and follow @thedailykale for more recipes every week
Bake potato with oil and a little sprinkle of salt for 1 hour, at 400.
Once potatoes have cooled a little bit, enough to handle them without burning yourself, cut them in half.
Scoop potato filling out of potato, *carefully* and place in a bowl with chicken, spices, cheese and bbq sauce.
Mix together.
Place the mixture evenly into the potatoes.
Place back in oven at 425 top with extra cheese for 12-15 minutes or until cheese has melted.
Can broil for the last couple of minutes if preferred.

title: Beef and Broccoli
steps: Spray your crockpot well add sliced chuck roast. Make sure it’s sliced into strips.
Whisk together in a small beef broth, brown sugar, and minced garlic. Add over the beef. Cook on low for 8 hour or high for 6 hours.
30 mins before scoop out 1/2 cup of the juice and add 2 tbsp of flour. Whisk together & add back into the crockpot along with the frozen broccoli.
Cook for another 30 mins & serve over rice.

title: Beef kebab wraps
ingredients: dressing: olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper
steps: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees. In a medium sized bowl, mix together the ground beef, yellow onion, garlic powder, oregano, fresh parsley, salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly with your hands.
On a parchment lined baking sheet, flatten the ground beef mixture. Once completely flat, use a butter knife to make lines down vertically, 1 inch apart.
Bake in the oven for 20 minutes. While it's cooking, make the cucumber salad and tzatziki.

title: Best Banana Bread Recipe
steps: Mash three spotty bananas.
Add two room temperature eggs.
Mix in 1/4 cup of milk.
Stir in 1/3 cup of maple syrup.
Incorporate 3 tablespoons of melted butter or coconut oil.
Add 2 cups of blanched almond flour.
Mix in 2 teaspoons of vanilla extract.
Add 2 teaspoons of baking powder.
Include a pinch of salt.
Fold in chocolate chips of choice.
Ensure the mixture reaches the desired consistency.
Pour the mixture into an 8 by 4 loaf pan.
Bake at 350°F for 45-50 minutes (45 minutes for a gooier center, 50 minutes for a firmer texture).

title: Best Buffalo Chicken Tacos
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Coat the chicken with olive oil.
Mix flour, baking powder, garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper in a mug.
Coat the chicken in the seasoning mixture, ensuring it's not too floury.
Place foil in the air fryer and add the coated chicken.
Cook the chicken in the air fryer at 375°F for 13 minutes, flipping halfway through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the coleslaw by mixing raw coleslaw mix with mayonnaise, apple cider vinegar, salt, pepper, and dill to your desired consistency.
Set up a sauce station with buffalo sauce and ranch, using more buffalo sauce than ranch.
Warm two small tortillas in the microwave until soft.
Check the chicken to ensure it is cooked through.
Dump the cooked chicken into the sauce bowl and mix to coat evenly.
Assemble the tacos by adding blended cheese and a generous amount of coleslaw on top.

title: Biscuits and Gravy Casserole
steps: Brown breakfast sausage in a pan.
Remove half of the cooked sausage from the pan and set it aside.
Stir in butter into the pan with the remaining sausage.
Stir in flour and let it cook down for at least 3 minutes.
Slowly stir in half and half, about 1/2 a cup at a time.
Season the mixture with slap your mama, black pepper, and red pepper flakes until it thickens, then set aside.
Cut each biscuit from a package of Pillsbury Grands into nine pieces.
In a mixing bowl, crack eggs, add a splash of milk and slap your mama, and mix well.
Put the biscuit pieces in a greased 9 by 13 baking dish.
Sprinkle the reserved sausage over the biscuits.
Top with cheese.
Spread the egg mixture over the cheese and biscuits.
Top with gravy and then add one more cup of cheese on top.
Bake in the oven at 350°F for about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Blackened Fish Tacos!
steps: Mix together red and green cabbage with mayonnaise and fresh cilantro.
Add fresh lime juice, diced mango, and diced jalapeños to the cabbage mixture, then season with salt and pepper and mix well.
Coat the cod with oil and season with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, ground cumin, and paprika.
Place the seasoned cod on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Bake the cod at 400 to 425 degrees Fahrenheit for about 10 to 15 minutes, depending on the thickness of the fish.
Blend together sour cream, half an avocado, half a jalapeño, a clove of garlic, fresh cilantro, lime juice, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Assemble the tacos by adding the slaw and then the baked fish on top.

title: Blueberry Bagels
ingredients: 1/4- 1/2 cup buttermilk (or can do 1 cup Greek yogurt)
steps: Kneed together all ingredients (start with 1/4 cup buttermilk and add more as needed); incorporate more flour as needed if dough becomes sticky. Stir in the blueberries.
Add dough to a floured surface and divide into 4-6 bagels. If dough becomes too sticky, add more flour. Can roll into rods then shape the bagel. Brush with egg wash.
Bake at 350F for 20-25 minutes, then broil for 2-3 minutes.

title: Blueberry Basil Margarita
steps: Prep the glasses by placing them in the freezer for a few hours.
Dip the glasses in hot honey and chili lime powder.
Add a handful of fresh blueberries to the glasses.
Tear up a lot of fresh basil to release the oils.
Slice jalapenos and add them for a kick.
Use agave as the sweetener instead of hot honey due to the jalapenos.
Squeeze fresh lime juice into the mixture and muddle everything together.
Strain the mixture into a cocktail shaker.
Add five ounces of tequila to the shaker for two drinks (two and a half ounces each).
Pour the mixture through a strainer on top of the blueberries and other ingredients to extract extra flavor.
Shake the mixture well.
Pour the margarita into the prepared glasses and garnish with a slice of jalapeno, fresh blueberries, and a basil stem.

title: Blueberry Cottage Cheese Biscuits
ingredients: 1 1/2 cup of organic self rising flour
1/2 cup of frozen wild blueberries (make sure they are wild because they are smaller and have more flavor which makes it so that you don’t need added sugar)
steps: Mix cottage cheese and flour (no need to blend the cottage cheese first) until a dough forms, then mix in blueberries.
Form into 6 balls and bake at 350 F for about 45 minutes or until done.

title: Blueberry Crumble Breakfast
steps: Take a cup of frozen blueberries and put them in a bowl.
Add a splash of lemon juice and a little cornstarch on top.
Mix the blueberries and then put them in the microwave for a minute.
While the blueberries cook, prepare the crumble topping by taking 1/3 cup of oats, salt, a bit of cinnamon, and about a tablespoon of maple syrup.
Add the vanilla protein powder and mix it in.
Add one to two tablespoons of water and mix until it gets chunky.
Pour the crumble over the microwaved blueberries and microwave for another minute.

title: Blueberry Muffin Chia Pudding
ingredients: 2 tbsp maple syrup or blueberry jam
steps: Blend together the unsweetened plant-based yogurt, thawed frozen blueberries, maple syrup or blueberry jam, gluten-free rolled oats, toasted pecans, lemon zest, vanilla paste (if using), kosher salt, unsweetened plant-based milk, and chia seeds until smooth.
Let the mixture sit for a few minutes to allow the chia seeds to absorb the liquid and thicken.
In a separate bowl, prepare the toasted oat crumble by mixing gluten-free rolled oats, vegan butter (if using), toasted pecans, chopped medjool dates, and lemon zest.
Toast the oat mixture in a pan until golden and fragrant.
Layer the chia pudding and toasted oat crumble in a serving dish as desired.

title: Blueberry Peach Quinoa Breakfast Bake
ingredients: 1 C Quinoa, rinsed but not cooked
steps: 1 Preheat oven to 375F. Grease the bottom of a 9×9 pan
Ad thee fruit and quinoa to the baking dish
In a medium bowl mix together all the liquid ingredients and spices. Once well combined pour into the baking dish.
Cover the dish with tinfoil and bake for 50-60 minutes

title: Boursin Egg Bake (One Pan)
ingredients: approximately 1/2 cup whole milk or heavy cream
steps: Ingredients: 1.) 1 dozen eggs 2.) approximately 1/2 cup whole milk or heavy cream 3.) favorite seasoning 4.) diced bell peppers 5.) diced onion powder 6.) chopped spinach 7.) cooked breakfast sausage drained, or diced cooked ham 8.) drizzle extra virgin olive oil 9.) @Boursin Cheese crumbles

title: Boursin Potato Gratin
steps: Start by thinly slicing potatoes and arranging them in rows in a baking dish.
Melt together some heavy cream, Boursin cheese, shallots, and garlic until smooth and creamy.
Pour the rich cheese sauce all over the potatoes.
Sprinkle the top with finch and fennel Italian seasoning.
Bake for about an hour until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden and bubbly.

title: Breakfast Burrito
ingredients: 1/4 cup Good Culture low fat cottage cheese
steps: Cook two eggs in a pan until scrambled.
Mix in about 1/4 cup of Good Culture low fat cottage cheese.
Season with onion powder, garlic powder, a little bit of salt, black pepper, and optional chipotle flakes.
Sprinkle a little bit of reduced fat Mexican cheese blend on top of the eggs and cheese mixture until melted.
Take a hero wrap and place the egg and cheese mixture inside.
Smash a quarter of an avocado on the side with a little bit of salt.
Top the burrito with the tomato onion salsa.

title: Breakfast Meal Prep Bowls
steps: • I use glass containers that are oven safe
• add in 1 serving of hashbrowns to each dish
• whisk 6 eggs together & pour equally into containers
• add in a large dollop of cottage cheese, mix
• add in toppings - I did cooked chicken breakfast sausage & cheddar cheese
• bake on 350 degrees for 30 minutes and reheat throughout the week

title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Add two tablespoons of sugar to a bowl and two tablespoons of apple cider vinegar.
Whisk until the sugar is mostly dissolved.
Add 1/3 cup of mayonnaise and whisk until creamy.
Add 3 1/2 cups of chopped raw broccoli, 1/2 cup of sharp cheddar cheese, 1/4 cup of mozzarella, and 1/4 cup of real bacon pieces.
Stir well.
Put the lid on and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Broccoli tots
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs (panko breadcrumbs are a light, fluffy Japanese breadcrumb but you can use any breadcrumb if you can't find it)
steps: Steam your broccoli until very tender, then mash really well in a large bowl.
Add egg, breadcrumbs and cheese and mash well to combine.
Using wet hands, shape your mixture into tots. If your mixture isn't holding, mash it further or try adding an egg. If your mixture is to wet to shape, try adding extra breadcrumbs.
Bake your tots at 180C for 20 minutes, or until edges are starting to brown.

title: Brown Sugar Maple Pecan Cookie Pie
ingredients: vanilla sugar or coarse sugar, for sprinkling (optional)
1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips or chunks
steps: Fit the pie crust into a pie dish. You can use store-bought crust if desired.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, maple syrup, and brown sugar until well combined.
Melt the butter and let it brown slightly, then add it to the egg mixture.
Toast the pecans in brown sugar in the oven until they are nice and toasty, then chop them.
Add the chopped pecans and chocolate chunks to the filling mixture.
Pour the filling into the prepared pie crust.
Bake the pie for about an hour until it is puffed on top and the center is gooey.

title: Brown Sugar Pop Tarts
ingredients: 2 sticks (1 cup) cold salted butter, shredded
coarse salt or sugar, for sprinkling (optional)
steps: Start by preparing the brown sugar cookie dough by combining the cold shredded butter with the flour and dark brown sugar until well mixed.
Press half of the cookie dough mixture into the bottom of a baking pan to form the base layer.
In a separate bowl, mix together the filling ingredients: dark brown sugar, all-purpose flour, ground cinnamon, melted salted butter, apple butter, vanilla extract, and salt until well combined.
Spread the filling mixture evenly over the cookie dough base in the baking pan.
Take the remaining cookie dough and crumble it over the filling to create the top layer.
Bake the assembled bars in the oven until they are just set and lightly golden.
Once baked, allow the bars to cool before preparing the frosting.
For the frosting, mix together the powdered sugar, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and ground cinnamon until smooth.
Spread the frosting over the cooled bars and sprinkle with coarse salt or sugar if desired.

title: Bruschetta Chicken and Bacon Pasta 🍅🌿
ingredients: 8- 10 oz mozzarella pearls cut in half
1 pound pasta of choice (I like bowtie or penne)
steps: Mix ingredients for marinade in a bowl, and then pour over chicken breasts in a shallow dish or gallon size ziploc bag. Let marinade in fridge for 6-12 hours.
Grill chicken until cooked through. Approximately 4-5 minutes each side. Set aside to cool. Once cool, chop into bite size pieces.
Whisk together ingredients for balsamic glaze in saucepan, bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 3-5 minutes, until mixture thickens. Set aside.
Cook pasta and rinse with cool water.

Add pasta, chicken, tomatoes, mozzarella, fresh basil, and bacon pieces to a large bowl. Drizzle balsamic glaze over the top, and gently mix. You may want to save some of the glaze for serving the pasta.
Enjoy!

title: Buffalo Chicken & Bacon Mac n’ Cheese
ingredients: (Aka, cook for half the time shown on the box)
steps: Store everything frozen - no need to thaw, just toss in the microwave with 2-3 tablespoons of milk or water, cover with a paper towel, and microwave for 3-5 mins until heated through
Make sure to blend the cheese sauce for 2-3 mins to ensure it’s completely smooth all the way through - heating up slightly in the microwave can help with the process

title: Buffalo Chicken Bites
ingredients: 3 tbsp hot sauce or buffalo sauce (2 tbsp mixed into the chicken 1 tbsp for tossing/dipping)
steps: Shred or dice the carrots and set them aside.
In a bowl, combine 2 pounds of ground chicken, 1 egg, and 1/3 cup of breadcrumbs.
Add the diced carrots to the bowl.
Season the mixture with 1 teaspoon of garlic powder, 1 teaspoon of onion powder, 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper, and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Add 2 tablespoons of hot sauce or buffalo sauce to the mixture and mix everything together thoroughly.
Preheat the air fryer and layer with avocado oil.
Form the mixture into bite-sized pieces and place them in the air fryer basket, ensuring they are not overcrowded.
Cook the chicken bites at 375°F for 12 minutes, then flip them and cook for an additional 7 minutes.
Once cooked, toss the chicken bites with 1 tablespoon of hot sauce or buffalo sauce for extra flavor.
Assemble the meal prep by adding jasmine rice, buffalo chicken bites, and carrot chips to containers.

title: Buffalo Chicken Wraps All Day Every Day Please!
ingredients: 1 to 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts
1/2 cup Frank’s Red Hot Buffalo Wing Sauce or @SweetBabyRay Mild Buffalo Sauce
steps: Preheat air fryer to 375°F.
Cut chicken into 2-inch cubes and toss with olive oil.
Mix flour, baking powder, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Coat chicken fully.
Air fry for 15–17 minutes.
Mix coleslaw with mayo, mustard, salt, pepper, and dill.
Toss cooked chicken with buffalo sauce.
Warm tortilla for about 30 seconds.
Add chicken, coleslaw, cheddar cheese, and ranch. Fold into a wrap.
Cut in half and drizzle with extra hot sauce and ranch.

title: Caesar Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 cup of Caesar dressing of choice
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F
Place chicken in a 9x13 casserole dish
Pour ½ of the Caesar dressing on one side of the chicken, season with salt and pepper, flip and repeat on the other side
Sprinkle cheese across the top of the chicken
In a bowl, mix the crushed croutons, melted butter and parmesan cheese
Spread crouton mixture across the top of the chicken
Bake at 375 degrees F for 20 minutes

title: Cajun Chicken Pasta
ingredients: cup of diced tomatoes (fresh or canned) optional
steps: Cook on high for 2.5 hours/ low for 3.5-4 then add pasta and cook another 30 min
Taste test to see if you need to add more seasoning

title: Cannoli Cake
ingredients: 15 ounce container of ricotta or dairy free ricotta
1/2 to 1 cup of mini chocolate chips
steps: Melt a stick of butter and set aside.
In a mixing bowl, combine 250 grams of sugar and whisk until incorporated.
Add three eggs to the mixture and mix well.
Add a 15 ounce container of ricotta or dairy free ricotta to the bowl.
Stir in a tablespoon of vanilla extract and a teaspoon of cinnamon.
Add the zest of an orange (or lemon, or omit if not available).
In a separate bowl, mix 220 grams of flour, two teaspoons of baking powder, and a half teaspoon of salt.
Combine the dry ingredients with the wet ingredients and mix with a spatula.
Add between a half a cup to a cup of mini chocolate chips, saving some for topping.
Pour the batter into a greased springform pan or regular cake pan.
Sprinkle additional chocolate chips on top of the batter.
Bake in the oven at 350°F for about 45 minutes.
Once baked, allow to cool slightly before dusting with powdered sugar.

title: Cheeseburger Mac
steps: Cut up one yellow onion.
In a separate bowl, mix 1/3 cup of ketchup, 2 tablespoons of yellow mustard, and 1/4 cup of dill relish.
Cook the onion and 1 pound of grass fed ground beef in a pot until the beef is cooked.
Add salt, pepper, and the seasonings: 2 teaspoons of paprika, 1 teaspoon of chili powder, and 1 teaspoon of garlic powder.
Add 3 1/2 cups of chicken broth, 1 pound of gluten free elbow pasta, and the ketchup, mustard, and pickle mix to the pot.
Bring to a boil and cook for about 8 minutes until the pasta is al dente.
Add 1 cup of milk and 2 cups of shredded cheddar cheese, mixing until everything is melted.

title: Cheesecake Chia Pudding
ingredients: 1/4 cup pitted dates (soaked in warm water for 10 minutes for softness)
Toppings of choice: fresh fruits, nuts, crushed graham crackers, or sprinkle of cinnamon)
steps: Instructions:
Boil dates and soak in the warm water for about 10 minutes to soften them. Drain and set aside.
In a blender or food processor, combine the cottage cheese, milk, soaked dates, vanilla extract (if using), maple syrup, and salt (if using). Blend until smooth and creamy.
Pour the chia seeds into a bowl with the blended mixture and stir. Mix well to ensure the seeds are evenly distributed.
Cover the bowl or jar and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. The chia seeds will absorb the liquid and create a pudding-like texture.
Once set, give the pudding a good stir. Serve it in bowls or jars, and top with your favorite fruits, nuts, or a sprinkle of cinnamon if desired.

title: Cheesy Beef Bowls
ingredients: 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, freshly shredded shredded, plus extra for topping
1 cup Colby Jack cheese, freshly shredded
Cooked white rice or pasta, for serving
steps: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook ground beef with ½ tsp salt, ¼ tsp black pepper, and ½ tsp garlic powder until browned. Remove from skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, melt butter. Add onion, grated carrot, and garlic. Sauté for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in chopped broccoli florets and cook for 4–5 minutes, until slightly tender.
Return beef to skillet. Pour in milk and heavy whipping cream. Simmer for 5–6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened.
Stir in Dijon mustard, ½ tsp salt, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, and ¼ tsp black pepper.
Reduce heat to low. Add cheddar and Colby Jack in small handfuls, stirring after each addition until completely melted and smooth.
Spoon the cheesy broccoli beef mixture over bowls of hot cooked rice or pasta, garnish with extra cheddar cheese, and serve immediately.

title: Cheesy Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 Tablespoons chopped fresh basil or chives (optional)
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.
Cut the spaghetti squash in half lengthwise, then remove the seeds.
Fill a baking pan with a 1/4″ layer of water and place each spaghetti squash half face down.
Place the chicken breasts in a large 9×13” casserole dish. Top evenly with seasoning.
Bake the spaghetti squash and chicken breasts at the same time for 45-50 minutes (or until the spaghetti squash is soft and the chicken breasts are fully cooked).
While the squash and chicken are baking, prepare the remaining ingredients.
Once the squash and chicken are done, shred or dice the chicken into small pieces.
With a fork, remove the “spaghetti” from the squash.
Combine everything (except for 1/2 cheese and 1/2 fresh herbs) and mix into the casserole dish.
Top the casserole with the remaining cheese.:
Lower the heat to 350 degrees F and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until everything is hot and the cheese has melted. Enjoy!

title: Cheesy Pork Breakfast Biscuits
ingredients: @jenneatsgoood same meal prep going on 2 years now
steps: Preheat oven to 400F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the onions and peppers and cook until softened, 6 to 8 minutes.
Push the onion and pepper toward the sides and add the ground pork to the center and cook, breaking up any large chunks, until the pork is browned and onions are translucent, about 8 mins.
Remove from the heat and season with the salt, pepper, and sage and mix well. Carefully pour off any excess oil and set aside to cool.
Whisk the eggs in a bowl. Add the pork mixture and 1 cup of the cheese and mix well. Add the almond flour, coconut flour, and baking powder and mix until just combined.

Scoop about 12 balls of dough onto the baking sheet, spacing them 1 to 2 inches apart. Lightly coat your palms with oil and press gently down on top of each ball to form a biscuit. Evenly sprinkle each with the remaining 1/2 cup cheddar and bake for 12 to 14 mins, until the cheese is melted and the biscuits are baked through and lightly browned.

title: Chia Seed Jam
ingredients: honey/maple syrup to sweetener to taste
steps: combine, let sit in fridge for about 20-30 mins at least until chia seeds gelatinize and then enjoy!

title: Chicken Alfredo Lasagna Rolls!!
ingredients: 1 tsp BritsCookin’ Garlic and Herb Blend
Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Boil lasagna noodles until tender; set aside.
In a bowl, mix Boursin cheese, ricotta, egg, garlic powder, black pepper, and Britscookin seasoning.
For the Alfredo sauce, melt butter in a pan, add minced garlic, then stir in heavy cream.
When it bubbles, whisk in Parmesan and Asiago cheese.
Season with salt and pepper.
Simmer 3 minutes or until it starts to thicken.
Spoon 1 cup of sauce into the bottom of a baking dish.
Spread the ricotta mixture over each lasagna noodle, top with chicken and mozzarella, then roll up carefully.
Place rolls seam-side down in the dish, pour remaining Alfredo sauce over the top, and sprinkle with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake at 375°F, covered, for 10 minutes, then uncovered for 10 more minutes.
Serve warm and enjoy!

title: Chicken and Bell Pepper Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breast, cut into cubes
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Cut the chicken breast into cubes and chop the bell peppers and red onion thickly.
In a bowl, combine the chicken, bell peppers, red onion, olive oil, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. Let it soak for a couple of hours if desired for better flavor.
Place the chicken and vegetable mixture on a sheet pan and bake in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the chicken and vegetables are baking, prepare the sauce by combining soy sauce, pineapple juice, rice wine vinegar, honey, and cornstarch in a saucepan.
Bring the sauce to a simmer over medium heat, stirring until it thickens. If it gets too thick, add water to thin it out.
After 20 minutes, broil the chicken and vegetables on high for 5 minutes to get a char on top.
Remove from the oven and pour the sauce over the chicken and vegetables before serving.

title: Chicken and Cucumber Salad with Peanut Butter Dressing
steps: Cook chicken however you like (pan fry, air fry, poach, oven bake or rotisserie).
Add cucumber, peanut butter, soy sauce, chili oil, garlic, honey, lime, cabbage, onion, and sesame seeds to a bowl.
Give the bowl a shake to mix all the ingredients.

title: Chicken Broccoli Cheddar Crescent Ring
ingredients: 1 can Big & Flakey Pillsbury Crescent Rolls
steps: Preheat the oven to 350˚F
Mix the softened cream cheese, garlic powder, salt and pepper together in a large mixing bowl. Then add the chicken, broccoli, and cheddar cheese and stir until combined.
On a greased cookie sheet, lay each crescent triangle down in a circle so that the wide side slightly overlaps to make a circle and the pointed side points out.
Scoop the mixture evenly around the circle, then pull the points gently over the top of the chicken mixture to secure the ring.
Bake for 15-25 minutes, or until the crescent rolls are lightly browned and the cheese is melted.

title: CHICKEN ENCHILADA POCKETS 🌮🌶️🧀
steps: Top them with guacamole, sour cream, cilantro or whatever you love on your enchiladas!

title: Chicken Pesto Meal Prep
steps: Add rice, chicken, pesto, Greek yogurt, red onion, spinach, and chicken stock to a bowl. Top with sun-dried tomatoes. Cook in the oven for 40 - 50 minutes at 180 Celsius.

title: Chicken Pie Delight
ingredients: Meat from half a BBQ chicken
2- 3 sheets puff pastry, cut into squares
steps: Peel and cube pumpkin, slice onion and leeks, shred chicken, crush garlic. Simmer veggie scraps and chicken bones in 3-4 cups of water for 30 min. Strain and add scraps to your kitchen caddy, then add to your food and garden organics bin. Sauté leek, onion, pumpkin and peas in butter for 5 mins. Add garlic for 2 mins, stir in flour, then chicken and 2 cups of scrappy stock. Simmer for 10 mins to thicken. Fill pie dish, top with squares of puff pastry, brush with melted butter, then bake at 200C for 30 mins or until golden brown. Enjoy!

title: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Melt butter in a pan.
Add chopped onion and sauté until tender.
Stir in flour gradually.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Pour in chicken broth and milk, stirring until thickened and bubbly.
Add frozen vegetables and shredded chicken, mixing well.
Prepare pie crust and preheat oven to 425°F.
Place the mixture in the pie crust and cover with top crust, sealing edges with a fork.
Cut vent holes in the top crust.
Bake for 15 minutes, checking for burning and covering with tin foil if necessary.

title: Chicken Salad Sandwich
steps: Mix celery, chicken, almonds, and strawberries together in a bowl.
Add mayo, mustard, coconut yogurt, lemon juice, salt, and pepper to the mixture and stir until well combined.
Serve the chicken salad mixture on your choice of bread to make a sandwich.

title: Chickpea Peanut Butter Blondies
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/4 cups chickpeas drained and rinsed
steps: Blend the chickpeas until completely smooth then add the peanut butter maple syrup and vanilla and blend again
Mix in the almond flour baking powder salt and chocolate chips then bake at 350 for 40-45 minutes until set but still soft in the middle
Let them cool before slicing

title: Chili Crisp Orange Chicken
ingredients: 64 oz (1800 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
10 g (1/2 Tbsp) ginger paste or minced ginger
steps: Remove all liquid from slow cooker, bring to boil for ~20 minutes to reduce.
Place over heat for 30 seconds, mix until thick, then add to chicken
Add salt to taste (if needed)
Allocate chicken and rice evenly across 10 servings, garnish with green onions and sesame seeds
Store frozen, reheat by microwaving for 3-4 minutes, mix, then microwave another 1-2 minutes if needed
Enjoy!
Less than a month until the cookbook releases

title: Chili Crunch Honey Chicken
ingredients: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp salt and pepper each
Pineapple salsa - 1 cup chopped pineapple, 1 cup chopped cucumber, 1/4 cup chopped red onion, 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro, 1/2 jalapeño chopped, 1 lime juiced, salt & pepper
steps: Coat chicken well with olive oil, seasonings, and chili crunch oil. Rub it in. Drizzle lots of honey on top.
Airfry at 380 degrees for 15 minutes.
Combine pineapple salsa ingredients and build bowls with chicken, rice, extra honey, and enjoy!

title: Chili Honey Chicken Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 tsp each: smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder
steps: Broil at 500 for approx 10 - 15 minutes
assemble bowl with jasmine rice and enjoy! xx

title: Chili Mango Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 cup fresh or frozen mango chunks
1 cup mixed green onions, basil, and cilantro
1 cup fresh mango chunks or slices (1 fresh mango)
steps: Start with the mango dressing by blending together fresh or frozen mango chunks, creamy peanut butter, toasted sesame oil, extra virgin olive oil, apple cider vinegar, honey, sambal oelek (if using), tamari or soy sauce, garlic, and salt in a food processor.
In a large salad bowl, add shredded cabbage or kale.
Add cooked shredded rotisserie chicken to the bowl.
Include sliced Persian cucumbers and a mix of green onions, basil, and cilantro.
Add fresh blueberries and fresh mango chunks or slices.
Slice and add avocados to the salad.
Top the salad with chopped salted roasted peanuts and some basil leaves.
Pour the mango dressing over the salad and toss everything together.

title: Choc veggie muffins (with hidden vegetables)
ingredients: 1 small zucchini, grated and liquid squeezed out
1 handful sweet potato, peeled and grated
steps: Blend the wet Ingredients: Preheat oven to 180°C/350° F (fan-forced). Add all blender ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Combine with Dry Ingredients: In a large bowl, mix all dry ingredients. Pour in the blended mixture and stir gently until just combined.

Bake the Muffins: Line a muffin tin with silicone patty pans. Spoon the batter into each cup, filling about 3/4 full. Bake at 180°C/350° F for 15 minutes, or until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Serve: Cool slightly before serving.

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Bread
steps: Start with a big mixing bowl and add all of the dry ingredients: one and a half cups of all-purpose flour, half a teaspoon of cinnamon, half a teaspoon of salt, and one teaspoon of baking soda.
Mix the dry ingredients well and set aside.
Mash five overripe bananas in a separate bowl.
Add two eggs, one teaspoon of vanilla extract, half a cup of brown sugar, one stick of melted butter, and half a cup of sourdough discard to the mashed bananas.
Use a hand mixer to mix the wet ingredients for about 20 seconds.
Pour the wet ingredients into the bowl of dry ingredients and mix until well incorporated using a spatula or large spoon.
Fold in eight ounces of semi-sweet chocolate chips gently.
Spray the inside of a 9 by 5 loaf pan with cooking spray and pour the batter into the pan.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees for about 50 minutes to one hour, keeping an eye on it towards the end until it is golden brown.
Once done, remove the loaf from the pan and let it cool before slicing.

title: Chocolate Fudge Popsicles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons all natural unsweetened cocoa powder
2- 3 tablespoons maple syrup (adjust based on sweetness preference)
Optional: A splash of vanilla extract or a pinch of cinnamon for extra flavor
steps: Comment “POPSICLE” for the link to the molds.
Made with wholesome ingredients like avocado, coconut milk, and a touch of maple syrup, they’re a delicious and nutritious way to cool off.
Perfect for toddlers, these popsicles are dairy-free, refined sugar-free, and packed with healthy fats.
Just remember, cocoa powder is best enjoyed by kiddos 12 months and older.

title: Chocolate Ice Box Cake
steps: Whip heavy cream with cocoa powder, powdered sugar, vanilla extract, and a little bit of salt until soft peaks form.
Layer the whipped mixture with gluten free Oreo cookies.
Chill in the fridge overnight to set.
Slice and serve.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Muffins – Toddler Friendly!
ingredients: 2 cups grated zucchini, squeezed (to remove liquid)
steps: Preheat your oven to 180C/350F fan-forced.
Add your wet ingredients including egg, maple syrup, vanilla essence and butter to a bowl and whisk to combine.
Add your dry ingredients to the same bowl including flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cocoa poweder. Stir to combine.
Add your squeezed zucchini and chocolate chips and stir.
Place muffin casings/patty pans in each of the 12 holes. Spray the tops of the muffin casings. Divide your mixture among holes.
Bake at 180C/350F for 20 minutes. A toothpick should come out clean or with moist crumbs.

title: Christmas Cheesy Potato Casserole
steps: Finely chop sage, rosemary, and parsley.
Melt butter with half and half in a saucepan.
Grease a baking tray with neutral oil or butter to prevent sticking.
Layer shredded potatoes in the tray; if using frozen potatoes, no need to thaw.
Season each potato layer with salt and pepper.
Add a thin layer of the fresh herb mixture over the potatoes.
Sprinkle a layer of shredded cheddar, mozzarella, and a little Parmesan over the herbs.
Repeat the layering of potatoes, seasoning, herbs, and cheeses until the tray is full, ending with a layer of regular cheese (cheddar/mozzarella) but not Parmesan.
Pour the butter‑half‑and‑half sauce over the top layer of cheese.
Top with a final sprinkling of Parmesan cheese.
Cover the tray with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking uncovered for another 30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Let the casserole rest for a minute before serving.
Garnish with chopped chives and serve.

title: Christmas Punch
ingredients: 1 apple, any kind, sliced into rounds
1 c. fresh cranberries, plus more for serving
steps: Ice
4 c. apple cider
1 (750-ml) bottle Prosecco
1 (12-oz.) can ginger beer
1 1/2 c. (12 oz.) unsweetened cranberry juice
1 1/2 c. (12 oz.) vodka
1 apple, any kind, sliced into rounds
1 blood orange, sliced into rounds
1 c. fresh cranberries, plus more for serving
Cinnamon sticks, for serving

title: Cilantro Lime Shrimp Tacos
steps: Add Chosen Foods mayo, apple cider vinegar, a little dash of honey, salt and pepper, and mix it all to combine for the slaw.
In a food processor or blender, add Chosen Foods mayo, lime juice, lime zest, cilantro, and hot sauce to taste for the cilantro lime sauce. Blend until smooth.
Ensure the shrimp is nice and dry, then add a generous amount of taco seasoning.
Cook the shrimp over high heat with Chosen Foods avocado oil, flipping after a minute.
Char the tortilla on the stove.
Assemble the tacos and finish with cilantro and lime juice.

title: Cookie Dough Overnight Oats
ingredients: fourth of a cup of organic dark chocolate chips
steps: Add half a cup of rolled oats to a jar.
Pour in one cup of milk of your choice.
Add one tablespoon of maple syrup.
Stir in two tablespoons of peanut butter.
Mix in one tablespoon of chia seeds.
Add one teaspoon of vanilla extract.
Incorporate a fourth of a cup of organic dark chocolate chips.
Add a pinch of salt and stir everything together.
Put the jar in the fridge overnight.

title: Cookie Pizzas
ingredients: 1/2 a box of yellow cake mix
steps: Bake some pizza dough at 400 degrees for five minutes.
Mix together a stick of melted butter with a half a box of yellow cake mix and spread that out over top of the dough.
Sprinkle on some brown sugar and some white sugar.
Top this with chocolate chips and then bake it at 400 degrees for another 10 minutes.

title: Corn fritters 🌽 for the boys!
ingredients: 1 15 oz can corn, drained and rinsed
steps: in a bowl, mix together all ingredients. If batter seems too wet, add 1-2 tbsp of more flour.
form into patties and bake at 350 for 25 minutes, flipping halfway.

title: Cottage Cheese Soup
steps: Add cottage cheese, roasted red peppers, minced garlic, crushed chillies, and tinned tomatoes into a blender. Blitz until smooth. Heat the mixture in a saucepan over low heat, stirring continuously.

title: Cowboy Cornbread Casserole
steps: Start by browning 1 pound of 93/7 ground beef in a pan over medium heat. When the ground beef is done, add half a packet of taco seasoning, half a cup of water, eight ounces of salsa, half a jar of chili beans, and half a can of sweet corn. Mix everything together until it's completely combined and let it cook for a few minutes.
While that's cooking, combine one box of corn muffin mix, half a can of cream corn, one container of non-fat Greek yogurt, and two tablespoons of milk. Mix all that together.

Spray a casserole dish with cooking oil. Transfer your meat mixture to the dish and spread it out evenly. Top with one and a half cups of shredded Colby Jack cheese. Then, top with your cornbread mixture and spread that out as best you can.
Bake in a 350-degree oven for 40 to 50 minutes until your cornbread is done.

title: Creamy Beef and Shells
ingredients: 1 to 1 and a half cups sharp cheddar
1 tsp Italian seasoning, Itsp cajun seasoning, pinch of red pepper flakes, salt & pepper to taste
steps: Add cooked beef, onion, tomato sauce, beef stock, and seasonings to the crockpot. Cook on high for 3 hours. Add in shells, heavy cream, and cheese and cook for an additional 30 minutes. We serve with garlic bread and it's so good!

title: Creamy Beef Pasta
ingredients: 1 (10 oz) can Rotel tomatoes with green chilies, undrained
3/4 cup heavy cream (or milk for a lighter version)
steps: Cook the Pasta
Cook bowtie pasta in salted boiling water until al dente.
Drain and set aside, reserving ½ cup pasta water if needed to loosen sauce.
Prepare the Beef Mixture
In a large skillet over medium heat, brown the ground beef.
Add Italian seasoning and stir until fragrant.
Pour in the can of Rotel (with juices) and stir well.
Let simmer for 2–3 minutes to combine flavors.
Build the Creamy Sauce
Lower the heat, then add butter and stir until melted.
Pour in heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add Parmesan and mozzarella cheese, stirring until melted and creamy.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Combine & Serve
Add the cooked bowtie pasta to the sauce and beef mixture.
Toss to coat evenly. If needed, use a splash of reserved pasta water to adjust consistency.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve warm.
Prep Time: 10 minutes
Cook Time: 20 minutes

title: Creamy Chicken Fajita Pasta 🐔🍝
ingredients: 100 ml of water (I would recommend a little more about 120, some of the pasta was dry)
steps: How to make:
Add the pasta, chicken, onion, peppers, garlic, cream cheese, diced tomatoes, fajita seasoning, salt, pepper, and water to a large baking dish. Mix everything together until well combined.
Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese evenly over the top and cover the dish with aluminum foil.
Bake at 375°F for 40 to 45 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for another 10 minutes, or broil on high for 5 minutes until the cheese is golden and bubbly.

title: Creamy Chicken Orzo
ingredients: 1 lb Boneless Skinless Chicken Breasts, cut into bite-size pieces
10 oz Broccoli Crowns, chopped small (4 Cups)
Freshly Grated Parmesan Cheese, for serving
steps: In a large skillet over medium heat, heat the olive oil until shimmering. Add the chicken and season with 1 tsp of the salt and all the pepper. Spread the chicken into one layer and let cook undisturbed for 2-3 mins until golden brown, then continue cooking while stirring for 2-3 more mins until cooked through. Transfer into a bowl and set aside.
In the same pan, melt 1 Tbsp of the butter, then add the onion and cook, stirring, until softened (3-5 mins). Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the orzo and toast for 1 min, then add 2+1/2 cups of the whole milk, the chicken stock, and remaining 1+1/2 tsp salt. Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring often to prevent sticking.
Cook uncovered for 8-10 mins, stirring often, until the orzo is al dente and the liquid has thickened into a creamy sauce. Stir in the chopped broccoli, and cook 4-6 more mins.
Once the broccoli is tender and the orzo is creamy, stir the cooked chicken back into the pan and let it warm through for 1-2 mins.
Stir in the remaining 1 Tbsp of butter and 1/4 cup of milk. Turn off the heat and stir in the lemon juice.
Serve hot, topped with freshly grated parmesan cheese and chopped fresh parsley. Enjoy!

title: Creamy Chicken with Cilantro Lime Rice
ingredients: 40 g reduced fat shredded Mexican style cheese
2 TBSP chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
steps: 1.Add chicken breasts, bone broth, chipotle peppers in adobo, and taco seasoning to a slow cooker. Cook on low for 4–6 hours or high for 2–3 hours, until tender.
2.Shred the chicken, return to the slow cooker, and stir in shredded Mexican cheese until melted.
3.Blend cottage cheese, nacho cheese sauce, milk, and taco seasoning until smooth. Pour over the chicken and stir to combine.
4.Cook rice according to package directions, then mix with fresh lime juice and chopped cilantro.
5.Serve the creamy chicken over the cilantro lime rice and top with 1/4 cup pico de gallo.

title: Creamy Chipotle Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 1 tsp each pepper, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, cajun seasoning
salt and garlic powder to taste
steps: blend

3.mix in cream cheese and cover till melted
