title: Creamy Coconut Peanut Noodles
ingredients: 3 tbsp natural peanut butter (smooth or crunchy)
1 1/2 tbsp red curry paste (see note 1 for substitutions and about gluten)
2 1/2 tbsp tamari (or all-purpose soy sauce, but this is not gluten-free)
2 tbsp neutral oil of choice (I used light olive oil)
500 g (1 lb) minced (ground) chicken (see note 2 for substitutions)
2 spring onions (scallions), thinly sliced, white and green parts separated, plus extra to garnish
2 cups (150 g) finely shredded green cabbage
1/4 cup (40 g) crushed roasted peanuts, to serve (optional)
Asian chilli oil or chilli crisp, to serve (optional)
steps: – Combine the ingredients together in a small jug or bowl and whisk well to combine. Set aside.

– Bring a large pot of water to the boil and cook the rice noodles until they are just pliable (between 2–3 minutes – they will continue cooking in the stir-fry). Drain, rinse under cold water to stop them cooking, then toss with 1 tablespoon of the oil to stop them sticking. Set aside.

– Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in a large, deep, heavy-based pan or wok over medium–high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 5–6 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through.
– Add the white parts of the spring onion along with the garlic and ginger. Cook for 1 minute. Add the shredded cabbage and cook for 2–3 minutes until softened slightly.

– Pour the peanut curry sauce into the pan with the chicken and cabbage. Stir to combine, then simmer for 1–2 minutes or until slightly thickened. Add the cooked noodles, bean sprouts and green parts of the spring onion, tossing with tongs to coat everything in the sauce. Add the chicken stock gradually (¼ cup/60 ml at a time) to loosen the sauce as needed (you may not need to use all the chicken stock depending on how thick you would like your sauce – the more chicken stock you add, the creamier and silkier the sauce will be).
– Divide among bowls and top with extra spring onion, crushed roasted peanuts and a drizzle of Asian chilli oil or chilli crisp (if using). Serve with lime wedges.

title: Creamy Green Chili Chicken Cornbread Skillet
ingredients: for recipe sent to DMs —or grab recipe below
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.

Lightly coat the chicken breasts with oil, then rub with taco seasoning. Heat an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat, drizzle with oil, and sear the chicken for 3–4 minutes per side. Add the onion and garlic and sauté for 1–2 minutes.

Add the broth, green chiles, & adobo sauce to the skillet. Cover & simmer for 8–10 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the skillet & set aside to cool before shredding.

Meanwhile, make the cornbread. In a bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, & salt. Add the buttermilk, egg, melted butter, green chiles, and green onions. Mix until just combined, then fold in the shredded cheese. Set aside.

Once the chicken has been removed, add the cream cheese and corn to the skillet with the broth. Stir until the cream cheese has melted into the broth. Add the shredded chicken, lime juice, and green onions, stirring to combine. Spread the cornbread batter evenly over the top, almost completely covering the skillet. Top with sliced jalapeños and additional cheese, if desired.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the cornbread is golden brown and cooked through. Serve with a sour cream, avocado, & fresh cilantro.

title: Creamy Sausage Orzo
steps: Cut up a pound of smoked sausage and brown it down.
Add a tablespoon of butter and a spoonful of minced garlic, then let it melt down and mix well until fragrant.

Add two cups of chicken stock, half a cup of heavy cream, and a tablespoon of soy sauce along with all the seasonings: Cajun salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and red pepper flakes (adjust to taste).
Add one full cup of orzo pasta and mix well.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then turn it down to a simmer.
(Optional) Add some sun dried tomatoes once the pasta is cooked.
Add in two cups of chopped spinach and stir well.
Grate some Parmesan cheese off the block and add to the mixture.

title: Creamy Swiss Chicken Bake
steps: In a bowl, add 1 cup sour cream and 1 cup of Mayo.
Season with garlic powder, pepper, and onion powder, or season to your liking.
Add in 1 cup of Parmesan cheese and stir until nice and combined.
In a 9 by 13 baking dish, lay down four chicken breasts and cover each one with Swiss cheese.
Take the sour cream and Mayo mixture and evenly spread it over the top.
Sprinkle some more Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake in a 400 degree oven for 45 minutes.

title: Crispy onion chicken & creamy caramelized onion pasta
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise
steps: Bake chicken at 375 degrees for 10-15 minutes

title: Crispy Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice, cooled (I used jasmine rice)
2 tb chili crisp/crunch (Trader Joe’s makes a good one, I used Momofuku this time!)
5 Persian cucumbers, thinly sliced (or 1 large English cucumber)
1 bunch green onions, thinly sliced (3/4 cup)
steps: Preheat the oven and prepare the crispy rice by spreading the cooked rice on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the rice with soy sauce, chili crisp, and sesame oil, then bake until crispy.
While the rice is baking, season the salmon with garlic powder, salt, and pepper, and place it in the oven to cook.
Once the salmon is cooked, shred it into pieces.
In a bowl, combine the ingredients for the creamy Asian dressing: olive oil, toasted sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, ground ginger, and kosher salt.
Whisk the dressing until well combined.
Prepare the salad by thinly slicing the cucumbers, shelling the edamame, and slicing the green onions.
In a large bowl, combine the crispy rice, shredded salmon, cucumbers, edamame, green onions, and diced avocado.
Drizzle the creamy Asian dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.

title: Crispy Rice Salmon Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice, cooled (I used jasmine rice)
2 tb chili crisp/crunch (Trader Joe’s makes a good one, I used Momofuku this time!)
5 cucumbers, thinly sliced (or 1 large English cucumber)
1 bunch green onions, thinly sliced (3/4 cup)
3 tb soy sauce (or sub coconut aminos)
steps: Preheat oven to 400F.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add cooked and cooled rice to the baking sheet.
Toss well with the soy sauce, chili crisp and sesame oil.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, tossing half way through (just watch to make sure it doesn’t burn).
While the rice is in the oven, season salmon and place it on a baking sheet.
Add to the oven (with the crispy rice) and let bake for 13-14 minutes, or until desired doneness.
Remove the rice the oven and set aside.
Remove the salmon try from the oven, shred into smaller pieces and set aside.
Next, chop/slice all of the ingredients for the salad and add to a large bowl.
Add the shredded salmon and crispy rice on top.
Last, make the dressing.
Whisk to together all of the ingredients for the dressing.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed.
Pour dressing over the salad.
Toss and enjoy!

title: Crispy Sticky Orange Chicken
ingredients: 300 g raw chicken breast (cut into cubes)
150 ml fresh orange juice (you can squeeze from fresh oranges)
120 g cooked white rice per serving
steps: ENJOY!

title: Crock Pot Chili Mac
steps: Start by adding cooked lean ground beef to your Crock Pot.
Add diced tomatoes undrained, chili beans, tomato sauce, and chili seasoning.
Mix all of this together until it is completely combined.
Cover and cook on high for four hours.
After four hours, add in cooked pasta.
Mix this all together until everything is completely combined.
Top with shredded cheddar cheese.
Mix until your cheese is completely melted.

title: Crock Pot Taco Chuck Roast

brown all sides of chuck roast:
combine remaining taco seasoning, onion, garlic and roast in crock pot:
cook on low for 6-8 hours

blend till smooth

title: Crockpot Honey Garlic Chicken & Noodles
steps: Add the soy sauce, sriracha, hoisin sauce, honey, ginger paste, garlic, cornstarch, and chicken stock to the slow cooker. Whisk until well combined and the cornstarch is incorporated.
Add the chicken thighs and turn to coat them in the sauce.
Cover and cook on high for 2-3 hours or low for 4-6 hours, until the chicken is tender and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the slow cooker and shred it using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the slow cooker and stir to coat it in the sauce.
Add the broccoli florets, cover, and cook for another 30 minutes on high until the broccoli is tender to your liking.
Add the cooked udon noodles and gently toss until everything is evenly coated in the sauce and the noodles are warmed through.
Serve topped with sliced green onions, sprinkle of sesame seeds, and an extra drizzle of sriracha or sauce, if desired.

title: Crockpot Queso Chicken
ingredients: sliced limes to squeeze on top
steps: cook on low 6 hours, shred meat

title: Crocktober Day 12: Honey Bourbon Chicken
steps: Start by adding 1.5 to 2 pounds of chicken breast to a 6 quart slow cooker and season them with salt and pepper.

In a small bowl, make the sauce by whisking together 1 cup of honey, 1 cup of low sodium soy sauce, ½ cup of ketchup, 4 tablespoons of olive oil, 2 cloves of minced garlic, ½ cup of diced onion, and ½ teaspoon of red pepper flakes.
Pour the sauce over the chicken in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 3 to 4 hours or high for 1.5 to 2 hours, ensuring the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Once done, take out about ½ cup of the sauce and whisk in 1 tablespoon of cornstarch, then pour it back into the slow cooker and stir.
Let it set for a few minutes to thicken the sauce, if desired.
Serve the chicken over rice with roasted zucchini, and drizzle the extra sauce over the rice or roasted potatoes.

title: Crunchy Chili Crisp Peanut Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup starchy pasta water (saved right before draining!)
steps: Cook & Save: Boil your pasta in salted water. Right before draining, scoop out ¼ cup of that liquid gold starchy pasta water. Drain the pasta well, but do not rinse!

Whisk: Microwave your peanut butter for 15-20 seconds to soften it. Whisk in the soy sauce, lime juice, mild chili crisp, and toasted sesame oil. Slowly whisk in the warm pasta water until the dressing is silky, emulsified, and pourable.
Assemble: Throw your warm pasta, shredded cabbage, cilantro, green onions, bell pepper, cucumber, and carrots right into a large mixing bowl.
Toss: Pour the smooth peanut dressing over the top, add your chopped peanuts and dry roasted edamame, and toss absolutely everything together until perfectly coated!
Enjoy it warm, room temp, or chilled straight from the fridge!

title: Crunchy Tuna Apple Salad
steps: finely chop two stalks of celery
chop one Fuji apple
chop the yellow onion
add the chopped ingredients to a bowl

mix in 1/2 cup of greek yogurt

drizzle with olive oil

title: Date Chocolate Muffins
steps: Heat some water in the microwave until hot enough to soak the dates.
Soak sixteen dates in the hot water for about ten minutes, or until they get super mushy.
Add the soaked dates and eggs to a blender and blend until completely smooth.
In a bowl, add chocolate chips and butter, then microwave in thirty second intervals until smooth.
In another bowl, add one fourth cup of flour and one fourth cup of cocoa powder.
Add the date mixture and the chocolate chip mixture to the flour and cocoa powder, and mix well.
Pour the mixture into a brownie tray or muffin tray (mini muffins recommended).
Bake in the oven at 350°F for twenty five minutes.

title: Dijon Dill Salmon
steps: Start by seasoning the salmon, ensuring it is fresh.
In a bowl, combine Dijon mustard, honey, fresh dill, lemon juice, and minced garlic.
Add a couple dollops of the mixture over the salmon and spread it out evenly with a brush.
Sprinkle panko bread crumbs on top and press them in gently.
Place the salmon in the air fryer for about 8 to 9 minutes.
Make a sauce by combining the remaining Dijon mixture with gently melted butter.
Plate the salmon with fluffy rice and green beans, topping it off with fresh dill and the lemon butter sauce.

title: Double Chocolate Cookie
ingredients: 3 Tbsp liquid sweetener (this could be honey, maple syrup, liquid allulose, or allulose-based maple syrup like RxSugar. My fave is liquid allulose because it has 0 sugar)
1 Tbsp sugar-free chocolate chips (I like Bake Believe or Lily’s)

steps: Chop up a head of romaine.
Add a big heaping spoonful or two of mayonnaise dressing to the bowl.
Squeeze in some garlic paste from the refrigerated section.
Add a squeeze of Dijon mustard.
Add some dashes of red wine vinegar.
Add Worcestershire sauce in a similar amount as the red wine vinegar.
Add a big heaping amount of freshly cracked black pepper.
Grate Pecorino Romano cheese into the dressing.
Toss the lettuce in the dressing.

title: Easy Candied Pecans
steps: Preheat oven to 300 degrees
Pour the pecans into a large bowl. Coat with the egg whites.
Top with both sugars, the cinnamon, and salt. Stir really well to evenly distribute everything.
Spread pecans on a large parchment paper lined baking sheet, and bake at 300° for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, remove the pecans from the oven. Stir them and flip them with a spatula. Put them back in the oven for 20 more minutes. Watch them at the end to make sure they don’t burn.
Remove from the oven, let them cool, and enjoy!

title: easy fudgy crackly top brownies
steps: in a bowl whisk the eggs, egg yolk, powdered sugar and brown sugar vigorously for about 2 mins until smooth and the powdered sugar has completely dissolved (this is how you get the shiny crinkly top!)
then add the melted butter, oil, and coffee powder. whisk until well combined.
add the flour, cocoa powder, and chocolate chips and fold gently using a spatula. do not overmix.

transfer the brownie batter to a parchment lined 8x8 pan and bake in a 350F (180C) preheated oven for 25-30 mins or until edges are set and center still looks a little soft. underbaking is better than overbaking when it comes to brownies.
cool completely before slicing. or put in the fridge to chill for 2-3 hours for best texture!

title: Easy No Bake Homemade Protein Bars — Jazz Leaf
ingredients: 1 cup peanut butter or any nut butter
steps: To create the protein base, in a large mixing bowl, combine the nut butter, protein powder, agave, vanilla and salt. Stir it together until a thick, dough-like consistency is formed. If the mixture is too dry, you can add a bit more nut butter or a splash of water to achieve the desired texture.
Line a loaf pan with parchment paper. Press the protein mixture evenly into the bottom of the pan to form a solid base.

To melt the chocolate, chop the chocolate bar into smaller pieces and add it into a microwave-safe bowl. Add the coconut oil to the chocolate. Microwave the chocolate in 30-second increments, stirring well after each interval, until the chocolate is completely melted and smooth.
Pour the smooth melted chocolate on top of the protein base, and spread it evenly to coat the entire surface.
Place the loaf pan into the freezer to chill and set for 60 minutes until the bars are firm.
Once set, remove from the loaf pan and place it onto a cutting board, slice into 8 equal slices.
Store the protein bars in an airtight container in the fridge for freezer! The fridge will yield a softer texture and the freezer will yield a more firm texture

title: Easy Pumpkin Cobbler in the Slow Cooker
steps: Whisk the 2 large eggs until fluffy.

Add the 2 cans pumpkin puree, 1/2 cup pure maple syrup, 1 tablespoon vanilla extract, 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, and a pinch of salt to the eggs and mix until evenly combined.

In a separate bowl, combine 1 1/2 cups almond flour, 1/2 cup chopped pecans, 1/4 cup maple syrup, 4 tablespoons unrefined coconut oil, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, and a pinch of salt to form a crumbly topping.
Grease the slow cooker dish with 2 teaspoons unrefined coconut oil.
Spread the pumpkin filling into the greased slow cooker dish.
Evenly distribute the streusel topping over the pumpkin filling.
Place a paper towel or towel on top to capture residual moisture.
Cover and cook on high for 2 to 2 1/2 hours until done.

title: Easy Sourdough Brownie Recipe - Apps Rust
ingredients: 1 -quarter cup (40 grammes) of dutched (or ordinary) cocoa powder
steps: Instructions:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (176°C) and line a 9″ x 9″ baking dish with parchment paper.
In a small saucepan over low heat, melt the butter. Stir in the cocoa powder, vanilla essence, and chocolate chips. After stirring until smooth, remove and let cool.
Use an electric mixer to beat the eggs, brown sugar, and granulated sugar for seven to ten minutes in a sizable mixing bowl.
In the bowl, add the chocolate mixture and the sourdough refuse. Beat on low until well blended. Add the flour and salt and stir until barely incorporated.
Smooth the top after adding the batter to the baking dish that has been ready. Bake for 35-40 minutes.
Allow the brownies to cool completely in the pan before removing and cutting into squares.
Storage and Serving:
To Store: Cool completely and store in an airtight container for up to 7 days at room temperature.
To Freeze: Once cooled, wrap individual brownies in plastic wrap and freeze for up to three months.
To Reheat: Thaw if frozen and microwave on high for 10-15 seconds.

title: Easy Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Drizzle olive oil in a pot.
Sauté 1/2 onion and 1 clove garlic until softened.
Add 1 tablespoon of flour and stir for a minute.
Pour in 2 cans of tomatoes and 1/2 cup of chicken broth.
Simmer for a few minutes.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of chopped basil and 1/2 cup of cream.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot.

title: Easy Weeknight Creamy Ravioli
steps: Season your sauce and meat with the same seasonings and enjoy

title: Egg Roll Bowl
steps: Start by sautéing the ground pork (or turkey or chicken).
Add the onions, garlic, ginger, salt, and five spice.
Stir in the shredded carrots.
Add the shredded cabbage and cover for about three minutes.
Stir to incorporate all ingredients together.
Add soy sauce and cover, letting it simmer on low.
After the mixture has simmered for about five to seven minutes, give it a stir.
Add green onions.
Plate your rice and add a heaping spoonful of the egg roll mixture on top.
Drizzle the sauce generously over the top.
Add sesame seeds.

title: Egg White Oatmeal
steps: Combine 1/2 cup oats, 1 cup water, and 1/4 cup egg whites in a bowl.
Whisk the mixture for at least a minute until everything is super combined and you see bubbles.
Add a dash of cinnamon, half a banana, and a tablespoon or two of PB2 to the mixture.
Add any sweetener you prefer, such as honey or maple syrup.
Microwave the mixture for 2 and a half minutes, checking for doneness and adding more time if needed.

title: Fall Cocktail
steps: Combine the Blanco tequila, Cointreau (or triple sec), lime juice, and apple cider in a pitcher or mixing glass.
Stir or shake the mixture until well blended and chilled.
Prepare garnish plates: one with cinnamon sugar and another with lime juice (or agave if desired).
Rim the glass with lime juice and dip it into the cinnamon sugar to coat the edge.
Fill the prepared glass with the cocktail mixture.
Garnish each drink with an apple slice.
Serve and enjoy.

title: Fluffy Vanilla Cupcakes
ingredients: 1 cup (240 g) heavy cream, room temp
steps: Preheat your oven to 350*F.
Line two standard 12-cup cupcake pans with paper liners.
In the bowl of your stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, add the cake flour, ap flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and baking soda and whisk to combine.
Add the heavy cream, oil, buttermilk, eggs, and vanilla.
Mix on low until combined and then scrape the bowl and paddle.
Mix on medium speed for 2 minutes.
Scrape the bowl again and mix on low for another minute.
Divide the batter between the 24 paper liners and bake for 18-20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cupcakes comes out with a few moist crumbs attached.
Cool the cupcakes in the pan for 5 minutes before removing and placing on a cooling rack to cool completely before frosting, about 45 minutes.

title: Football Dip
steps: Mix cream cheese, mayo, and sour cream together.
Add Hidden Valley Ranch dip and chopped fresh jalapenos to the mixture.
Fold in freshly shredded mozzarella cheese and crumbled bacon.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Top with jalapeno slices, cheese, bacon, and green onions.
Bake in the oven on the middle rack until heated through.

title: French Onion Chicken Meatballs & Cheesy Orzo
ingredients: 4 medium sweet Vidalia onions, chopped (about 6 cups)
2 teaspoons kosher salt, divided, plus more to taste
4 cloves garlic, grated or finely chopped
4/3 cups freshly grated Gruyère cheese, divided
1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, plus more for garnish
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.

Caramelize the onions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onions to the pan and season with ½ teaspoon of the salt. Stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onions are very soft and deeply caramelized, 35 to 40 minutes.

Make a well in the center of the onions and add in the balsamic vinegar and garlic. Stir gently until the garlic becomes fragrant, about 30 seconds, then mix together with the onions until well combined. Continue to cook for another 2 to 3 minutes to let the flavors meld.
Transfer ⅓ cup of the onions to a large mixing bowl and set aside cool slightly. Remove the skillet with the remaining onions from the heat.

Make the meatballs: To the large bowl with the reserved onions, add 2 tablespoons of the parsley, ⅓ cup of the grated Gruyère, egg, panko, Dijon, 1 teaspoon of the salt, and ¼ teaspoon of the pepper and mix well. Add in the ground chicken and use your hands to mix until well combined. Use a 2-tablespoon cookie scoop or tablespoon measure to portion the mixture into balls (about 18–20 meatballs) and place them onto the prepared baking sheet. Use your hands to roll each meatball until smooth, and spray the tops lightly with nonstick cooking spray.

Transfer the meatballs to the oven to bake until cooked through, 10 to 12 minutes. Then turn the broiler on high and cook until golden brown on top, about 2 minutes. Keep an eye on them as everyone’s broilers vary!

Cook the Orzo: Meanwhile, return the skillet with the remaining onions back up to medium-high. Once sizzling, add the orzo and stir to combine. Add the chicken stock, thyme, ½ teaspoon of the salt, and ¼ teaspoon of the pepper. Raise the heat to high and bring the mixture to a boil, scraping any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Once boiling, reduce the heat to medium-low to maintain a gentle simmer, and cook, stirring occasionally, until the orzo is al dente and most of the liquid has been absorbed, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the remaining 1 cup of Gruyère until melted and creamy. Remove from heat and taste to adjust for seasoning if desired.

Nestle the cooked meatballs into the orzo mixture. Garnish with the remaining chopped parsley and a few cracks of black pepper. Serve family style straight out of the skillet, or divide evenly among serving bowls.

title: French Onion Meatball Skillet
ingredients: 4 head garlic cloves, peeled and minced
2 tbsp finely chopped thyme leaves (or 2 tsp dried thyme)
2 tbsp coconut aminos (sub tamari or reduced-sodium soy sauce)
3/4 cup shredded gruyere or mozzarella cheese
1 tbsp coconut aminos (sub tamari or low-sodium soy sauce)
1 tsp kosher salt (omit if using tamari)
steps: Preheat oven to 400F. Line a large sheet pan with parchment paper.

Heat the olive oil in a large, deep, lidded skillet over medium heat. Once the oil is heated and shimmering, add the sliced onions. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onions are very soft and caramelizing, 15 to 18 minutes (Note: if the onions start getting too browned, reduce heat to medium low until done caramelizing and add another tablespoon of oil.)

While the onions caramelize, combine the ground beef, coconut aminos, garlic powder, and black pepper in a large bowl. Form about 18 two-tablespoon meatballs with lightly oil clean hands and place on the sheet pan, evenly spaced. Bake until at an internal temperature of 160F, 11 to 13 minutes.

Add the garlic, thyme, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and continue cooking over medium heat until aromatic, 1 to 2 minutes. Add the rice and toast, stirring frequently, until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Pour in the broth, coconut aminos, and 1/2 cup of water and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to medium low, cover, and cook until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is fluffy, 16 to 19 minutes, stirring halfway through to prevent sticking. If needed, add an additional 1/2 cup of water if it needs more when you stir halfway through.

Reduce the heat to low, remove the lid, and place the meatballs on top of the rice. Sprinkle the mozzarella on top and cover to melt the cheese, 1 to 2 minutes (or transfer the skillet uncovered to the oven and broil on high for 1 to 2 minutes) . Remove the skillet from the heat, top with chopped parsley, and serve.

title: French Onion Pot Roast With Maple Garlic Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and chopped
steps: Sear the roast.
Preheat oven to 325°F. Season the chuck roast generously with Kinder’s Sunday Pot Roast Seasoning.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the roast on all sides until browned. Remove and set aside.
Caramelize the onions.
Add butter and sliced onions to the same Dutch oven.
Cook over medium-low heat for 20–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the onions are soft, golden and caramelized.
Build the sauce.
Add tomato paste and garlic. Cook for about 1 minute.
Pour in the red wine and Worcestershire sauce. Stir and scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Let simmer for a few minutes until slightly reduced.
Slow cook the roast.
Pour in the beef broth and return the chuck roast to the Dutch oven.
Cover and bake at 325°F for about 4 hours, or until the meat easily falls apart with a fork.
Make the maple garlic mashed potatoes.:
Boil potatoes in salted water until fork-tender. Drain well.
Add potatoes, butter, sour cream, cream, garlic and maple syrup to a stand mixer. Mix until creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Shred + assemble.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and shred the roast directly into the French onion gravy.

title: Fudgy Chocolate Chia Pudding
steps: Instructions for both on the bl0g.

title: FUDGY DATE BROWNIE BALLS 🤎🍫
ingredients: 3/4 cup almond flour or oat flour
steps: Blend (immersion blender) dates, almond flour, cocoa powder, nut butter + sea salt until sticky and smooth.
Roll into bite-sized balls. Freeze 20 minutes to firm.
Melt dark chocolate + coconut oil until smooth.
Dip each ball, place on parchment, and chill until set.

title: Garlic Zucchini Chicken Bowls
ingredients: 1 /s cup low sodium soy sauce or tamari
1 lb ground chicken (I like thigh meat)
steps: Prepare rice according to package instructions and set aside. Preheat oven to 400F. Dice zucchini into bite sized pieces. Transfer to one large baking sheet. Drizzle olive oil on top, toss and add a pinch of salt. Bake for 15-20 minutes, mixing at the halfway point, then broil for 2 minutes at the end to get some slightly crispy edges.

Remove the zucchini from the oven and let cool. While the zucchini is in the oven, you will work on everything else. In a bowl, whisk together the maple syrup, soy sauce, tomato paste, rice vinegar, sesame oil, garlic and crushed red pepper flakes. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.

Add olive oil. Once the pan is hot, add the ground chicken, breaking it down into tiny pieces. Once the chicken is cooked through, pour in the sauce. Continue to cook until most of the liquid is absorbed. Stir in the green onions and sesame seeds. Remove from heat and assemble bowls, with the rice on the bottom, roasted zucchini on one side and the chicken on the other side. Garnish with additional green onion and enjoy!

title: Giant Crispy Ground Chicken Pizzas
steps: Combine your ground chicken with some seasonings.
Form three thin round discs and sprinkle with flour.
Egg wash lots of panko bread crumbs and spray with olive oil.
Flip the pan over and repeat on the other side.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Top with marinara, fresh mozzarella and pesto to melt.

title: Ginger Chuck Roast
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, halved and sliced thin
steps: Oven Method:
Set the roast on the counter for 30 minutes before preparing. Preheat the oven to 300 F.
Trim some of the excess fat from the roast and slice into large chunks. Season well on all sides with salt and pepper and coconut sugar.
Using a large dutch oven, heat the avocado oil over medium heat. Once the oil is shimmering, add the chuck roast. Sear on all sides to lightly brown. Set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and add the sliced onion. Lightly season with salt and pepper, sauteing for 3-4 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger and saute for another 2 minutes, or until fragrant/
Add the chuck roast back to the pot along with the broth, coconut aminos and rice vinegar. Place the lid on the pot and transfer to the oven.
Allow to cook in the oven for 3.5 - 4 hours, or until the meat easily shreds. Start to check the meat at around 2.5-3 hours! Remove from the oven once cooked.
Whisk 2 tbsp of arrowroot starch with about 3 tbsp of water (or beef broth) and add it to the pot roast, stirring it into the liquid to thicken.
Allow to rest for 10-15 minutes before serving with a side of your choice like rice and vegetables.
For the slow cooker method:
Follow steps 2-4 above.
Add the vegetables and roast to the slow cooker along with the broth, coconut aminos and rice vinegar. Cook on low for 6-8 hours, or until the roast easily shreds.
Whisk 2 tbsp of arrowroot starch with about 3 tbsp of water (or beef broth) and add it to the pot roast, stirring it into the liquid to thicken.
Allow to rest for 10-15 minutes before serving with a side of your choice like rice and vegetables.

title: Gluten Dairy Free Breakfast Burrito
steps: Use a gluten and dairy-free burrito-sized tortilla.
Prepare soft, scrambled eggs.
Cook crispy hash browns.
Cook bacon.
Slice avocado.
Mix dairy-free cream cheese with jalapeno and garlic.
Assemble the burrito by layering the scrambled eggs, crispy hash browns, bacon, avocado, and the cream cheese mixture in the tortilla.

title: Gooey Caramel Date Overnight Oats
steps: top with crushed up walnuts or pecans when ready to eat*
Shake it up, cover with an airtight lid, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or up to several days.

title: Greatest Protein Pancake Recipe
steps: Combine equal parts oats, cottage cheese, and egg whites in a mixing bowl.
Blend the mixture until smooth.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour the batter onto the skillet to form pancakes.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface, then flip and cook until golden brown on the other side.
Serve with syrup or chocolate chips if desired.

title: Greek Chicken Orzo Bowls
ingredients: 1 lb skinless chicken breast (if they are very thick, slice them in half)
1 cup tzatziki (store bought or make MY recipe on the blog!)
steps: Cook orzo according to instructions on the box and set aside. Next, marinate the chicken. Add chicken to a bowl and coat with the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, thyme, mustard and salt. Cover and marinate at least 30 minutes. Add 1 td of olive oil to a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot (very important), add the chicken. Do not touch for 5-6 min. Gently flip to the other side and pour the marinade into the pan, for extra flavor and to keep the chicken moist. Do not touch the chicken again. After 5 minutes, reduce heat to LOW and spoon the marinade over the chicken. Cover and let the chicken finish cooking, about 5 more min or until the internal temp is 165F. Remove from heat and let rest before slicing for the bowls. Meanwhile, cut tomatoes and cucumbers and toss with olive oil, lemon juice & salt. Last, assemble your bowls, with orzo on the bottom, salad next, chicken, and tzatziki. Add pickled onions and crumbled feta. Garnish with parsley and enjoy!

title: Ground Beef Tortilla Roll Ups
steps: Combine some ground meat, onion, bell pepper, shredded cheese, olive oil and seasonings.
Spread the mixture into burrito sized tortillas.
Slice them into small rolls and bake for 25 minutes.
Add on some more cheese to melt.

title: Healthier Honey Joys
ingredients: 1 tbsp Unrefined Nutrients Kids Immune Protein (Vanilla Vanguard)
steps: Preheat the oven to 150°C fan-forced and line a 12-hole mini muffin tray with mini paper cases. You can also use regular muffin trays or a lined baking tray.
In a small saucepan, gently melt the butter and honey until just combined. Do not allow the mixture to boil.
Remove from the heat and stir in the vanilla extract and salt, if using.
Place the cornflakes and desiccated coconut in a large bowl.
Pour the honey mixture over the cornflakes and gently fold until evenly coated.
Spoon the mixture into the mini cases and lightly press down.
Bake for 8 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Allow to cool completely in the tray to crisp up before serving.
Don't skip the cooling step — the honey joys firm up and develop their signature crunch as they cool in the tray. Resist the urge to eat them warm!

1/2 cup maple syrup (or 6 dates, pitted and soaked in hot water for 15 min)

line a 8x8 baking dish with parchment paper and pour batter into dish
top with chocolate chips
bake on 350F for 23-25min
let completely cool before cutting into brownies

ingredients: About 1/3 cup breadcrumbs OR shredded cheese
steps: Steam or boil the broccoli + carrots until soft, then mash them up. Mix with the ground chicken, egg, seasonings and breadcrumbs or cheese.
Form into little nuggets and place on a sprayed baking sheet—or preferably parchment paper. Bake at 375°F for about 35 minutes, flipping halfway through.

title: High Protein French Toast Bake
steps: Start by adding four eggs to each dish.
Add three tablespoons of egg whites to each dish.

Add a teaspoon of cinnamon and a tablespoon of Greek yogurt to each dish.
Add a teaspoon of vanilla extract to each dish.

Press each piece of toast down into the mixture to soak up the ingredients.
Pop these in the oven at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: High Protein Ground Beef Mongolian Noodles
steps: Start off by boiling some pasta until al dente.
In a pan on high heat, sear some lean ground beef, pressing it into the pan and seasoning it with salt and pepper.
Only flip the beef after a few minutes when it develops a beautiful golden brown crust.
Add garlic and ginger and cook for a few more minutes.
Add brown sugar, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, beef broth, and optionally red chili flakes.
Let that cook for a few more minutes before adding a cornstarch slurry to thicken it up.
Add the noodles and mix everything together until combined.
Serve it up with some green onions.

steps: Add fresh mint and elderflower liqueur to a wine glass. Gently muddle.

title: Homemade Cookie Butter Coffee Syrup Recipe
steps: Brown the butter until it’s golden and nutty, typically 5–10 minutes over medium heat. Then add the coconut sugar and whisk until fully cover in butter. Carefully add the water while whisking.
Add the allulose and stir until both sugars are dissolved.
Next, add the cinnamon sticks, cloves ginger, nutmeg and molasses. Simmer gently for 10ish minutes.

Remove from heat and let it cool for about 10 minutes. Add vanilla bean paste and butter extract. Allow to steep with the spices for 30-60 minutes. Before storing, remove the cinnamon sticks and cloves.

I start with 30g of syrup in a double shot iced latte. Adjust from there depending on how sweet you want it. My picky husband like it a bit sweeter (closer to 40g). It gives you that warm, spiced cookie flavor without needing a ton of syrup.
Store it in a sealed jar or bottle in the fridge. Give it a good shake before using since we’re working with real browned butter here.

title: Homemade Hot Pockets
steps: Chop the deli ham into bite-sized pieces.
Unroll the puff pastry and cut it into 8 rectangles.
On the bottom half of each rectangle, spread a little honey mustard, avoiding the edges.
Add a small amount of chopped ham on top of the honey mustard.
Place a piece of shredded cheddar cheese and a piece of American cheese on top of the ham.
Fold the top half of the rectangle over the filling and crimp the edges with a fork to seal.
Place the filled pockets on a baking sheet.
(Optional) Beat an egg with a little water to create an egg wash and brush it over the top of the pockets.
Bake in a 400 degree oven for about 15 minutes.

title: Honey Teriyaki Chicken
ingredients: 1360 g (48 oz) boneless skinless chicken thighs

Mix in a small bowl, add after chicken is done and let sit uncovered for 15- 20 mins. Salt, pepper, garlic powder to taste
steps: Toss boneless, skinless chicken thighs in your slow cooker along with soy sauce, dark soy sauce, honey, mirin, ginger paste, and garlic paste.
Cook on high for 4-5 hours or low for 5+ hours until the chicken is cooked through.
In a small bowl, mix cornstarch and cold water to create a slurry. Add this to the slow cooker after the chicken is done and let sit uncovered for 15-20 minutes.
Prepare the rice by cooking 480g of short grain or sushi rice according to package instructions.
For the low-cal Yum Yum sauce, mix low-fat mayo, Greek yogurt, sriracha, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and milk in a bowl until desired consistency is reached.
Chop the green onions for garnish.
Serve the chicken over the rice and drizzle with the Yum Yum sauce. Enjoy your meal prep!

title: Hot Honey Chicken Plate
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs, cut into bite sized pieces
1 lb sweet potatoes (2 medium sweet potatoes, cubed)
1 tsp red pepper flakes & 1/2 tsp kosher salt
steps: Preheat oven to 400F. Toss sweet potatoes with oil and seasonings. Place on a baking sheet and bake 35-40 minutes until crispy, giving them a toss at the halfway mark. Next, add chicken pieces to a bowl and toss with oil and seasonings. Cook chicken in a large skillet over medium heat until blackened and cooked through. Cook quinoa—add quinoa and broth to a small pot. Bring to a gentle boil, then cover and turn heat to low for 15 min. Remove cover and fluff. Make dressing by whisking together all of the ingredients. Last, make the slaw—add shredded cabbage and carrots to a bowl. Toss with remaining dressing ingredients. Last, build your bowls. Pour hot honey dressing on top and enjoy!⁣

title: Hot Honey Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 cup shredded or rotisserie chicken (I did 3 breasts, and made more dressing)

title: How to Make the Perfectly Flaky and Buttery Homemade Pie Crust
ingredients: about 5 to 6 tablespoons ice cold water
steps: In your food processor, add the flour, salt and sugar. Pulse a couple of times so that the dry ingredients are mixed together. If not using a food processor, combine all the dry ingredients in a bowl.

Add the cubed butter and pulse a few times until incorporated. You need the butter in little pea-size small clumps. If not using a food processor, cut the butter in small pieces with the tip of a knife, mixing with the flour, until you get a coarse mixture.

Add about 4 tablespoons of chilled water. I placed half glass of water in the freezer before starting with the recipe. Pulse only a few times, (or mix with a spoon if not using a food processor) and check the dough. You need to stop as soon as the dough comes together in a ball. Do not over-mix. Add a little more water if necessary. I added two more tablespoons of water (total of 6).
Pack the dough into a disc using your hand and wrap in plastic wrap. Refrigerate for one hour or longer. You can prepare the dough the day before too, and leave it in the refrigerator overnight.

Roll the dough on a clean surface sprinkled with flour, into a circle of about 12 inches (30 cm) in diameter. Make sure the dough doesn't stick to the counter when you roll it, so flip it and move it around.

Transfer the dough to a 9 inches pie pan, helping yourself with the rolling pin. Cover the pan with the dough pushing gently the dough down to the bottom, without stretching it. Trim off the excess pastry around the edges, leaving about one inch all around.

Fold back the edge, toward the outside of the pan, And if you like, make a fluted edge. Using your finger index on one hand, push the dough through the index and middle fingers of your other hand, as shown in my picture.
Prick the bottom of the crust with a fork Store in the refrigerator while preparing the filling!

title: Hugo Spritz Margarita
steps: Swipe a lime wedge along the rim of a glass. Sprinkle with salt. Place your glass in the freezer to set.
Add fresh mint and lime juice to a cocktail shaker. Gently muddle.
Add tequila, elderflower liqueur, and Fancy edible glitter. Add ice, then shake until chilled.

title: Ina Garten's Chicken Thighs with Creamy Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 8 bone and skin on chicken thighs
steps: Pat the chicken dry on both sides and generously salt and pepper both sides.
Heat a tablespoon of olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chicken thighs, skin side down, and cook undisturbed for about 15 minutes on each side.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add two cups of sliced onions to the same pan and let them caramelize.

Once the onions are caramelized, add about two tablespoons of white wine, eight ounces of creme fresh, a tablespoon of Dijon mustard, a teaspoon of whole grain mustard, and a teaspoon of salt to the pan with the onions.
Stir for about a minute with the caramelized onions.
Return the chicken back to the pan along with the juices and finish with some chopped parsley.

title: Jalapeno Cheddar Burgers
steps: Dice half an onion into small pieces.
Mix together ground chicken, diced onion, cumin, paprika, chili powder, and diced jalapenos.
Form the mixture into small patties.
Cover the patties and refrigerate until ready to grill.
Grill the burgers until cooked through.

steps: Mix everything except the graham crackers until well combined.
Refrigerate for at least 2-4 hours or overnight, until thickened. Stir, portion into jars, and top with crushed graham crackers, extra yogurt, and fresh lime zest.

title: Lasagna
steps: Start with one pound of ground chuck and a pound of sweet Italian sausage. Add a diced onion and cook the pink out of the meat. Strain the fat, add six cloves of minced garlic back to the pan, and then your meat and onions. Cook on low until caramelized. Add in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, tomato sauce, and water, then stir. Add in seasoning, sugar, and fresh chopped parsley. Stir, cover, and simmer for at least 60 minutes. While the sauce cooks, make the ricotta mixture and set aside. To assemble, add sauce to a nine-by-13 dish, cooked lasagna noodles, more sauce, all the ricotta mixture, sliced mozzarella, shredded mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese. Repeat the layers with noodles, sauce, sliced mozzarella, shredded mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375 for 30 minutes covered and then 30 minutes uncovered.

title: Lazy Queso
steps: Add yellow and white American cheese to your pan, shredded by yourself.

Pour on the heavy cream.

Bake until gooey.

title: Lemon Butter Zucchini Pasta

4 cups low sodium chicken or vegetable broth
1/2 cup shredded gouda or fontina cheese
steps: Start by making the garlic butter sauce with salted butter, chopped shallots, and chopped garlic.
Add fresh thyme leaves and red pepper flakes to the sauce.
Incorporate the short cut pasta and pour in the low sodium chicken or vegetable broth.
Add the grated zucchini or yellow summer squash to the pot and stir everything together.
Allow the mixture to cook until the pasta is tender and the zucchini is cooked through.
Stir in the whole milk ricotta cheese until creamy and well combined.
Finish by adding shredded gouda or fontina cheese and roughly chopped fresh basil before serving.

title: Lemony Chicken Thighs Bake
steps: Brown seasoned chicken thighs in a pan.
Sauté an onion and garlic in the same pan.
Add a cup of rice and toast it in the pan.
Season with salt and pepper.
Pour in a cup of chicken broth.
Mix everything well.
Add the juice of a lemon and chopped kale leaves.
Stir in some coconut milk for creaminess.
Place the chicken thighs on top of the mixture.
Bake in the oven for about 15 to 20 minutes until the rice is cooked.

title: Magic Breakfast Enchiladas
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Chop the medium onion and red peppers, and set aside.
Cook the breakfast sausage in a pan until browned, stirring occasionally.
Add the hash brown mix to the sausage and cook until warmed up and mixed together.
In a separate bowl, crack the eggs and whisk them together with salt, pepper, cream, and half of the green enchilada sauce.
Scoop some of the egg mixture into a tortilla, sprinkle with cheese, and roll it up seam side down in a greased pan.
Repeat until all tortillas are filled and rolled.
Pour the remaining egg mixture over the rolled enchiladas.
Sprinkle the leftover cheese on top of the enchiladas.
Pour the rest of the enchilada sauce over the top.
Bake uncovered for 45 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the top is golden.

title: Man-Pleasing Chicken
steps: preheat oven to 450°F.
In a small bowl, whisk mustard, maple syrup, and vinegar together. Pat chicken dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
Place chicken in a greased or foil-lined baking dish (I prefer foil because the sauce can get sticky and baked on!)

title: Marry Me Chocolate Chip
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) light brown sugar firmly packed

steps: Get your pan nice and warm and melt two sticks of butter. Once it's completely melted, put the butter into its own bowl and let it start to cool off. In a separate bowl, mix 340 grams of all-purpose flour, one teaspoon of baking powder, one teaspoon of baking soda, and three-fourths teaspoon of salt. In another bowl, add 200 grams of light brown sugar, 133 grams of granulated sugar, two egg yolks, 1 ½ teaspoons of vanilla extract, and 140 grams of sourdough discard. Stir in the melted butter. Preheat your oven to 350°F and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, taking them out while they still look a little bit raw in the middle. Enjoy.

title: Mediterranean Chicken Pasta
ingredients: As much parmesan as your heart desires
steps: In a large skillet, heat up olive oil over medium heat. In the meantime, season the chicken with a pinch of salt, pepper and oregano. Sear a couple minutes each side till nice and golden, then remove from heat. Add onion, scrape any chicken pieces then add butter. Once melted add white wine. If skipping, proceed by slightly caramelizing the onions by stirring every 5 minutes for 25-30 minutes on low. Add minced garlic, sun dried tomatoes and dry pasta. Toast for 2 minutes then add chicken broth till the pasta is entirely covered. Simmer on medium low till the broth is almost completely evaporated. Add heavy cream, spices and lemon zest. Stir then add chicken and let it cook another 2-3 minutes then turn off heat. Top with spinach, Parmesan and parsley. Serve and enjoy!

title: Naturally Leavened Bread
steps: You'll need an active bubbly starter at its peak on a digital scale.
Place your bowl on the scale and zero it out.
Add 250 grams of active starter.
Zero out your scale again and add 725 grams of warm filtered water.
Remove the bowl from the scale and mix the starter and water together.
Put the bowl back on the scale and zero it out.
Add 25 grams of salt.
Zero out your scale again and add 1,000 grams of unbleached all-purpose flour.
Mix until there are no bits of flour left and it turns into a shaggy dough.
Scrape down the sides of the bowl and cover it with a plate or kitchen towel.
Let it sit on the counter for one hour.
After an hour, perform the first round of stretch and folds by pulling up one side of the dough and folding it over.
Repeat this process around the bowl about 10 times.
Cover the dough and let it rest for another 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, perform the second round of stretch and folds.
Cover the dough and let it rest for another 30 minutes.
After another 30 minutes, perform the third round of stretch and folds.
Cover the dough and let it rest for another 30 minutes.
After the final 30 minutes, perform the fourth round of stretch and folds.
Cover the dough and let it bulk ferment for about two hours.
Once the dough has risen significantly, add flour to your surface and pour the dough onto it.
Cut the dough in half to shape two loaves.
For the first shape, stretch the dough, fold it over, roll it up, and shape it into a round ball.
Let it rest on the counter for 20 minutes.
For the final shape, flip the dough over, stretch it gently, fold it, and roll it into a round ball again.
Flip it into a banneton and cover it with a kitchen towel.
Place it in the fridge to proof for two hours.
After two hours, flip the dough onto parchment paper and score it.
Preheat your Dutch ovens to 500 degrees and place them in the oven for 20 minutes.
Bake at 500 degrees for 35 minutes, then remove the tops and bake for an additional 10 minutes at 425 degrees.
Enjoy your beautiful, crispy naturally leavened bread.

title: New York Crumb Cake
steps: Make the crumb topping by combining melted butter, brown sugar, flour, cinnamon, and salt until it forms a thick mixture. Set aside.
Place a whisk attachment onto your stand mixer.
Add softened butter and vegetable oil to the mixer and whip until pale and almost pearly white.
Add granulated sugar and whip until combined.
Add an egg, egg white, and vanilla extract and beat until fluffy.
In a separate bowl, mix all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until combined.
Alternate adding half the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, then add sour cream and milk, mixing until combined.
Add the remaining dry ingredients and mix until just incorporated.
Pour the batter into a parchment lined 8 by 8 pan and spread it to the edges.
Take the crumb topping and squeeze it between your palms over the batter, breaking it into chunks.
Gently pat the crumb topping to help it settle into the cake.
Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for about 35 minutes until golden brown and a knife comes out clean.
Dust with powdered sugar before serving.

steps: Remove the skin from the salmon and finely mince it.
Place the minced salmon into a bowl.
Chop up some scallions and add them to the bowl.

Form the mixture into burger shapes.
Heat a pan and sear the salmon burgers until a beautiful crust forms.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookie Recipe
ingredients: (Makes about 3 dozen cookies) 2 cups butter, softened (not melted)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a large bowl or mixer, cream together the softened butter, brown sugar, and white sugar until smooth and creamy.
Add eggs, egg yolks, and vanilla; mix until fully combined.
Add flour, oats, baking soda, baking powder, and salt. Mix just until incorporated.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Scoop dough using a large cookie scoop (about 3 tablespoons) and place on a baking sheet, spacing evenly.
Bake for 11 minutes. Cookies will look slightly underbaked in the center — that’s exactly what keeps them soft.
Let cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

1 1/2 cup (250 g) dark chocolate chips or chunks
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Add olive oil, almond butter, coconut sugar, eggs and vanilla extract to a bowl and mix well.
Mix in flour, oats, baking soda and salt until fully incorporated then fold in chocolate chunks.
Spread cookie dough in an even layer in a 9x9 greased or parchment lined baking dish, then top with extra chocolate chunks, if desired.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until the center is set and the edges are crispy.
Sprinkle with flaky sea salt and allow bars to cool before slicing.

title: Old Fashioned Loaf
steps: Preheat 375°F. Line 2 loaf pans.
Whisk dry.
Whisk wet.
Combine until smooth.
Divide between pans, smooth tops.
Bake 12 min, reduce to 325°F, bake 40–55 min.
Bake until moist crumbs / 200–203°F internal temp.

ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs (680 g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs
Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp onion powder, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp allspice, 2 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt
3 tbsp butter 1 1/2 cups yellow onion, diced
1 tbsp turmeric, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp pepper
1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper & 2 tsp sumac
1/4 cup mayonnaise 1/4 cup plain Greek yogurt
2 to 3 garlic cloves 1 tbsp fresh parsley
steps: In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and Better Than Bouillon. Mix well. Marinate for as long as your patience can handle.
Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside.

Reduce heat to medium-low. Add butter to the same pan then the onions & cook, stirring often, until translucent. Add the garlic & spices, cook for 1 to 2 mins. Add the rice and toast for 2 mins while stirring. Pour in the hot water mixed with Better Than Bouillon. Stir & bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover & reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20 mins until cooked.
Mix the salad ingredients in one bowl and the sauce ingredients in another bowl. Enjoy!

Bake 9–11 min

title: Peanut Butter Fudge Iced Brownies
steps: Prepare a box of brownies according to the package directions, using an 8 by 8 pan or double the recipe for a 9 by 13 pan.
Line the pan with parchment paper for easy removal after baking.
Mix 1 and 1/2 cups of sugar, 7 tablespoons of milk, 2 tablespoons of shortening, and 1/4 teaspoon of salt in a heavy saucepan over medium heat.
Add 2 tablespoons of margarine and mix until melted and combined.
Allow the mixture to come to a boil, then set a timer for 2 minutes without stirring.
After 2 minutes, turn off the heat and add 1/2 cup of creamy peanut butter and 1 teaspoon of vanilla, stirring to combine.
Pour the peanut butter fudge over the brownies in the pan and let it sit on the counter for about 1 to 2 hours to cool before cutting.

title: Peanut Butter Oreo Pie
steps: Grab a 9 by 13 pan and a package of Oreos.
Crush the Oreos as finely as possible using hands and a rolling pin or a food processor.
Dump the crushed Oreos into the No. 13 pan.
Melt one stick of butter and pour it into the crushed Oreos, mixing well.
Press the mixture down with a spatula and place it in the freezer.
In a large bowl, add two blocks of softened cream cheese, two cups of powdered sugar, and two cups of creamy peanut butter.
Use an electric mixer to mix the ingredients well.
Grab a 16 ounce container of Cool Whip and fold half of it into the peanut butter mixture.
Remove the Oreo crust from the freezer and scoop the peanut butter mixture on top, smoothing it out.
Add the rest of the Cool Whip on top of the peanut butter mixture.
Heat around a fourth of a cup of peanut butter in the microwave for 30 seconds to a minute until runny.
Top the pie with mini Oreos and chopped Reese's, then drizzle the heated peanut butter on top.
Let the pie sit in the refrigerator for a couple of hours before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Crush the entire package of Reese's Oreos in a blender until fine crumbs.
Mix the Oreo crumbs with 5 tablespoons melted butter and press the mixture into the bottom of a springform pan; chill to harden.
In a mixer, combine the two 8‑ounce blocks of cream cheese, 3 cups peanut butter, vanilla, powdered sugar, and 1.5 cups heavy cream; mix until smooth.
Spread the peanut butter filling over the chilled crust and smooth the top; freeze for about 15 minutes.
Heat 3/4 cup heavy cream in a saucepan until it just begins to simmer, then remove from heat.
Stir in 8 ounces milk chocolate chips until the ganache is smooth.
Pour the chocolate ganache over the frozen filling and smooth the surface.
Refrigerate the pie for several hours until set before serving.

Pour the batter into a preheated 350-degree oven and bake for about 25 minutes.

In a high speed blender add cottage cheese, milk, oil, honey, eggs and vanilla. Blend until smooth.

title: Queen Ina Gardens Giant Crinkle Cookie
steps: Soften the butter quickly in the microwave.

In a separate bowl combine the flour, baking soda, and salt; then gradually add to the wet mixture, mixing just until incorporated.
Fold in the chopped chocolate bars, being careful not to over‑mix.
Scoop the dough into large 2½‑inch balls and place on a baking sheet; freeze for exactly 15 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Bake the frozen dough balls for 10 minutes, then remove and “slam” (press) each cookie to create a crackled surface.
Return the cookies to the oven and bake for an additional 3 minutes.
Repeat the slamming and baking steps once more for extra texture, then allow cookies to cool.

Transfer the ricotta mixture to a ziploc bag and pipe it onto the toasted rounds.
Finish with lemon zest, fresh basil ribbons, and a drizzle of olive oil or honey.

title: Roast Chicken
steps: Fill your baking dish with whatever veggies you want — I did baby potatoes, carrots & onion. Fill the chicken cavity with a halved lemon, quartered onion & a head of garlic with the top cut off. Feel free to add fresh herbs if you’re feeling fancy!
Rub the chicken with olive oil or butter and season generously with salt & pepper (plus whatever seasonings you love!).
Roast at 425° for about 1–1½ hours, or until the thickest part of the thigh reaches 165°. If it starts getting too brown before it’s cooked through, tent it with foil.

title: Roasted Tomato Soup
ingredients: 6 medium tomatoes (roma or campari work great, you can also sub 2 pints of cherry tomatoes)
2 full bulbs of garlic, chop off the tip

Dried Italian seasoning to hearts content (basil, oregano, thyme, parsley)
Fresh basil or parsley, for serving
steps: Preheat oven: to 400 °F (200 °C).
Roast the veggies: toss tomatoes, onion, garlic, carrots, and bell pepper on a parchment lined sheet pan. Top with olive oil, salt and pepper. Roast for 35-40 minutes

Pull out the garlic heads and transfer roasted veggies to a pot (or a blender if you don’t have an immersion blender). Once the garlic has cooled slightly, squeeze the roasted cloves out of their skins and add them to the pot. Add cannellini beans, tomato paste, cottage cheese, and broth. Blend until completely smooth and creamy
Taste and adjust: add more salt, pepper, or herbs as needed.
Serve: pour into bowls, top with cream, olive oil, sea salt, and fresh basil. Enjoy with warm grilled cheese!!

title: Salmon and potato nuggets

Combine potato, cheese, salmon paste, and garlic powder.
Shape into nuggets or tots.
Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Salmon Veggie Patties
steps: put everything in the food processor and blend.
form patties and bake at 350 for 20-30 minutes.

title: Same Day Sourdough Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 12 grams honey (or 12 grams sugar as a substitute)
500 grams unbleached flour (all-purpose or bread flour)
steps: Grab a bowl and a digital scale.
Start with 125 grams of active bubbly starter.
Add 325 grams of warm filtered water and mix until most of the starter is dissolved.
Zero out your scale and add 12 grams of extra virgin olive oil.
Zero out your scale again and add 12 grams of honey (or sugar if preferred).
Zero out your scale once more and add 500 grams of unbleached flour.
Zero out your scale again and add 12 grams of salt.
Mix the dough by hand until it comes together and has a consistent feel, about three minutes.
Scrape down the sides of the bowl to gather all the dough in the middle.
Cover the bowl with a kitchen towel and let it rest for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, perform the first set of stretching folds by pulling one side of the dough up and folding it over the middle. Repeat this around the bowl four times.
Cover the bowl and let it rest for another 30 minutes.
Repeat the stretching folds for the second set, covering the bowl afterward and resting for another 30 minutes.
Perform the third set of stretching folds, cover the bowl, and let it rest for another 30 minutes.
For the final set of stretching folds, cover the bowl again and let it rise at room temperature for about three to four hours, until it is almost doubled in size.
Once the dough has risen, pour it out onto a floured counter and shape it into a rectangle, popping any air bubbles.
Fold the sides of the rectangle into the middle, then roll it up tightly from one end.
Tuck the ends under to seal and create tension in the loaf using a bench scraper or your hands.
Place the seam side down in a greased 9 by 5 loaf pan.
Cover and let it proof at room temperature for two hours, or until it fills the pan and rises slightly above the edge.
Preheat your oven to 375 degrees.
Once proofed, bake the loaf for about 35 minutes, until golden brown.
After baking, rub the top with butter and let it cool for about 30 minutes before slicing.

title: Sarsaparilla Spritz
steps: Start off with ice in a glass.
Add a mixture of mango and passion fruit to the glass.
Pour in Prosecco until it looks visually appealing.
Top it off with a little bit of club soda.
