title: Save for later!! Perfect easy crockpot dessert 🍎
steps: In a bowl, toss the apples with granulated sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Place them in the crockpot.
In another bowl, combine brown sugar, oats, flour, and salt. Cut in the cold butter until the mixture is crumbly.
Sprinkle the crumble topping evenly over the apples.
Cook on HIGH for 2½–3 hours or LOW for 4–5 hours, until the apples are soft and the topping is golden.
Serve with ice cream or yogurt!

title: Sheet pan chocolate chip cookie bars with red, white & blue m&m’s + sprinkles for the EASIEST 4th of July treat!
steps: Sheet pan chocolate chip cookie bars with red, white & blue m&m’s + sprinkles for the EASIEST 4th of July treat!
Preheat oven to 325 F. Spray a half sheet pan (18’x13’) with cooking spray, you can also line with parchment paper, although it makes it harder to spread.
In a medium bowl, stir together melted butter and both sugars until combined. Add eggs and vanilla and mix again.
Stir in baking soda, salt, cornstarch and flour. Then fold in chocolate chips, m&m’s + sprinkles.
Spread into prepared baking pan and smooth with a spatula to make even for baking.
Bake for 18-22 minutes or until light golden brown along the top and edges. Top with flaked salt. Allow to cool before serving.

title: Sheet Pan Gnocchi with Sausage, Broccolini, Garlic Bread…and Burrata
ingredients: 1 (10 oz) loaf frozen garlic bread, wrapped in foil
8 oz broccolini, chopped (and tough ends trimmed off)
4 tbsp pesto, divided, plus more for finishing
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.

Place the foil-wrapped garlic bread on one side of an 18-by-13-inch rimmed sheet pan. Add the gnocchi, tomatoes and broccolini to the rest of the pan. Drizzle generously with olive oil, season with salt and red pepper flakes, and toss everything together.
Break the sausage into small pieces and nestle it around and on top of the gnocchi.
Bake for 20 minutes, until slightly crispy. Remove the pan from the oven, carefully unwrap the garlic bread and place it back on the pan cut-side up. Spread 2 tablespoons of the pesto over the bread.
Return the pan to the oven and bake for another 12 minutes, or until the garlic bread is crunchy, the gnocchi is golden and the sausage is cooked through.

Toss the gnocchi with the remaining 2 tablespoons pesto, then scatter the torn burrata over the top. Finish with an extra drizzle of pesto and more red pepper flakes if you want, and serve everything directly from the sheet pan with the garlic bread.

title: Sheet pan pancake – no refined sugar!
steps: Preheat oven to 180C/350F fan-forced.
Blend all blender ingredients.
Grease a 31 x 21 cm (12 x 8in) with butter, then baking paper.
Pour blender ingredients into your sheet pan.
Add dry ingredients and mix with a whisk until well combined.
Bake for 30 minutes or until starting to go golden brown.

title: sheet pan pineapple bbq chicken bowls 🍍🍚🫑🤤
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed
steps: To make the sauce, add the ketchup, brown sugar, soy sauce, pineapple juice, garlic, ginger paste, rice vinegar, and sesame oil to a small saucepan. Heat over medium-low, stirring occasionally, and let it simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the sauce has reduced by about half and is thick and glossy. Set aside.
Preheat your oven to 425°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut the chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces and place them in a large bowl. Add 1 cup of the prepared BBQ sauce and toss until the chicken is evenly coated.
Spread the chicken onto the prepared baking sheet in an even layer. Add the pineapple, bell peppers, and onion, spreading everything out so it cooks evenly.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, stirring halfway through, until the chicken is fully cooked, the vegetables are tender, and everything has started to caramelize around the edges.
Remove the sheet pan from the oven and brush everything with a little more of the BBQ sauce. Garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds, then serve over your favorite rice.

title: Sheet Pan Sausage & Pesto Meatball Tortellini with Vodka Sauce
ingredients: – 1/3 cup grated Parmesan cheese, plus more for topping and serving
– 1 (24 oz) jar vodka sauce, plus more if you like it saucier
– Fresh basil or parsley, for serving
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Grease a large sheet pan, or line it with parchment paper or foil for easier cleanup. If using foil, grease the foil well.

In a large bowl, combine the panko, Parmesan, pesto, egg and Italian sausage. Mix until just combined, then roll into about 20 meatballs and arrange on the prepared sheet pan. Bake for 12 -15 minutes.

Remove the pan from the oven and give it a good shake to loosen the meatballs from the pan. Add the tortellini and vodka sauce. Pour the 1/2 cup water into the empty sauce jar, shake it up to get every last bit of sauce, then pour it onto the pan and toss everything together, scraping up any brown bits from the pan.

Add the kale or spinach and toss again until everything is evenly coated. Spoon over a little more vodka sauce if you like it extra saucy, then add dollops of ricotta all over the top and finish with a gentle snowfall of Parmesan.
Return to the oven and bake for 15–20 minutes, until the tortellini is tender and cooked through. Finish with fresh basil or parsley, more Parmesan and red pepper flakes.

title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas with Roasted Garlic Chipotle Sauce 🔥
ingredients: 2 lb (0.8 kg) boneless skinless chicken thighs, sliced
Seasonings: 2 tsp paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tsp cayenne (optional), 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp salt & 2 tsp pepper
1/2 each of a red, yellow, orange and green bell pepper, sliced
Veggie seasonings (1 tsp each): garlic powder, cumin, chili powder, paprika, oregano, onion powder, salt, pepper
1 head of garlic, top 1/4 sliced off 1 tbsp oil of choice 1 tsp salt
2 chipotle pepper 1 tbsp honey Juice of 1/2 lime
steps: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl with mayo, avocado oil, honey, lime juice, garlic, and all chicken seasonings. Toss until everything is coated. Marinate for at least a few mins, or up to overnight. Longer = better flavor.
Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Drizzle the garlic head with oil and salt, wrap it in foil like a little flavor gift, and place on a tray. Roast for 45–60 minutes, until soft & golden.

Add all sliced veggies to a large sheet pan. Drizzle with avocado oil, sprinkle with veggie seasonings, and toss to coat. Add the marinated chicken directly onto the pan with the veggies. Toss everything together so it plays nice. Bake for 20–25 minutes, until the chicken is fully cooked, lightly charred, and the veggies are tender.
Once the garlic is cool, squeeze the roasted cloves into a blender or food processor. Add sour cream, mayo, chipotle peppers, honey, and lime juice. Blend until smooth.
Spoon pan juices back over the chicken. Top with cilantro, extra lime, and dollops of the chipotle sauce. I love turning this into wraps. Load up tortillas and crisp them in a buttered pan.

title: Shrimp Burgers
ingredients: 2 lbs Shrimp, peeled & deveined. (Either finely chop by hand or pulse in food processor. I like to keep some chunks though so I prefer do it by hand)
1 tbsp Cajun seasoning, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp black pepper
Toast burger buns then add lettuce, shrimp patty and secret sauce! So good y’all!
steps: Combine in a bowl and mix well. Form patties then cook in a skillet with a little bit of olive oil. About 3–4 minutes each side.

title: Sloppy Joe bowl
steps: Peel and slice one large sweet potato.
Add the sweet potato to a bowl with a damp paper towel and some sea salt.
Microwave the sweet potato for four minutes.
Chop one green bell pepper and a white onion.
Mince 3 to 4 cloves of garlic.
Arrange the microwaved sweet potatoes on a baking sheet, add olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Bake the sweet potatoes in the oven at 415 degrees for about 10 to 15 minutes.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil and the minced garlic.
After about 30 seconds, add the chopped onion.
Once the onion is softened (about 2 to 3 minutes), add in the ground beef and break it up until it's brown.

Once the meat is mostly brown, prepare the Sloppy Joe sauce by mixing together 1 teaspoon yellow mustard, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, 3 tablespoons of ketchup, 2 tablespoons of coconut amino, 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar, and 2 tablespoons of tomato paste.
Add spices: 1 teaspoon chili powder, 1 teaspoon sea salt, and a fourth teaspoon of black pepper.
Mix until everything is well combined.
Once the sweet potatoes are done baking, plate them underneath the meat mixture.
Top with pickled red onions and dill pickles.

title: Slow Cooker Caramelized Pulled Pork
steps: Season the pork shoulder with salt and pepper, score the top, and place it into the slow cooker.
In a small bowl, whisk together the brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic, honey, apple cider vinegar, and red pepper flakes.
Pour the glaze over the pork, ensuring it gets into the scored cuts.
Cover and cook on low for 7-8 hours (or high for 4-5 hours) until the meat is fork-tender.
Shred the pork directly in the slow cooker, letting it soak up that rich, caramelized glaze before serving.

title: Slow Cooker Mediterranean Chicken Bowls
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons Kinder’s The Greek Blend Seasoning
steps: Add the chicken thighs to the bottom of your slow cooker.
Add the Greek yogurt, olive oil, red wine vinegar, Kinder’s Greek Blend Seasoning, and cumin.
Toss everything together until the chicken is evenly coated.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours or high for 3 to 4 hours, until the chicken is tender and easily shreds.
Shred the chicken directly in the slow cooker and stir it into the juices.
Squeeze the juice of half a lemon over the chicken and mix well.
To make the cucumber tomato salad, combine the cucumber, tomatoes, olive oil, red wine vinegar, Italian seasoning, and salt in a bowl.
Add cooked rice to each bowl.
Top with the shredded chicken, hummus, tzatziki, cucumber tomato salad, and crumbled feta.:
Serve and enjoy!

title: Slow Cooker Soy Garlic Steak Noodles - Brocc Your Body
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steak, sliced into 2 inch long 1/2 inch thick pieces
8 oz uncooked ramen noodles, like these
steps: In a small bowl, add the soy sauce, garlic, ginger, rice vinegar, honey, toasted sesame oil, sriracha, and ¼ cup water. Stir until combined.
Add the steak to the bottom of the slow cooker. Pour the sauce on top and cover. Cook on high for 3-4 hours or low for 6-7 until the meat is tender.
In a small bowl, add the cornstarch to 1 ½ cups water and whisk until fully combined.
Add the mixture to the slow cooker along with the bell peppers and stir to combine.
Add the noodles and cook, stirring every 5-10 minutes, for 20-25 minutes or until the noodles are cooked through and the bell peppers are soft.
Serve immediately with lots of chopped green onions on top.

title: Slow Cooker Thai-Inspired Peanut Chicken with Sticky Coconut Purple Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon honey, coconut sugar or brown sugar
2 tablespoons reduced sodium soy sauce (gluten free, if desired)
1 cup lite coconut milk (from the can)
Cilantro and chopped peanuts for garnish
steps: Add peanut butter, honey, soy sauce, garlic, hot sauce and coconut milk to the slow cooker and whisk until sauce is well combined.
Add chicken and red pepper slices to slow cooker and spoon sauce over the chicken. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours or high for 2-3 hours.
Once done cooking, remove chicken with a slotted spoon, shred with two forks, then return to the slower cooker; stir to combine the shredded chicken with the sauce.

About 30 minutes before you are ready to serve the chicken, make the rice: Place a medium pot over medium heat and add in coconut oil and purple sticky rice. Toast rice with the coconut oil for 5 minutes; stirring frequently to toast the rice and infused the coconut oil flavor in.

After 5 minutes add in water and bring mixture to a boil, then cover, reduce heat to low and simmer for 25 minutes. (If you are not using thai purple sticky rice, then cooking time may vary. For instance, brown rice takes about 45 minutes.)
After rice is done cooking, remove heat, then re-cover and let stand for 5 more minutes. Once done, season with a little salt to taste.

To make the bowls, evenly distribute rice and chicken on top. Add hot sauce, peanuts and cilantro on top, if desired. If you are making for meal prep, simply divide into 4 containers (leave off toppings until ready to eat). This recipe can also be doubled if you are making for a crowd. Makes 4 servings.

title: SLOW ROASTED BEEF TACOS 🌮
steps: You can do this in a Dutch oven OR crockpot:
In a skillet or Dutch oven, bring to medium heat and add about 1 tbsp of olive oil. Sear both sides of meat.
Turn off heat (Dutch oven) or move to crockpot
Add remainder of ingredients
Cook in the Dutch oven for about 3-4 hours on 325° until meat is falling apart when a fork is inserted. OR 6 hours on low in the crockpot
Shred and toss in juices. Enjoy!

title: Sourdough Bread Recipe
ingredients: f o l d & s h a p e :
steps: Mix active sourdough starter and water in a large bowl.
Add salt and gently mix.
Add in bread flour and mix until all of the flour is fully hydrated (3-5min).
Rest covered with a damp dish towel for 1 hour.
Stretch and fold the dough 4 times every 30 minutes over 2 hours. Cover the dough with a damp dish towel between every stretch and fold.
Flip dough out of your bowl on the counter and divide your dough into two equal pieces.
Shape dough pieces and place in a banneton covered in the fridge overnight.
b a k i n g:
The next morning preheat oven with a dutch oven inside at 450f° for 45min-1hour.
Remove dough from the fridge and score.
Place loaf in the preheated dutch oven with the lid on for 20 min.
Remove the dutch oven lid. Turn oven down to 400f and bake the bread for an additional 10-20 min until golden brown.
Wait to cool before cutting.
Enjoy!

title: Sourdough Chocolate Chip Cookies Recipe - Little Spoon Farm
ingredients: 1 cup 1 teaspoon (125 g) bread flour all-purpose can be substituted, see notes
8 tablespoons (113 g) unsalted butter cold, cubed
1 1/2 cups (340 g) chocolate chips semi-sweet or milk chocolate
steps: Mix dry ingredients
Use a whisk or a fork to mix the bread flour, all-purpose flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt in a small bowl. Set aside.
Mix wet ingredients 1
In a separate small bowl, use a whisk or a fork to beat the egg, vanilla extract and sourdough starter until smooth. Set aside.
Mix wet ingredients 2

Place the cold, cubed butter, light brown sugar and granulated sugar into the bowl of a stand mixer with the paddle attachment. Beat on low-speed until the mixture forms small crumbles, 45-60 seconds. Add the chocolate chips and mix on low-speed 30-45 seconds. Scrape down the sides of the bowl.

Add the dry ingredients and mix on low-speed until the batter starts to become a crumbly mixture, 20-30 seconds. Pour in the egg mixture and mix on low-speed until the dough comes together and starts to pull away from the sides of the bowl, 20-30 seconds. Use a spatula to stir the batter, ensuring all of the ingredients have been fully incorporated.

Use a cookie scoop to portion the dough into 12 balls, (2 scoops per cookie) and place them on a parchment-lined baking tray. Cover the dough with a sheet of plastic wrap so they do not dry out. Chill the dough in the fridge for a minimum of 2 hours. (24 hours is best!)

Bake in a preheated, 375°F (190°C) oven for 15-17 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center still appears slightly under-baked. Remove and allow the cookies to rest on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a cooling rack.

title: Sourdough Ciabatta
steps: The measurements for mine are 1 & 1/3 cup of water, 1 cup active starter, and 3 cups flower.

Prepare your dough as usual with the stretch and folds and the countertop bulk fermentation. You are going to let this go slightly overproof. Slightly overproofing I mean about one hour more than usual. From there handle your dough as little as possible as you spread it out flat. You are going to cut into 8 even pieces. Gently flour each side of the ciabatta and lay flat on a parchment lined baking sheet.
Preheat the oven to 450 and bake for 10 minutes, then decrease the temp to 400 and bake for an additional 10 minutes.

title: Sourdough Discard Hawaiian Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned pineapple juice room temperature
1/4 cup non-dairy or regular dairy milk warmed to 110
200 grams (about 3/4 cup) sourdough discard unfed, at room temperature
3 Tablespoons unsalted butter divided and melted
1 egg beaten with 1 Tablespoon water for egg wash
steps: Combine the pineapple juice, milk, instant yeast and brown sugar in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a dough hook*. Add the flour, sourdough discard, beaten egg, vanilla extract and salt. With the mixer on low, slowly pour in 2 Tablespoons of melted butter. Increase speed to medium and mix until a shaggy dough forms, about 2 minutes.

Transfer the dough to a smooth work surface and knead until smooth, about 3-4 minutes. The dough should be smooth, soft and just slightly tacky (not sticky). If needed, add more flour or milk (1 Tablespoon at a time) to reach your desired consistency.
Transfer the dough to a large oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let rise for 90 minutes, or until doubled in size.
Brush a 9x13-inch baking pan with the remaining 1 Tablespoon of melted butter and set aside.

Turn the dough onto a smooth work surface and divide into 15 equal-sized pieces. This doesn't have to be exact, but if you do want perfectly identical rolls, weigh the dough on a kitchen scale and divide that number by 15. For me, each roll weighs about 73 grams.Using your palm for friction, roll each piece of dough into a ball, then place the rolls into the prepared baking pan with the seam-side down. Repeat until you have 15 rolls.
Cover the baking pan with plastic wrap or a clean kitchen towel and let the rolls rise for 60 minutes until puffed and doubled in size.

Preheat the oven to 375℉. Lightly brush the rolls with egg wash. Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown. Let cool slightly in the pan, then brush with 1 Tablespoon melted butter before serving (optional).

title: Sourdough English Muffins
ingredients: 1 tablespoon (20 g) honey sugar or maple syrup
steps: ½ cup (100 g) active sourdough starter
1 tablespoon (20 g) honey sugar or maple syrup
1 cup (240 g) milk
3 cups (360 g) all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon (5 g) fine sea salt
¼ cup (40 g) cornmeal for sprinkling
Let the dough ferment for 8.5 hours.
Cook the muffins on medium low heat, starting to check at 4 minutes on one side, and continue checking until done, which may take about 8 minutes on one side.
Adjust the size of the muffins to preference for breakfast sandwiches.

title: Sourdough Pizza Dough
steps: Starting off with 150 grams of sourdough starter.
Add 300 grams of room temperature filtered water.
Add 15 grams of olive oil.
Add 500 grams total of flour (50 grams of whole wheat and 450 grams of bread flour).
Add 15 grams of salt.
Mix the dough until it has a nice shaggy consistency with no dry flour left in the bowl.
Cover the dough and leave it for an hour.
After an hour, perform a gentle round of stretch and folds.
Cover the dough and leave it for another hour.
After the second hour, perform another round of stretch and folds.
Cover the dough and leave it for another hour.
Skip the third round of stretch and folds if the dough is holding together well.
Leave the dough on the counter for a couple of hours to finish its bulk fermentation.
Once bulk fermentation is complete, divide the dough into four equal pieces (about 250 grams each).
Shape each piece into a tight little pizza ball by pulling the edges under and turning it.
Place the shaped dough into an airtight container.
Refrigerate the dough to use within the next five days.

title: Southside Spritz
steps: Start by muddling a big handful of mint leaves.
Add two ounces of vodka of your choice.
Add one ounce of fresh lemon juice.
Add half ounce of fresh lime juice.
Add a splash of St. Germain.
Add ice and shake well.
Take the biggest spritz glass you can find or your pool cup.
Pour the mixture into the glass.
Add three ounces of Prosecco.
Top with some lime club soda.
Give it a nice stir.

title: Southwest Beef Skillet
ingredients: salt, pepper, paprika, chili powder, cumin
steps: start by chopping all veggies and set aside. in a large pan, heat 1 tbsp oil. add in 2 lb ground beef along with the onion and bell pepper. break apart ground beef and cook until about halfway done. add in seasonings, and continue cooking until there is no more pink. add in minced garlic and stir for a couple minutes until fragrant. set meat mixture aside. in the same (empty) pan, add remaining tbsp oil. add in sweet potatoes, fire roasted tomatoes, green chiles, and same seasonings mix until well combined. add in 1/4 cup of water and cover with a lid for 18-20 minutes, until potatoes are fork tender. add meat mixture back into the pan and combine everything together. top with 1 cup of cheese and turn off heat. cover with lid for 5 ish minutes or until cheese is melted. serve and enjoy!

title: Spicy Peanut Chicken Salad
ingredients: spicy peanut dressing: (I typically blend this and add water/ lime juice depending on the flavor)
dash of crushed red pepper (add more if you like it really spicy)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350F. Lay shredded cheese into a rectangle and top with thin pickle spears. Be sure to pat the pickles dry before adding them on top of the cheese.
Put the wrap into the oven at 350F for about 12 - 15 minutes or until golden brown on the edges of the wrap. Let the wrap cool for 5 minutes.
Add ground beef, lettuce, tomato, onion, avocado, and your favorite sauce.
Sweet potato bowls always hit the spot! this is one of my favorite blood sugar balancing meals!
Start by preheating the oven to 400F.
Chop the sweet potato into “discs” and place them into a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with cinnamon, smoked paprika, and sea salt. (l just eyeball this.
Place the sweet potato in the oven on a parchment. Paper lined baking sheet for 45 - 50 min.
Chop your toppings: 1 added black beans, mini sweet peppers, pineapple, avocado, olives, tomatoes, olives, and chives.
Cook your ground beef on the stove top. (I add the siete taco seasoning).
Once your sweet potatoes are done, add everything into one bowl and top with chipotle aioli.
If there’s one new recipe you try this week, it should be this!! It’s AMAZING.
Cut the spaghetti squash cross

title: spicy pineapple marg
steps: Infuse the tequila overnight with jalapeno slices and pineapple chunks.
In a half gallon container, combine 20 ounces of infused tequila.
Add 10 ounces of pineapple juice.
Pour in 5 ounces of Cointreau.
Add 5 ounces of agave syrup.
Mix in 8 ounces of lime juice.
Add ice and a couple of jalapeno slices for garnish.

title: Spicy Pineapple Margarita
steps: Lime wheel:

In a shaker, combine jalapeño, tequila, orange liqueur, lime juice, and pineapple juice. Shake with ice for 8 seconds and strain over fresh ice. Garnish with a couple pineapple fronds and a lime wheel.

title: Spicy Skinny Margaritas
ingredients: 1/2 large jalapeno pepper, seeded and thinly sliced
steps: Add the sliced jalapeño peppers and lime juice to a cocktail shaker. With a cocktail muddler or back of a wooden spoon, mash to break up the peppers.
Add the tequila, orange juice, honey, and egg white to the shaker, then cover and shake (do not add ice).
Rub a lime wedge around the rim of two glasses, then dip in coarse salt.
Fill the glasses with ice, then top with the margarita mix. Garnish with a lime wedge and enjoy!

title: Strawberry Crumble Chia Pudding
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened plant-based yogurt (or use sweetened vanilla yogurt and adjust additional sweetener to preference)
1 cup unsweetened soy milk (or alternative of your choice)
steps: Strawberry Crumble Chia Pudding, inspired by a strawberry oat recipe in my upcoming cookbook but obviously chia version this time.
Prep ahead and look forward to enjoying for a quick grab and go breakfast when you need it.
And yes, feel free to change up the fruit based on your preference.

title: STRAWBERRY HUGO SPRITZ
ingredients: 2 mint sprigs, plus more for garnish
Strawberries and edible flowers, for garnish
steps: To a wine glass, add the leaves from 2 mint sprigs, clapping them between your palms first. Add the strawberry purée and elderflower seeds. Allow to sit for 1-2 minutes, if time allows, to infuse the mint flavor.
Fill the glass with ice. Add prosecco, and a splash of sparkling water. Stir to combine.
If desired, garnish with strawberries, mint and edible flowers.

title: Strawberry Ice Cream
ingredients: adjust sweetener to your taste - less sweet sttawberries may require more
if you want a richer ice cream then add 2 tbs sour cream (especially if you use a lower fat greek yogurt)
steps: If its powdery after the first spin, add 1tbs milk and respin

title: SUGAR COOKIE CREAMER 🎄✨
ingredients: (use organic ingredients when possible) 1 c half half (or creamer of choice)
steps: WHAT TO DO:
combine all ingredients + mix well
pour over your favorite hot or iced coffee + you’ve got the holidays in a mug

title: Summer Margarita
steps: In a pitcher, combine three fourths of lime juice from eight limes.
Add one cup of pineapple juice.
Pour in three fourths cup of coconut milk.
Mix in three fourths cup of Grand Marnier or any orange liqueur of your choice.
Stir in half cup of agave.
Add a cup and a half of tequila.
Stir the mixture well.
Rim the glasses with Tajin for an extra touch.
Serve with a lime wedge.
Enjoy your delicious summer margaritas!

title: Super Easy Sweet and Sour Chicken
ingredients: fourth of a cup of rice vinegar
fourth of a cup of brown sugar
fourth of a cup of ketchup
fourth of a cup of water
steps: Cut four chicken breasts into bite size pieces.
Grate in three cloves of fresh garlic and a teaspoon of ginger.
Add two tablespoons of soy sauce and one tablespoon of cornstarch to the chicken mixture and let it sit.
Prep the veggies: bell peppers and half an onion.
Make the sauce by mixing a fourth of a cup of rice vinegar, a fourth of a cup of brown sugar, a fourth of a cup of ketchup, two cloves of fresh garlic, and two tablespoons of soy sauce.
Add a fourth of a cup of water to the sauce mixture and mix well.
Add half a tablespoon of cornstarch to the sauce mixture for thickening.
Heat some neutral oil in a pan over the stove.
Add the chicken in an even layer and sauté for about three to five minutes per side.
Turn the heat down to low and remove the chicken from the pan.
Add the veggies and pineapple to the pan and cook down on medium heat for about five minutes until tender.
Once the veggies are soft, add the sauce directly onto the veggies and let it thicken for about one to three minutes.
Add the chicken back into the pan and coat it with the sauce.
Top with a little bit of cilantro and sesame seeds before serving.

title: Super Fudgy Gluten Free Brownies
steps: Melt together the butter and sugar in the microwave for four minutes, stirring every 30 seconds.
Add in eggs, vanilla extract, gluten free baking flour, cocoa powder, and salt.
Mix until you have a velvety batter.
Bake for 30 minutes.
Cut and serve.

title: Sweetgreen Harvest Bowl Copycat Recipe
ingredients: Salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika
2 cups wild rice (or quinoa or brown rice)
Optional: splash of water to thin out
steps: To make it:
Roast the sweet potato.:
Dice sweet potato into small pieces and toss in olive oil, salt & pepper. Roast in the oven at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes.
Make the dressing.

In a small jar, add the balsamic vinegar, olive oil, maple syrup, Dijon mustard, grated Parmesan, salt & pepper. I like to use a frother to whip it all together until smooth. If you don’t have one, you can also seal the jar and shake it up until well combined.
Cook the chicken.
Dice the chicken breast into bite sized pieces. Season with smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, then sauté until golden on the outside and cooked through.
Finely chop the kale
I swear every salad tastes 10x better when everything is finely chopped. Chop the kale really well so you get a little bit of everything in every bite!
Assembly
Add the kale to a bowl with the roasted sweet potato, chopped apple, wild rice, almonds, goat cheese, and chicken. Drizzle generously with the maple-balsamic vinaigrette and toss everything together.

title: Teriyaki Beef Ribs
ingredients: Green onion and sesame seeds for garnish
steps: Add the beef ribs to a large mixing bowl.
Drizzle a little bit of olive oil over the ribs.
Season the ribs with garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Toss the ribs to ensure they are well coated and set aside.
In a separate bowl, combine low sodium soy sauce, brown sugar, honey, red pepper flakes, minced garlic, water, ground ginger, and oyster sauce.
Whisk the sauce mixture together until well combined.
Add the beef ribs to the crock pot.
Pour the sauce mixture over the beef ribs and cover the crock pot.
Cook on low for eight hours.
Once cooked, carefully remove the ribs from the crock pot as they will be very tender.
In a bowl, whisk together two tablespoons of water and two tablespoons of cornstarch.
Add the cornstarch mixture into the sauce in the crock pot and whisk until the sauce thickens.
Pour the thickened sauce over the ribs.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.

title: Tex-Mex Beef Enchiladas
ingredients: 3 cups beef broth, more or less depending on your preferred sauce thickness
Salt to taste, starting with 1/2 tsp
Oil, for lightly frying the tortillas
steps: Add the ground beef and diced onion to a large skillet over medium heat. Cook until the beef is browned and the onion is tender. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute. Drain the excess grease.

Season the beef with onion powder, garlic powder, tomato chicken bouillon, Sazón, if using, and a pinch of black pepper. Stir in the tomato paste and ½ cup water. Cook for a few minutes, stirring until everything is well combined and the beef mixture has thickened slightly. Set aside.

Add a thin layer of oil to a skillet over medium heat. Sauté each corn tortilla for about 10 seconds per side. You only want to soften them. You don't want them crispy. Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining tortillas. Trust me, this step is a MUST! Once finished, remove the oil from the pan.
Melt the butter in a skillet or saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in the flour and cook for about 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the beef broth while whisking to prevent lumps. Start with less broth and add more as needed until the sauce reaches your preferred consistency.
Add the chili powder, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and salt. Continue cooking and whisking until the sauce is smooth and slightly thickened. Taste and adjust the salt if needed.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Spread enough enchilada sauce across the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish to completely cover it.

Dip a prepared corn tortilla into the enchilada sauce, coating both sides. Place it in the baking dish and add some of the ground beef mixture and shredded Mexican-blend cheese. Roll the tortilla and place it seam-side down.

Repeat with the remaining tortillas until your baking dish is full. Depending on how tightly they're rolled, a 9x13-inch dish should hold around 12 enchiladas. The full recipe makes approximately 20 enchiladas, so you may need a second baking dish.
Spoon additional ground beef over the enchiladas, pour more enchilada sauce over the top, and finish with plenty of shredded cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes, or until the enchiladas are hot and bubbly and the cheese is completely melted.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings like sour cream, cilantro, diced tomatoes, avocado, or jalapeños.

title: Thai Basil Beef Rolls
steps: Brown some beef.
Add some seasonings to the beef.
Add lots of sweet Thai chili sauce.
Add pickled ginger.
Assemble the rolls using flour tortillas, cucumber, beef, green onions, and Thai basil.
Slice them in half and enjoy warm with extra sauce on top.

title: Thai Peanut Chicken Bowl
steps: Marinate the chicken thighs with chopped cilantro, minced garlic, fish sauce, fresh pepper, curry powder, and coconut milk for 30 minutes in the fridge.
Wash a cup of rice and add it to the instant pot with a can of coconut milk and 3/4 cup of water, then stir.
Cook the rice in the instant pot for 30 minutes.
Prepare stir fry veggies from Costco.

Make the peanut sauce by mixing 1/2 cup peanut butter, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar, 1 to 2 teaspoons chili garlic sauce, cloves of garlic, 1 to 2 teaspoons brown sugar, and 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice.
Add a tablespoon of water at a time to the peanut sauce until the desired consistency is reached.
Plate the dinner with a scoop of coconut rice and a little peanut sauce on the chicken for the triplets.
Serve the remaining chicken and rice in bowl style with a generous scoop of peanut sauce for adults.

title: Thai peanut chicken fried rice
steps: Place two pounds of chicken breast in the Crock Pot and season with salt, pepper, paprika, onion powder, and red pepper flakes.

Add 2 teaspoons minced garlic, 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, 2 tablespoons sriracha, 1/4 cup low‑sodium soy sauce, 1/4 cup powdered peanut butter, 1 teaspoon sesame oil, the juice of one lime, raw honey, and 1/2 cup light unsweetened coconut milk.
Mix everything well, put the lid on, and cook on high for three and a half to four and a half hours.
When the chicken is done, shred it, then add a bag of frozen vegetables, replace the lid, and let the vegetables warm for about 15 minutes.
Stir in 2½ cups cooked brown rice and mix thoroughly.
Divide the mixture into meal‑prep containers, using about two cups per serving, yielding five servings.

title: THANKSGIVING MARGARITA
ingredients: 2 oz tequila - I used blanco, but reposado would be great, too!
steps: BATCH RECIPE:
In a large pitcher, combine 2 ½ cups tequila, ⅔ cups triple sec, ⅔ cups lime juice, 1 ¼ cup cranberry juice, and 1 ¼ cup apple cider.
Store in the fridge until ready to serve.
To serve, pour 5 oz into a rocks glass filled with ice.
Garnish and enjoy!

title: The absolute best lactation protein ball recipe
ingredients: 1 x cup of mini chocolate chips
steps: Combine oats, flax seed, sunflower seeds, shredded coconut, mini chocolate chips, vanilla, honey, and peanut butter in a large bowl.
Mix all the ingredients together until well combined.
Form the mixture into small balls, about the size of a golf ball.
Store the protein balls in the refrigerator or freeze half for later use.

title: The BEST Brookies
ingredients: 3/4 cup (168 g) unsalted butter, melted (can be warm but not hot)
3/4 cup (150 g) light brown sugar, packed
2 cups (256 g) all-purpose flour, spooned and leveled
1 1/2 cups semisweet chocolate chips, divided (I do half mini half reg)
Flaky sea salt, for sprinkling on top
3/4 cup (75 g) regular unsweetened cocoa powder
1/2 cup (100 g) light brown sugar, packed
1/2 cup (65 g) all-purpose flour, spooned and leveled
steps: Cookie Dough:
In a large bowl, whisk together the butter, brown sugar, and sugar until well combined.
Vigorously whisk in the egg and vanilla for a good minute or until the mixture turns creamy and a shade lighter.
Whisk in the baking powder, salt, and cornstarch to evenly incorporate.
Switch to a rubber spatula and fold in the flour. About halfway through, add in 1 cup of chocolate chips and fold to fully bring the dough together. It will be thick and sticky.
Place in the refrigerator uncovered.
Brownie:
Add the butter and coconut oil to a medium saucepan and stir to melt over medium heat.
Once melted and hot, whisk in the cocoa powder and allow to bubble for about 30 seconds. Remove from heat and whisk in the chocolate chips until smooth. Set aside.
In a separate large bowl, vigorously whisk together the sugar, brown sugar, and eggs for a good minute or until creamy and a shade lighter.
Whisk in the vanilla and salt, followed by the chocolate mixture.
Add in the flour and whisk just to combine.
Grease and line a 9×13 baking pan with parchment paper, allowing some paper to hang over the sides for easy removal.
Spread the batter in the pan and place in the refrigerator to chill for 15 minutes. In the meantime, preheat the oven to 350F.
Once the brownie batter is chilled and feels firmer to the touch, it’s time to add the cookie dough on top.

Take spoonfuls of the chilled dough and press flat between your hands. Lay on top of the brownie layer to cover the surface in patches of cookie dough. Near the end, use any remaining dough to fill in the gaps to fully cover the surface.
Top with the remaining 1/2 cup of chocolate chips and gently press into the surface.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until the bars are evenly puffed and lightly golden on the surface.
Drop the pan a couple times right when it’s fresh from the oven to deflate the bars. Then sprinkle with flaky sea salt.
Allow to cool for about 20 minutes at room temperature, then transfer to the refrigerator to chill for an hour or until just barely warm.
Once cooled, lift out of the pan and slice into 12 large squares or 24 smaller squares. I suggest running a knife under the bars to help release from the paper. Enjoy!

title: The Best Chocolate Chip Cookie
steps: Brown one stick of unsalted butter until it is a little darker than light brown and then kill the heat.
Add three ice cubes to the browned butter to add back moisture and cool it down.
Stir in 150 grams (3/4 cup) of brown sugar until combined.
Add one egg and half a tablespoon of vanilla extract, then stir until it forms a thick batter.
Mix in 1/2 teaspoon each of baking powder, baking soda, and kosher salt.
Grind 100 grams of whole oats until powdery, then add to the mixture.
Stir in 120 grams (1 cup) of all-purpose flour until combined.
Add 170 grams (about 1 cup) of chocolate chips and stir until the dough is well mixed.
Scoop the dough using a No. 20 scoop (about 3 tablespoons) and place on a baking sheet.
Refrigerate the cookie dough for about 24 hours to let it age.
Bake at 350°F for about 10 minutes for fresh dough, or at 280°F for about 26 minutes for frozen dough.

title: the BEST homemade chicken nuggets 🤍 perfect balance of savory and sweet!
ingredients: 3 tbsp barbecue sauce (can add more if you want stronger bbq flavor)
steps: Preheat your oven to 425F.
In a large bowl combine 1 package of ground chicken with 2 eggs, parmesan cheese, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.

For the coating blend 1 small bag sweet potato chips- 1 cup of crumbs (I like Jackson’s because they’re only make with 3 ingredients) add 1/4 cup almond flour, 1/4 cup grated parmesan, and 1 tsp smoked paprika.
Wet your hands so the chicken doesn’t stick to your fingers while you form little nuggets and coat them in the sweet potato crumb mixture.
Put them in the over at 425F for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown!

title: The BEST Mexican Street Corn Chicken Rice Bowls — Jazz Leaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
Fresh cilantro and hot sauce to garnish (optional)
2 pouches cilantro lime microwavable rice OR fresh rice. See bottom for instructions on that
steps: Toss the cubed chicken breast with 1.5 tablespoons of taco seasoning until evenly coated.

Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in a single layer and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through (internal temp 165 degrees F). Remove from the pan and set aside.

Without wiping the pan, add the frozen corn and remaining half tablespoon of taco seasoning directly to the same skillet. Cook over medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes, letting the corn sit without stirring so it picks up a light char and absorbs the seasoning left from the chicken. Remove from heat and stir in the pico de gallo. The residual heat from the corn will slightly soften the pico without cooking it down completely.
While the corn cooks, whisk together the Greek yogurt, mayo, and lime juice in a small bowl until smooth.
Pour ½ of the lime crema into the corn and pico mixture and mix to combine. Reserve some of the sauce over the top of the bowls.
Microwave the rice pouches according to package directions.

Divide the rice between four bowls. Top with corn and pico, cooked chicken, and avocado slices. Spoon the lime lime crema, and finish with sliced avocado, fresh cilantro, lime juice and hot sauce if using.
Cilantro Lime Rice:
Rinse the rice under cold water 6 to 8 times until the water runs clear. Add the rinsed rice to a non-stick saucepan with the 4 cups of cold water, salt, and avocado oil. Stir to combine.
Place over medium-high heat and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover with a lid, and let the rice simmer for 10 minutes. Do not lift the lid.
Remove from heat and let it sit covered for 2 minutes. Fluff with a fork, then immediately stir in the lime juice and fresh cilantro. Taste and adjust with more lime or salt if needed.
Do not crowd the pan when cooking the chicken. Cook in two batches if needed so the chicken sears rather than steams.
Use high heat for the corn and resist stirring constantly. The char is where the elote flavor comes from.
The crema ratio is a starting point. Go up to 4 or 5 tablespoons of each if you want a saucier bowl.
Rotisserie chicken is a great shortcut. Warm it in the skillet with the taco seasoning and skip the full cook step. Total time drops to about 15 minutes.
Store all components separately in airtight containers for up to 4 days. Add avocado and pico fresh when serving.

title: the perfect getting ready / pre dinner cocktail 🍸🍋✨
steps: top with ice, sparkling water & enjoy

title: Toddler approved breakfast
steps: Spray pan with oil. Cut muffins in half and place in dish cut side up. Top with shredded cheese and ham if using. In a small dish combine eggs, cottage cheese, and seasonings. Pour mixture evenly over muffins. Baked in preheated oven at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, or until eggs are fully set.

title: Trader Joe’s Dupe Protein Pancakes
ingredients: Optional: 1–2 tsp honey or maple syrup
steps: Blend everything until smooth, cook on a lightly greased skillet over medium heat, and flip once bubbles form. That’s it.

title: Tuna Spring Rolls
steps: Drain the tuna from the cans.
In a bowl, mix the non-fat plain Greek yogurt and blended cottage cheese until fluffy.
Add Sriracha and a dash of low sodium soy sauce to the mixture.
Prepare the spring rolls by running them under cold water for 5-10 seconds until malleable.
Place a sheet of seaweed on the plate.
Scoop the tuna mixture onto the seaweed.
Add shredded carrots, cucumbers, jalapenos, green onions, and pickled ginger on top of the tuna mixture.
Drizzle with wasabi mayo.
Roll the spring roll tightly.

title: Turkey Veggie Skillet
ingredients: 2 bell peppers color of choice, chopped
steps: Brown ground turkey over medium/high heat and drain any excess water/fat. Add turkey seasonings & stir to combine. Remove & set aside. Drizzle olive oil in the pan and add the onion and garlic. Cook until fragrant and then add in the zucchini & bell pepper. Add veggie seasonings. Cook until desired veggie doneness. Add the ground turkey back into the skillet & turn the heat down. Add tomato paste & water. Mix well. Simmer for 5 minutes & enjoy!

title: Viral Brownie Balls
ingredients: Flave City brownie batter protein smoothie
steps: Pulls the oatmeal until it becomes oat flour.
Add dates, cacao powder, maple syrup, almond butter, vanilla, salt, and the Flave City brownie batter protein smoothie.
Blend until it looks like brownie butter.
Roll the mixture into balls and pop them in the freezer.
Microwave a little bit of chocolate chips with coconut oil until it's super smooth.
Roll the balls into chocolate, sprinkle with sea salt, and let them set.

title: Warm Chia Seed Pudding
steps: Combine 2 tablespoons of chia seeds with 1 cup of water.
Add 1 serving of protein powder to the mixture.
Stir in your choice of fruit.
Optionally, add cacao powder, cinnamon, and cacao nibs for additional flavor.

title: Watermelon Hugo
steps: Top with club soda:
Assemble in a glass filled with ice, gently stir to combine & enjoy!

title: Watermelon Prosecco Spritz
steps: Start with a good amount of fresh watermelon and muddle it together with the juice of one lime and a handful of mint.
Fill a large wine glass with ice.
Strain the muddled watermelon juice into the bottom of the glass.
Add a couple of capfuls of St Germain to the glass.
Pour in the Prosecco, filling the glass.
Garnish with a beautiful piece of mint and a slice of watermelon.

title: Yummy Fall Dinner
ingredients: about half a can of coconut milk
steps: Sauté the onion and green bell pepper until softened.
Add the great northern beans, pinto beans, shredded chicken breasts, and bone broth to the pot.
Stir in about half a can of coconut milk.
Season with cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, salt, and pepper to taste.
Simmer until heated through and flavors meld.
Serve warm.

title: 🍯🍔Clean Chick-fil-A–Style Sauce (Homemade)
ingredients: 1 tsp organic soy sauce (or coconut aminos)
steps: 1. Add all ingredients to a bowl
2. Whisk (or blend) until smooth and creamy
3. Taste and adjust sweetness or salt if needed
4. Store in the fridge (lasts ~5–7 days)
5. Use it on: nuggets, burgers, wraps, fries, roasted veggies 😋

title: 🔥 Jalapeño Popper Chicken Wrap meal prep🌯🔥
ingredients: 1 cup reduced fat cheddar cheese, shredded
1/4 cup pickled jalapeños, diced (grab the mild ones for less heat)
steps: In a bowl, combine shredded rotisserie chicken, cooked and crumbled center cut bacon, nonfat Greek yogurt, hot sauce, reduced fat cheddar cheese, diced pickled jalapeños, and ranch seasoning. Mix until well combined.
Spread the mixture onto the low calorie tortilla wraps and fold them into burritos.
Heat a pan over medium high heat and place the burritos in the pan.
To make the creamy jalapeño ranch, add nonfat Greek yogurt, light mayo, pickled jalapeños, jalapeño brine, ranch seasoning, and a splash of water into a blender and blend until smooth.
Once the burritos are golden brown, serve them with a dip in the creamy jalapeño ranch.

title: 🤯GENIUS HEALTHY LAVA CAKE DESSERT
ingredients: 8 oz cottage cheese (half a 16 oz tub)
4 tbsp powdered monkfruit (or sweetener of choice)
3 tbsp cacao powder (use 2.5 tbsp if you want it less rich)
Optional but highly recommended: a sprinkle of sugar free or chocolate chips
steps: First, the cottage cheese. I processed 8oz cottage cheese in a small food processor until smooth to get rid of the curds. Transfer to a small oven-safe bowl.
To the processed cottage cheese, crack in 2 eggs
Add the cacao powder (I use 3 tbsp … sometimes more… but I like it really rich)
Stir in 3 to 4 tbsp of powdered monkfruit or preferred sweetener. Make sure it’s POWDERED. That is key
Add a splash of vanilla extract and mix thoroughly till you have a nice smooth batter.
Sprinkle chocolate chips on top, if desired, shake it so it somewhat submerges into the cake to get you the lava cake feel. Again, use as many as you like
Pop it into the oven and bake at 350°F for 33-35 mins.
Remove, let cool for two or three mins.
